tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng bdun pa

chos grags rgya mtsho'i lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /na rim bdun pa rje chos grags rgya mtsho ni/ de nas chos kyi rje mthong ba don ldan gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu kar/ go'i shri rin po che la zhal chems bka' rgya bcu gsum dang bcas pa gnang*/ byang phyogs spyi lha zhes bya bar sprul sku 'byon par yab yum dang bcas lung bstan/ de nyid kyi bar do'i rnam thar las kyang/ byang phyogs suu don yod grub pas khyod dzambu'i gling du/ pha grags pa dpal grub dang*/ ma lha mo skyid las skye bar 'gyur ro gsungs zhes phyis sprul sku nyid kyis bka' stsal/ mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs chen pos kyang bya lo zla ba bdun pa'i skabs shig ja gral ba mang du yod pa cig la nga yi rmi lam ltar na da res sprul sku'i yab la dpal grub bya ba zhig yong ba 'dug gsungs/ kun mkhyen ban sgar bas kyang*/ mtshur phu nas shar phyogs drang por sprul sku 'byon zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ rngod spyi mda' zhes pa/ de yang grub pa'i gnas mkha' 'gro'i sbas yul zhig ste/ de'i gnas kyi bdag po gzhi bdag thams cad kyi spyi dpon nam/ thams cad kyi lha'am/ jo bo lta bu yin pas na spyi lha zhes bya ba/ sngon rje rang byung rdo rje mtshur phu'i dben gnas bde chen na bzhugs pa'i dus dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus shing*/ phyin chad yon bdag byed cing ci gsung sgrub ces dam bcas/ gnas der phebs nas bzhugs pa'i zhu ba phul bzhin rim par phebs nas zhabs kyis bcags/ ma 'ongs sprul sku 'byon pa'i zhing du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgya gar gyi gnas chen rnams kyi yal ga mkha' 'gro ma'i sbas lung*/ gdul bya dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can spyi nang bya bar/ yab grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu chen po rus chen sngong la nang tshan dpa' ya ste/ grags pa dpal grub bya ba dang*/ yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sprul pa jo dar bza' lha mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su/

shing pho khy-i'i lo hor zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga'i snga dror nam mkha' la kha dog lnga'i 'ja' tshon gyi re khā dang*/ me tog gi char dang*/ 'brug gi sgra dang*/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ de ma thag zhal nas a la la gsungs shing bzhad/ sku la me tog gi rnam pa mang po dang dbu ltag tu rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ thugs kar rtsa ris kyi a yig gsang gnas suu chos 'byung dang 'khor lo/ zhabs la 'khor lo ste sku la rang byon drug gsal por mngon la/ gsang chab 'o mar 'babs shing dri bzang gi ngad kyis thams cad khyab/ zhag bdun na gsung mang du byon pa na yab kyis sngags mang du gsung bar go /yum gyis dbyangs yig gsungs par go /gzhan rnams kyis ma ṇi gsung bar go/ yab yum kyis gsang bar dam bcas kyang*/ nyid kyi thugs rje'i rang 'od mkha' la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i sgrogs mkhan med kyang spyi nang du bya bral pho mo gnyis las chos kyi rje sku 'khrungs 'dug zer nas grags pa'i dbyar rngas phyogs kun khyab par gyur nas/ phyogs phyogs kyi lha dpon mi dpon gyi gtsos thams cad rang babs kyis 'dus shing gsang bar rngo ma thogs te/ snye bong ra steng gi gdan sa pa chos dpal 'byor gyis thos nas mjal du 'gro bsam pa na rmi lam du yum gyi pang na bzhugs 'dug pa la dbu zhwa sogs phul ba rmis pas/ bla ma bsgres po la rngod nas kha skad 'di 'dra lags par ci byar 'os zhus pas/ nga'i rmi lam na spyi lha'i la khar nyi zla gnyis shar ba mal gcig tu 'dus song ba rmis pas/ the tshom mi dgos drung gong ma'i dbu zhwa na bza' phyags lh+wam rnams khyer la song gsungs te/ phyin pas sku 'khrungs nas zhag bco lnga song ba'i thog tu sleb/ khong gzigs pas bzhad cing dgyes par mdzad/ rje gong ma'i dbu zhwa sogs dang drung rtogs ldan pa'i na bza' dbu zhwa rnams phul bas/ rje gong ma'i rnams phyag gis bzhes te/

gzhan ma bzhes/ khyed thams cad mkhyen pa mthong ba don ldan yin na nga la byin rlabs mdzad dgos zhus pas phyag gnyis ka spyi bor bkod de byin rlabs yang yang mdzad pas the tshom chod/ zla ngo gnyis bzhes pa na rngod pa'i lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis a rig thang du gdan drangs/ drung gong ma'i chos khri la bzhugs nas khrom chen po la zhal bstan tshe/ phyag rten rnams phyag gis rim par bzhes/ byin rlabs gnang nas khrom rnams la dal bus gzigs te phyag g.yas kyis zhal dkyil lan gsum dal gyis phyis nas mnyam bzhag dang lta stangs mdzad de/ sku gzi brjid dang ldan par bzhugs pas/ der 'dus pa thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas/ mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam la bkod do// de nas zla ngo gsum bzhes tshe rngod kyi ber bsnol du/ bzher byas sku mdun du col tshig zhus te/ mi rnams khyed karma pa min pa 'dra/ rje gong ma rnams kyis zla ba 'di la gsung 'di byon pa sogs 'dug /grub rtags mang du bstan 'dug pa/ nyid mthong ba don ldan gyi sku'i skye ba yin na yid ches kyi rtags dang gsung zhig 'byon par zhus pas/ nga ni karma'i ming can ste// nga lta'i gang zag dkon pa yin// nga dang 'brel pa 'ga' yod pa// nga yis mi bslu'i smon lam yod// bcu gsum zla ba ma rdzogs par// tshig 'di gsang chen rgya dang ldan// de nas kho bo rtsod bral ba'i// rtags rnams rim gyis gsal par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs/ de nas snye bos gdan drangs nas/ da ra steng du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ karma si tu pa'i zhu yig lcags mo dbon po/ /gser bya bral bsod ye sogs kyis phul nas/ zhu yig phyag gis bzhes nas yig phreng la rim par gzigs nas gsung tshul mdzad/ dpal ldan rdo rje gsungs nas lcags mo'i pang par byon/ bya bral gyi lag pa la 'jus nas mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad/ gzhan yang sngar gyi slob ma rnying pa phal cher 'ga'i ming gsungs shing ngos bzung mdzad pas/

thams cad sngon gyi dus dran pas yid mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos/ dad pa'i yus kyis ngus shing brgyal bar gyur to/ /zla ngo lnga bzhes pa snye bo'i ga gor khar bzhugs pa'i dus/ sku mdun der kha cig tho co 'dra byas pas/ zhal nas/ a ham̐ bde stong sgyu ma'i rtsal// sna tshogs ye shes rol pa la// byis pa rnams kyis bden par mthong*// nga ni skye 'gag gnas dang bral// ces gsungs/ de nas zla ba dgu bzhes pa na/ go'i shrī rin po che mjal bar/ sku gzi brjid kyi dpal 'bar zhing*/ rab tu mnyes par mdzad cing byin rlabs gnang ba dang*/ phyag rten rnams phyag tu rim par bzhes/ sgar dung ngos bzung mdzad/ rje gong ma'i dbu zhwa phul ba mnabs shing*/ rdo rje dril bu phyag gis bsnams nas/ pad kor dril stabs mdzad/ thugs dam mgon sku ngos 'dzin kyang gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab par dgongs te rang byung kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal por mtshan gsol/ sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan chen por seng ge'i khrir bzhugs/ zla ngo bcu gcig bzhes pa na/ nags phu bas spyan drangs nags mdar khrom tshogs la ā li kā li gsungs/ phag lo sar nas mdo chen du bzhugs pa na nga rdo rje 'chang yin gsungs/ gcig gi sngos yig phul bas dga' ldan du skye bar gyur cig gsungs/ yang gzhan gyis co 'dri zhus pa na/ the tshom mi dgos bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal la ltos/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis phrin las bsgrub cing yod/ sa ra ha birba pa ku ku ri pa gsum nam mkhar bzhugs/ 'di gsum gyi rnam thar 'dzin mi nga yin gsungs nas phyag mdzub nam mkhar gtad/ yum gyis kyang de rnams kyi zhal mjal/ mdo chen phuu na gcod la 'byon gsungs/ gcod ji ltar byed zhus pas sems nyid rtsad nas gcod pa yin gsungs rtsad nas ji ltar gcod zhus pas sgom gyis gsungs/ mi shes zhus pas nam mkhar phyag mdzub gtad de mtha' dbus med pa zhig yin gsungs/

yang mdo chen gyi bla ye na yum sras bzhugs dus/ mi la ras pas mgur ma 'then shing yod e mthong gsungs/ long por spyan drangs/ thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ byi ba'i lo la spug ngo bor bzhugs pa'i dus/ rta mgrin mtshon cha 'khor lor sprul pa yum gyis gzigs/ 'di 'dra mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ bgegs btul ba yin/ su la'ang ma bshad gsungs/ tshes bcu'i dus cig nga karma pa ni 'gro ba 'dren gsungs nas gar mdzad de/ de ma thag sku lus mi snang bar mdzad ste yang lam gyis byon/ yum sras bla ye na bzhugs dus yum la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang dang mi la seng ge la chibs pa nam mkha' la yod gsungs/ drung nas kyang phyag dang mgur gyi lad mo mdzad/ 'khrul 'khor mdzad cing yum la ngas khyod kyi lto bar 'di ltar byas pas khyod kyi hub bo ba yin gsungs/ yig drug dang ā li kā li gsung zhing khyod kyi khong nas 'di skad smras pa thos sam gsungs/ dpal ldan rdo rje dang bya bral gnyis la 'di bzhin gyis gsungs nas 'khrul 'khor gnang*/ bla ma yab la ltos dang*/ shar phyogs na slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi g.yas su mi la ras pa g.yon na ye shes mtsho rgyal dang gsum bzhugs pa e mthong*/ yang yud tsam na yar bzhengs nas lho phyogs na ltos dang*/ sa ra ha pas mda' bsrang tshul mdzad 'dug pa e mthong*/ de bzhin nub phyogs na mi la ras chen gyis mgur 'then zhing yod/ byang phyogs na pha dam pa bal thul mnabs nas bzhugs 'dug 'di rnams kho bo yin gsungs/ yang tsā ri'i mkha' 'gro ma thams cad tshogs 'khor zhu ba la byung gsungs/ tsā ri'i ri pa rnams mjal du byung ba'i tshe/ tsā ri la 'gro gsungs yum gyis tsā ri la 'gro ba'i dgos ched ji lags zhus pas/ gang zag byin gyis rlobs nus pa'i gnas yin/ gnas sgo yang phye rgyu yod/ tsā ri'i gdul bya kho bos skyong*/ kho bo'i bar chad gnas kyis sel gsungs/

yang slob bu zhig gis mjal ma thag a bla gsungs te ngos bzung*/ drung mthong ba don ldan pas ming gnang ba zhig yod zhus pas bkra shis yin gsungs/ gsa' phu gang na yod zhus pas/ ya gi gsa' phu yin gsungs phyag mdzub gtad/ pha ri sham po'i ri yin gsungs/ der sprin gyi steng na ber can gzigs/ gsa' phu na kho bo'i mchod rten yod pas mgyogs par rta rgyug nas 'gro gsungs/ der phebs tsa drung gong ma'i gzim gur bshams yod pa'i nang du phebs nas nga'i yin gsungs shing*/ gsol lcog steng 'og can rgyus med kyis mi shes pa cig yod pa drung du bzhag pa na/ steng ma de yar khyog gsungs/ thang sku ma ṇi ma'i gong sham can zhig la gzigs nas/ mthong ba don ldan dang 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs rnams nga yin/ 'di sgrol ma 'di phyag drug par 'dug gsungs shing ljags klog ma phul ba'i skabs yin rung*/ ma ṇi rnams la phyag mdzub btsugs te dbyangs snyan pos rim par gsungs/ de nas stag rtser phebs nas/ shākya thub pa dang*/ rang byung ba'i sku ngos bzung*/ der dge 'dun pa dang skye bo khri phrag tsam 'dus pa la zhal bstan/ ma ṇi pad dbyangs gsungs nas thams cad dad cing dang ba 'dren par mdzad/ der jo bzang bsam gtan mjal ba'i dus su/ drung nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mar zhal gzigs/ slar gsa' phur phebs nas/ dpon ma ṇi sgrongs/ kho bo spyan ras gzigs yin/ 'khor ba 'dren oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ gsungs nas dbyangs mdzad/ yang bzhengs nas kho bo mar pa lo tsā yin gsungs/ de nyid du bzhugs khri'i steng du ne'u le bzung mi 'di su yin gsungs/ nged chos mi shes zhus pas/ rnam thos sras yin gsungs/ rgyal po a nyag la ming nas bos te phyag nas mang du gnang bas yid ches/ rnam thos ri bor sgo rnams phye gsungs nas mdzod nag sogs la gzigs rtog mdzad/ sngon 'di ltar yin gyi gsung mol mdzad cing*/ drung gong ma'i thugs dam thang sku rta mgrin nag po gu ru zhi drag sogs ngos bzung*/

spyir thugs rje chen po dang rje mar mi gnyis rnams yang yang gzigs shing de gsum nyid yin par zhal gyis bzhes/ rgan mo blo bde'i bu brgyud rnams ja 'dren la byung tshe yon bdag lhun grub dang rgan gog gnyis la ming nas bos yar shog gsungs nas gsol ras gnang bas shin tu dad pa thob/ der mar me'i snum zad pa la chu ting phor gang phyag gis blugs pas sngon pas ches gsal zhing yun ring bar thub/ sgar pa dbus na yod pa rnams nyang kha nas yong rtsis byed pa la de nas mi 'ong*/ dwags po nas 'ong gsungs te sgar dpon rnams pa mor mjal/ de rnams su'ang yi dam chos skyong gi gzigs snang shin tu mang zhing de dag nyid la thim pa dang thang sku la thim pa sogs mang du gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bzhi bzhes nas ba yor bzhugs dus/ slob dpon padma rta mgrin sogs lan mang zhal gzigs/ lan cig cho 'phrul chen po byung ba la slob dpon padma dang*/ rta mgrin nag po/ ber nag can rnams kyis bar chad bsal ba yin gsungs/ ber nag can zhal gzigs nas rtse bla sgang du thal gsungs/ yang rta mgrin sngon po dang*/ rta mgrin lha lnga 'khor pu shud kyi mgo can dang bcas zhal gzigs/ lha tshogs rnams thugs dam thang sku la thim yong gsungs/ tsā rir byon dus bkra shis ljongs su thog mar gzim khang du phebs grabs byas kyang*/ 'di la 'gro gsungs nas drung gong ma'i bzhugs khrir byon te/ 'di nga rang gi khri yin gsungs/ nyin gcig chu rong lam bgrod dka' ba zhig la mgyogs par bzhud pa'i zhabs phyir rgyug pa na/ der gnas kyi sgo phye ba ni rta mgrin rang byon sku mdog zhal phyag tha dad pa rta mgo gnyis pa dang gsum pa sogs ches mang ba rta mgrin gling gi sgo phye/ rta mgrin rigs bsdus kyi lha tshogs thams cad nam mkha'i khams gang bar zhal gzigs nas rta mgrin gyi pho brang du phyin/ thams cad kyis sngags thon gsungs nas/

sngags gsungs/ tshogs 'khor sogs mdzad/ sngar rje gong mas rta mgrin rigs thams cad pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug /byin legs su mkha' 'gros bdud rtsi drangs shing gnas sgo du ma phye yod par lung bstan/ rtsi mal khar chibs thog tu gzims yur ban 'phrang ngan pas chibs 'dred mchi zhus pas gzims sad nas slob dpon padma gar yod gsungs/ mi shes 'phrang ngan 'di 'drar thugs sgrim zhus pas slob dpon padma nga rang yin pas chog /'phrang ngan yang skyon mi 'ong gsungs/ zla gcig tshun la 'bul ba sogs 'di 'dra 'ong gsungs pa thams cad thog tu babs/ rkyen dgon sar gyi gzim khang gzigs ma thag drung rang byung ba'i gzim khang yin gsungs/ tsā ri rnying ma'i phyag chen pa gcig gis drung gi sku lan gnyis su yal zhing yang gsal lam lam byon pas lus la rtag 'dzin ma che gsungs par 'dug bsam nas nyams rtogs bzang po skyes/ 'di dag tu gnas bzang ba'i rten 'brel gyis rta mgrin nyid la thim pa sogs gzigs snang mtha' yas shing*/ zhing skyong spyan sngar byung ba bla ma bsam gtan la bstan pas khong gis kyang mthong*/ mi nag po rwa co can zhig byung gsungs nas rta mgrin gyi skur bzhengs te drag sngags kyis tshar bcad/ blo gros bzang po la sngon nas 'di 'drar ngas gar dang phyag rgya bslabs pa de gyis dang gsungs/ sngon rje gong mas go'i shrī rin po che la bstan pa gtad pa'i rten 'brel gyis khyod kyis chos lung phul zhig gsungs/ sngon du tshe dpag med dang yig drug dgos gsungs ste dgung lo lnga pa sa stag gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor yod pa'i nyin tshe dpag med phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang dang gtor ma'i byin rlabs/ yig drug /yi ge'i phyi mo rgya bod kyi dbyangs gsal rnams phul bas/ rdor dril bum pa sogs 'dzin lugs dbang gi rnam gzhag dpag dka' ba mang du gsungs/

ri mi dgon bya ba de rje dwags po rin po ches lung bstan mdzad pa'i sku 'bum rje de nyid kyi tshems ring bsrel gyi snying po can bzhugs pa'i gnas su phebs nas/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig nas brtsam ste bde mchog lha bcu gsum pa phul ba'i tshe/ rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba shin tu lci ba zhig phyag tu phul yod pa dkyil 'khor dang drung bzhugs pa'i bar thag ring bar yod kyang de nyid nas dor ba gtso bo'i tshom bu'i steng du dal bus bzhag pa ltar gyur te tshom bu la cung zad kyang ma gnod pa'i ngo mtshar bstan/ ma hā mā ya'i dbang phul tshe de nyid gzigs te de'i bzhugs stangs mdzad nas khyed tsho 'di mi ston gsungs/ rjes gnang zhig gi tshe gar mdzad dgos zhus pas/ bzhengs nas stang stabs dang pad kor zhig mdzad/ sngar ngas khang dmar/ zur mang*/ karma rnams su byas pa de yin/ de dus nged chen po yin/ da nged chung ngu red zin pas mi shes pa gda'o gsungs/ der than pa chen po byung bas char 'bebs par zhus pas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs kyis da lta nyid du char phobs shig gsungs pas de dgong nas bzung char cher bab ste/ bden tshig grub par skye bo kun yang yid ches/ sgar 'degs dus char che yang de ring ba yor ma sleb bar mi 'babs par byed gsungs pas de bzhin du byung*/ kar dbon dbuu sar 'gro dus si tu pa la zhal ta cig zhu zhus pas/ khong la go chod par gyis smros zhal ta de yin gsungs/ stag lo zla ba drug pa'i skabs na bya bral zur mang ba zhwa khra can ag tshoms dmar po yod pa des karma pa mkhyen zer nas 'chi bde smon lam byed gsungs shing bsngo ba mdzad/ phyis zla ba bcu pa la de'i bsngo rten 'bul mi byung ba ji skad gsungs pa'i dus der lho lam khra sgo'i sar shi bar 'dug /sngar bla ma hor gyi rnam shes gzigs pa dang blo gros bzang po'i ma bde ba can du bkod pa sogs bar do'i don mdzad pa ni ches mang*/

phrag yul du bzhugs skabs/ sngar rje rang byung bas btul ba'i kla klo'i rgyal brgyud sogs kla klo mang pos/ grags pa'i rnga chen thos te mjal du 'ong nas rang yul gyi yo byad mang du phul/ karma pa karma pa zer nas dad pa rang shugs kyis skyes te de rnams dge bar bkod/ gter ston ratna gling pas gter nas bton pa'i dam rdzas rje nyid kyi lung bstan dang bcas pa der phul/ kong btsun de mo'i thang du yos lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ kong btsun de mos ja 'dren phul zhing spyan 'dren par gzigs te chibs kha bskyod/ stag khrom ri khrod du bzhugs tshe kho bo la sprul pa/ spyir rgya bod kun na mang du yod/ bye brag bu rang du shākya bya ba dang*/ shambha lar rgyal po/ kha che khri brtan du nya pa'i tshul gyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa sogs dpag tu med pa cig yod gsungs/ lo de'i nag pa'i bco lngar dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs gsan/ nyi shu la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gsan/ spyir mda' 'phen stangs kyis thabs shes kyi mda' gzhu ste nga sa ra ha dang grub thob brgyad cu las 'di dang 'di'i bzhugs stangs so gsungs shing kho bo de rnams yin gsungs/ rta mgrin nag po byon gsungs nas ral gri 'bul tshul mdzad pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs zhi khro'i rigs mang po dang*/ yaksha me dpal gnod sbyin lcags ral can mon pa bdun/ ber nag can sprin las dbu thon pa/ rta mgrin nag pos sde brgyad zhabs kyis mnan pa dang*/ rta mgrin 'brug la chibs pa slob dpon padma gtso 'khor lnga sogs 'di skabs rnams su'ang zhal gzigs 'byams klas so// thugs dam rten sgom bzhi drung du gdan drangs pa na gandho la'i sgo phye gsungs nas gang lags zhus pa 'di gsungs te phye/ de nas grub chen pagshi la byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi sku gzigs su phul nas su la byon pa lags zhus pas/ karma pa min pa 'di lta su la 'byon gsungs/

'di 'dra'i zhal ta mngon mkhyen mdzad pa ni brjod kyis mi langs na re re nas brir langs pa lta ci zhig /snyan phu'i bla ma sangs rgyas dpal la rdzogs chen gyi ngo sprod mdzad de/ phyag g.yon pas sil snyan gyi lung bsnams/ g.yas pas de'i mtha' bskor te 'di la 'khor ba zo khyun gyi dpe yin sogs/ ngo sprod rim par gnang*/ g.yang kha steng du nyi zhur phra mor yi dam dpag med gzigs/ kong lung ral gsum gyi char sogs dang*/ klo mon dang bcas 'thab rtsod dang sdig zas kyis 'tsho ba rnams la gang 'dul gyi chos dang*/ ma ṇi dung phyur gzungs sngags 'don pa/ ri rgya/ klung rgya/ lam rgya/ tshe thar srog sdom sogs la bkod/ sha btson sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rnams bton/ 'khrug rtsod rnams bsdums te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis kar bde bar mdzad/ mang zhig de nyid du smin grol la bkod do// do nas 'brug lo'i lo gsar g.yang kha steng du mdzad/ sbrul lo'i gsar bzhad rdzong gsar du mdzad skabs/ bka' brgyud bla ma kun dang*/ sprin gseb tu sku stod thon pa'i rta mgrin nag po ye shes kyi khyung kha dog sna tshogs gzigs/ lho'i dbang lha 'od phrom sbrul gyis brgyan pa'i mgo thog tu rje na rim/ mgo'i g.yas g.yon du slob dpon padma dang*/ rta mgrin mjug mar nyi ma dang zla ba/ zur du khyung tho dge bsnyen rnams ky-is phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ rta mgrin dang yagsha me dpal sogs kyis 'byung po gzir ba dang*/ yang dpal dus mkhyen dang*/ thub chen shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma/ dpal mgon po ber can rnams zhal gzigs/ skabs shig /rang byung padma chu zla bzhin sogs sho lo ka gcig thol gyis gsungs pa'i don yang rgya cher dkrol ba bcas gnang*/ yang dgyes pa rdo rje sogs yi dam khro chags zhi ba'i lha 'byams su klas pa dang*/ khyad par sgrol ma gzigs nas/ khyod ni bdud rtsi dam pa ste zhes sogs kyis bstod pa dang*/

mi la'i dbu thog tu gdugs rang 'khor gyi phyir rdo rje'i gur phyi nang sgrib g.yogs med pa nyi zlas brgyan pa lañtsa'i yig drug gis gtams pa gzigs te/ byar med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis bstod pa dang*/ yang bka' bzhi pa rin chen bzang po la ras pa bcus bskor ba gzigs/ bkra shis tshe ring mas bum pa dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba drangs/ gser yig nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus su mi la bzhugs pa sogs gzhan yang gz-igs snang mtha' yas/ zla ba drug par gdan bteg tar ti nas dpal 'bar dgon sogs su byon skabs/ gser gyi padma la phag mo lha lnga bzhugs pa dang*/ khrag mtsho las padma dmar por lha mo rang byung ma gtso 'khor thams cad dmar mo kho nar zhal gzigs/ rgyal ba g.yung dang tshe bdag gzigs pa na/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma mchog sogs kyi bstod pa dang*/ dgu gtor gyi skabs shig mgon po zhal gzigs pa na/ rgyal ba'i bka' srung mgon po yang dag mchog zhes sogs bstod bskul kyang mdzad/ yang pad sdong dmar po 'dab ma sngon po can du/ zla dkyil la sgrol ma dkar ljang so sor bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gnyis dang bcas gzigs tshe/ sgrol ma dbyings nyid bde chen rol pa'i mchog / zhes sogs gsungs par mdzad/ dpal 'bar sde dgon bcas phul te/ der gtsug lag khang gi logs bris ngo mtshar ba'i zhal bkod sogs mdzad nas/ rngod du phebs/ a rig thang sogs su gzigs snang ni mtha' yas/ tang lar sa ra ha gzig lpags la bzhugs pa gcig gzigs te/ ye shes lhun grub bde chen rol pa'i dbyings/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ brgyad gshongs 'khor chen du go'i shrī rin po che la/ sdug bsngal chos kyi dbyings su dag/ stong nyid ye shes dbyer med la// ma 'gags sna tshogs rol pa'i rtsal// rang byung nga yi rnam thar yin// zhes don gyi rnam thar kyang gsungs/ re rgyab sgang du dgu gtor dus mgon po zhal gzigs/

der gsol dpon tshe'i dus byed pa'i tshe/ zhal nas snying re rje/ snang srid thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin ste/ /zhes sogs kyis ngo sprod mdzad/ gnas de nyid du/ gter ston ratna gling pas gter nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe ril dang*/ rje nyid kyi lung bstan phul ba ni/ rta mgrin gyi shog ser las/ las can chos kyi bdag po lnga// mchog gi bu lnga bstan pa ni// rgyal sras dharma kirti yi// lung bstan rgyas par gzhan du bstan// gal te rten 'brel ma 'grig na// de 'og phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe// khams kyi char gtogs nub kyi phyogs// ri bo mkha' lding 'dra ba'i zhol// padma nga yi rnam sprul te// byang sems khyi yi lo pa gcig/ rang byung mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes// sa la gnas pa'i byang sems 'byung*// ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs nyid// sngon gyi bag chags sad du 'ong*// gsung gi mtshan ma dag dang ldan// snying thig gsang 'dus skor bzhi dang*// khyad par rta mgrin gsang 'dus bdag/ ma 'ongs phyi ma dus mtha'i bar// rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thug pa yi// de yis bstan pa dar bar byed// chos zab bdud kyi 'phrang dam pas// 'di yang rten 'brel zhib tu sgrigs// shes pa 'di rta mgrin nag po'i shog ser na snang ngo*/ /zhes bya ba sbrul lo zla ba dgu pa'i yar tshes la sku mdun du 'bul du byung ngo*// gnas der rje dus gsum mkhyen pa zhal gzigs nas bzhugs pa'i rje nyid kyis mdun du lho'i dbang lha 'od phrom cha lugs srin po ltar byas te byung bar gtor ma slong bar gzigs te gnang*/ khra tshang gong du/ rdo rje 'chang dang rta mgrin dus mkhyen gsum gzigs tshe/ rta mgrin gyi zhal nas bdag gis nad yams bar chad zlog /zhes gsungs shing sku'i rnam 'gyur rngam rngam gtsigs gtsigs mdzad pa na rdo rje 'chang dang dus mkhyen shin tu mnyes par 'dug gsungs/ der phyag drug mgon dkar gzigs/ lung bzang nyi ma thang du dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gzigs/

der g.yas pa lha rjes mjal ma thag sngar sman dpyad phul tshul sogs gsungs pas nges shes cher skyes so// de nyid du sbrul lo zla ba dgu pa'i nyi shu lnga'i dus mchod kyi tshe/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs zhal gzigs nas/ na mo gu ru/ ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /sogs kyi gsol 'debs kyang zhus ngor mdzad/ yang de nyid du ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ gzhan yang zla dkyil la rdo rje 'chang sogs zhal gzigs brjod las 'das shing*/ de skabs mgon po zhal gzigs dus/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rab gtum pa sogs bstod bskul dang*/ lha mo la ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro mgon skyobs pa rnams kyi bka' bzhin du/ /sogs kyi bstod bskul mdzad/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams zhal gzigs tshe/ ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du sogs gsol 'debs mdzad/ de nyid du rgyud 'bum lung tshang ma gsan/ bdag ni skye ba sprul pas 'gro don 'grub/ /sogs gsungs/ gsung rab la phyag nas 'thor ba zug /dgu gtor dus mgon po sogs zhal gziḍa/ der rta lo gsar bzhad mdzad nas nag shod du byon/ nag shod klo zam dang*/ bkra shis steng rnams su/ sgrol ma dang*/ rdo rje 'chang sogs zhal gzigs 'byams klas par/ slob dpon padma rang byung kun mkhyen yin sogs/ tshigs bcad du ma dang*/ rta mgrin dpa' bo lha bzhi'i mngon rtogs mdzad/ sog gi bkra shis steng du bcu gcig zhal gyi sku la phyag nas zug /der bla ma rin po che ban sgar bas thog mar mjal/ tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan phul ba la/ da dung slob dpon padma'i sku yod 'dug pa'ang phul dgos gsungs par dad gus bla lhag tu skyes/ der yang sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du gnas pa dang*/ 'gro la phan bde 'byung ba'i sgo rlabs chen dang gzhan yang*/ sog gi zam chen dang*/ lcags zam gyi zhal bkos/ tsan dan dgon sogs de phyogs kyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi 'chad nyan dang*/

sgrub mchod 'dzug pa sogs dgon sder chos kyi bca' khrims dang*/ yul sder/ ri rgya klung rgya/ tshe thar ma ṇi dung phyur sogs dge bskul rgya chen/ thams cad la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas gnas skabs mthar thug kun du dge bar mdzad nas/ rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i yar tshes nas karma phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ mi nyag rab sgang ba'i ja 'dren gyi 'bul chen dang gdan 'dren zhus/ 'brug lung mdor/ rnam sras yab yum zhal gzigs/ spyi stod bzhi mdor karma si tu dpon slob brgya lhag ja 'dren la phebs dus/ bstan pa'i bdag po zhal gzigs/ lci'i zam khar me tog gi char babs/ nang ya gnyis sogs phyogs kyi sde ris thams cad kyis mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i bsnyen bkur zhus/ nang chen tshang gsar gnyis sogs 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi bar mdzad nas dkar po'i dge bar bkod do// karmar phebs kar gzhi bdag rgyal chen dpal ldan shes rab la/ khyod kyis sang sgar pa karmar 'gro bar char ma btang gsungs te bka' bsgos/ rta lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la karmar phebs/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu bzhi byang chub 'grub skar du grags pa pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor nyin gandho la'i drung du go'i shrī rin po ches dge bsnyen yongs rdzogs dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa phul ba'i tshe/ me tog gi char babs/ phyogs thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis yongs su gang zhing*/ der bstan pa'i gtso bo zhal gzigs te/ kun mkhyen ldem bag thob pa yi/ /bcas sogs kyi bstod pa mdzad/ de'i nyin 'jam dpal bzang po la thog mar tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang gsan pas zhal gziḍa te/ ye shes 'gro ba'i don skyobs pa/ zhes sogs gsungs/ gcod skor rnams phul ba'i tshe bslang tshad tshar tshad du ma dang nyid keng rus su snang ba dang slob dpon padmas gcod kyi man ngag mang du gsungs nas de rnams gter gnas 'di 'drar yod gsungs pa byung*/

bde ba can dang 'og min sogs gzigs te/ bde ba chen po'i gnas mchog dang*/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ yang slob dpon padmas gcod dang dpal chen po'i dbang bskur ba gzigs nas/ kun mkhyen thugs las rdol ba yi/ /ces sogs dang*/ yang*/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥlongs sku rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs nyid kyi rnam thar yang gsungs/ lug lo'i lo gsar karmar mdzad nas zur mang du phyags btegs/ der zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i khu bo dge bshes chos grags kyi nged kyi sprul sku 'di'i yin lugs gsung sgros gsal po gcig zhu zhus pas sprul sku nyid la zhal ta'i tshul du/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan drug pa seng ge sgra/ /ces sogs sngon dus dang*/ da lta'i tshul ma 'ongs pa'i zhal gdams bcas gsal bar gsungs/ rtsar gshis lhun grub dgon du phebs/ me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang*/ ri bong zhig byung bar gzungs sngags dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gsungs shing ja ma sum rgan yin/ 'di nas dga' ldan du skye gsungs/ gzhan yang rten bzang ngan sna tshogs pa'i lung bstan mang du mdzad/ tshems brjes pa na mche ba g.yas pa la āḥdakar po dang gzhan la mi la'i sku dang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil yi ge ha rnams dkar zhing gsal ba phyir ma 'bur ba me long la gzugs brnyan lta bur byon/ sde 'khrug rnams soḍa chos dang zang zing gis 'jaḍa par mdzad pa/ ban bon skye bo'i tshogs rnams phan bder bkod nas slar karmar phebs/ slob dpon padma yab yum la gsang sngags rnying ma'i lha tshogs dang*/ de'i g.yas su thub dbang la panṭita dang gsar ma'i lha tshogs/ g.yon du rdo rje 'chang la bka' brgyud bla mas bskor ba rnams ring du gzigs/ yang slob dpon padmas sbas lung mang po lung bstan mdzad/ tshes bcu'i tshe slob dpon padma sku che ba dang*/ sku shin tu chung ba dang*/ gzhan yang rdo rje ber can dam can/ sngags bdag sogs 'byams su klas par gzigs/

rtsi'i bya ngos tshang sar bas spyan drangs/ de nas skyo mda' dang bla ma bsod nams dpal gyis sa mdor spyan drangs nas so so'i dgon ma lag sde dang bcas phul zhing so so la chos kyi 'chad nyan dang bsko 'ja' sogs gnang*/ bya lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ tsha sgang dang ngom stod smad sogs su spyan drangs par phebs nas/ thams cad smin grol la bkod/ slar yang karmar phebs/ shing bya lo dgung lo bcu gnyis par sangs rgyas kyi dus chen la jo bo gandho la dang*/ siṅgha gling btul ba'i thub pa chu lon ma sogs kyi drung du kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang pos mkhan po dang*/ go'i shrī dpal 'byor don grub kyis las slob mdzad de/ rab tu byung bar mdzad la mtshan chos grags rgya mtsho dpal bzang por gsol zhing dge tshul gyi dngos po yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ mkhan po las 'dul ba'i mdo bstan bcos bslab bya rnams nyin bzhin du gsan par mdzad cing de phyin bslab bya phra mo 'ang khyad du mi gsod pa dgra bcom pa'i ngang tshul du bzhugs so//

de nas gnas sgo ba sogs pu 'bor ba rnams dang kre kaṃ khyim phrin las kyi gdan sa pa dang*/ lcags mo kre po sogs shar rma rdza sgang pa rnams dang*/ dar mdo'i mi chen mi nyag sogs kyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyis snga phyir gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ bya lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la karma nas gdan bteg tshe sa cung zad g.yos/ rje mthong ba don ldan la bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyis bskor ste/ re re'i sprul pa mtha' yas pa ston par gzigs pas phrin las gnad du 'gro bar mkhyen cing phebs/ gling gi nang rme 'khrug rtsod sogs bsdum shing*/ dpon chen sar du bskos/ mnga' ris thams cad phan bder bkod/ de nas dben sa lha khang du ras bud mdzad tshe 'ja' dmar po'i nang nas bka' brgyud kyi bla mas ras pa rnams byin gyis rlobs par gzigs/ der phag lo sar/ shel khog stod smad du phebs/ ban bon gyi 'khrug pa sogs sde 'khrug chen po rnams gtan zhir mdzad/ skye bo btson dong na gnas pa rnams phyung ste bde bar mdzad/ gso ros bla ma kun rgyal pas rje nyid 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar yun ring du mjal bas nges shes tshad med thob/ gnas nang du nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang zhing thub dbang dang slob dpon padma sogs zhal gzigs te/ 'og min chos kyi pho brang nas/ sogs kyis gsol 'debs mdzad/ 'jam dpal bzang po rdo rje 'chang du gzigs nas gsol 'debs dang mgur mdzad/ nyag rong du byon/ ārya gling sogs par gzhan phan cher mdzad/ slob dpon padma zhal gzigs nas/ mtsho las skyes pa yid 'ong padma'i steng*/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa mdzad/ khrom spyi thog tu phebs/ kaḥthog pa sogs ban bon gyi 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhal ta gnang sbyin gyis zhi bar mdzad/ shug ring thang du gzigs snang dpag tu med par mgur gnang gzhan snang du me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od rtag tu 'khrig

/de nas rim par phebs shing*/ thong che dang tshe pa sogs kyi rtsod chen rnams bsdums/ rag khrom dang gser bkra shis lung du bzhugs nas de phyogs kyi dge 'dun mtha' yas pa la phyag chen dang chos drug gis smin grol mdzad/ der byi ba lo'i lo sar mdzad nas cho 'phrul gyi tshes bcur bcom ldan 'das ma rnam 'gyur sna tshogs mdzad pa zhal gzigs/ der sgom chen ye dpal gyis mjal bas 'gyu ba dbyings su dag ste brtan pa thob pas mos gus tshad med pa skyes/ 'dzi ga lha mo dar thang du chos rje gzhon nus sogs lha sde mi sde rnams kyis mchod cing phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi zhing btson rnams thar bar mdzad/ a mdo ba phur tsha nang so pe ri'i khri dpon khag gsum hor ser thang pa dang*/ ri pa'i dpon a nu rgyal/ bal dur bkra shis mgon sogs kyis snga phyir gdan 'dren nan zhus dang*/ 'dir yang gser dngul mu tig gos dar/ chibs brgya phrag lhag rnga mong sogs pheb zhu'i ja 'dren la phul nas/ drung pheb par zhu dang hor ser gyi a ram 'bul/ ban bon la ngan mi byed/ zhal ta gang gnang gi lo grangs can la phyi nang bar gsum du 'khrug rtsod mi byed par dam 'cha' ba'i nan zhus bskyar yang khad kyis phebs par zhal bzhes tsam las ma gnang*/ ma ṇi dung phyur tshe thar dpag med lo gcig phyi nang gar yang dmag 'khrug sogs mi byed pa'i dam bca' phul ma thag 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char gyi ngo mtshar chen po yang mthong bas de thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas sgo gsum gcig du 'dud par byas so// dar gyi snyan mo rir a byams rtogs ldan pa'i rtsod pa rnams dang*/ de nas mi nyag nas/ ri shong rnams su phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod thams cad bsdum/ sgo sdong gi shag shig lo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ jag phran lo gsum rkun ma rnams phul/ ngo ber ras bud dang glang lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ lha khang du phyi thag ring nas phyag nas mdzad pas rten gtso dang bcu gcig zhal la phyag nas mang du zug

/a ri dgon sogs su gzim gur la 'ja' ka ba lta bu zug cing me tog lang long du byung*/ ne bar du lha khang zhig la phyi nas phyag nas mdzad pas rten gtso'i mdzod spu dang mgrin pa dang thugs ka rnams su nas zug /mdzod spu'i nas de kha cig gis mthong kha cig gis mi mthong bar 'dug /ra ti'i mkhan slob dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byas tshe bka' brgyud kyi bla ma kun dang mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas gzigs/ 'gu thom chos grags kyis dar mdor spyan drangs tshe slob dpon bsod rtse sogs ser skya mang pos mdo smad kyi gzhi bdag thams cad kyis bsu bar dngos su mthong dngos su'ang nam mkha' la rol mo 'i sgra grags/ mi chen grags rgyal sogs dar mdo dang 'gu thom sogs kyi lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis mchod sprin mtha' yas pas mchod/ der slob dpon bsod rtses drung bstan pa'i bdag por mthong*/ yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas 'od sngon por byon te rdo rje 'chang du gyur par mthong*/ rgyal rong pa bla ma tshul khrims kyis thog mar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku ri rab tsam pa dang*/ gser gyi rdo rje 'ba' zhig gi khri la thub pa chen po bzhugs pa mthong ba de phyin khong la nyams snang gong du 'phel zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i bogs thon pa byung bas nges shes tshad med thob pa byung*/ gangs chu 'gram du chos gsungs par lcags zam pa'i mi chen gyis khang thog nas thos shing spyan ras gzigs nam mkha' gang ba zhig tu mthong de sogs gang zag las dag pa'i snang ngor 'khor lo bde mchog dang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rol pa cir yang shar zhing*/ gzhan yang khrom ser skya mang po snang tshul mthun par lha'i rol par mngon sum du shar ba sogs re re nas brir ma langs so// grong gi phyi rol rgyang ring nas phyag nas gnang ba mi chen gyi khang par phyin cing bstan gtso'i thugs kar zug /ril bu khang du yang mang du phyin/

la mo rtse bde chen steng du'ang rten la phyag nas zug pa mang zhing phyi nas 'thor ba gzim khang du phyin/ mdo nas nyin gcig lhag pa'i sa u ta dgon du phyag nas zhus pa mdo nyid nas gnang bas lha khang dang dgon du phyag nas mang du sleb pas dgon sde dang yul mi thams cad kyis slar yang mchod sprin cher byas shing chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ gtso bor thugs dam la bzhugs pa na ting 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyal po 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu la brtan pa thob/ thugs dam gyi lha thams cad zhal gzigs shing nyid dang tha mi dad par rtag tu gzigs/ bla ma gnyis la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bcos min du 'khrungs/ gdams ngag thams cad gnad du phog pas nyon mongs rang sar grol ba'i rtogs pa mnyam rjes dang bral ba brnyes so// rang grol mchod rten dang rdza bkra dgon sogs su byon/ de re rer yang phyag nas phyin zhing zug pa dang zhal gzigs dang 'ja' 'od sogs bgrang las 'das/ de nas mi nyag dang 'jang gi mtshams sgo ro yul du byon/ 'khrug chen rnams lo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ jag phran dang rkun ma lo gsum phul zhing thams cad bde bar bkod/ der ras bud dang sha yul du stag lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ gzhi bdag sngo gzi 'dzo dge bsnyen du bkod ste rdo rje bod khams skyong du ming btags/ skya kheng rma se sogs zhabs kyis bcags/ 'di thams cad du phyag nas phyin pa sogs ni mtha' yas/ dza landha rar bka' bzhi rma se sogs mkhas pa mi lnga'i chos grwa chen po rnams la chos 'khor bskor zhing chos khrims nyams pa rnams gsos te 'chad nyan grwa skor sogs snga srol bzang por bkod/ 'dru'i 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhi phyir phyags phebs te zhal ta gnang sbyin gyis zhi bar mdzad/ de ltar mi nyag gi yul rab stod tsha sgang sogs kyi char thams cad phan bde la bkod nas/ stag lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum nas bu 'bor phyogs su phyag btegs/

nyag rong pa sogs kyis lam khral rnams phul/ 'go log ma khrom sogs kyi 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhi bar mdzad/ dgon sar gyi lha khang gi phyi ring po nas phyag nas mdzad pas nang du phyin zhing thang sku dril ba rnams kyi nang du'ang mang du phyin/ nyi ma nyis 'gyur gyi ring bar thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub/ der ras bud dang yos lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ phyag nas zug pa'ang mang*/ bla ma thugs rje 'od zer gyis rje nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho byang sems mang pos bskor zhing lha'i bu mo me tog dkar dmar gyis thod bcings pa skra grol ba bzhis glu len pas mchod pa dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtshor lam lam du byung ba yang yang du mthong*/ nyag gre dpon pos 'jam dbyangs su mthong*/ zhig po sangs rgyas grags kyis rta mgrin du mthong*/ gzhan ban skye mang pos spyan ras gzigs dkar po mthong*/ khrom spyis kyang res dkar res dmar res ser ba sogs sna tshogs par snang zhing dad pa mi phyed par gyur/ 'dir yang hor se chen gyi gdung brgyud rgyal bu dbang po'i dbur/ ri thang gi dpon rnams dang*/ be ri khri dpon khag gsum sogs mang pos gdan zhu nan tan dang*/ gser dngul mu tig za 'og sogs bdog pa'i dngos po mang pos bsnyen bkur/ le thang sogs su spyan drangs par phyags phebs te/ phyi nang gi 'khrug chen rnams gtan zhir mdzad/ phyag nas rgyang ring du phyin pa dang zug pa mang*/ yos lo zla ba gsum par gdan sa gnas sgo'i ka ka ri phug tu phebs/ mkhan nang dge 'dun gyis bsu tshe ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang gzigs snang mang du byung*/ grub chen pakshi'i sgrub gnas rnams su phebs/ grub thob chen po'i sku 'dra gsung byon ma sogs la mchod pa cher mdzad/ phyag nas mang du zug /chos 'byung steng gi pha wang zhig la zhabs rjes drug /rga lo phug tu zhabs rjes drug rnams bzhag /chos khri sar kun gyis mthong bar zhabs gnyis ka'i rjes shin tu gsal bar bzhag

/rtogs ldan chos 'bum la rga lo phug gi lam du chibs pa lhun grub kyi zhabs rjes yod zer ba rmis pas nam langs pa na phyin te nyul bas gsal por mjal/ dus mkhyen yab sras kyi slob brgyud kyi grwa rgyun rnams gtsor gyur rong khag bzhi bum 'bor sgang che chung gi lha sde mi sde mtha' dag gi mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ chos 'khor rgya chen bskor nas ston pa gnyis pa lta bu'i phrin las byung*/ der grub thob nyag se'i skye ba grub chen chu 'phur bas mjal/ 'bul zhabs mtha' yas par mdzad/ khong gis 'bri chu'-i khar drung na rim rnams drug brtsegs su bzhugs pa gcig la gcig thim nas rje don ldan zhabs spyan ras gzigs su gyur cing slar rje 'di nyid du gyur par snang*/ dbra thog tu dang por bcu gcig zhal dang ci zhig na drung nyid du snang ba dang*/ baiḍūrya'i sa gzhir pad dmar la 'od dpag med dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs su gzigs tshul ches mang*/ de nas grub chen pa de bel phur bsam gtan gling du sgrub grwa btsugs te sgrub dpon du bskos par mdzad/ rdzong nag gi gnas gzigs/ 'bom nyag tu phebs/ khrom khri dpon gyis gtsos ban bon skya ser khri phrag smin grol mdzad/ spung ri sogs su phebs/ 'das log pa yon mchod kyis 'bul zhabs cher byas/ khong gis dang por drung nyid spyan ras gzigs 'khor ba dong sprug dmar por zhag mang dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dkar po bstan gtso res mos sogs mjal tshul ngo mtshar ba bgrangs las 'das/ spung rir phebs/ phyag nas mang du zug cing chu mig chu ngur phyag nas mdzad pas de ma thag cher 'phel/ chos su blo gzhol nges kyi bu slob mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mang po dbang khrid kyis rgyud smin par byas nas sgrub pa bar bzhag /grub chen pakshi'i dge bsnyen 'dam chen tso ri'i g.yu mtsho khar phebs/ sgrub sde mang zhig btsugs/ bar gang du chu mig chung ba la phyag nas mdzad pas cher 'phel/

'ba' thang du phebs/ 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhi bar mdzad/ smon bzang dka' bcu pa sogs kyis spyan drangs/ bde chen gling du'ang sgrub grwa btsugs/ re ne stong dpon sogs kyi ngor phebs nas thams cad smin grol la bkod/ bra ba bka' gdams pa'i sgrub gnas 'bo de dgon du phebs/ sgrub grwa btsugs/ mchog rab tu phebs te/ 'khrug rtsod rnams gzhil/ ras bud mdzad/ sgrub grwa btsugs/ ngo khro dang*/ sogs/ 'bri chu rgyud pa'i lha sde mi sde rnams smin par mdzad/ rtsad bar du sgrub sde btsugs/ sbyor sgang du 'brug lo'i gsar bzhad mdzad/ der sgo gsum shing rta tshogs gnyis lam du drangs/ /zhes sogs rang gi rnam thar rgyas par gsungs/ dge bsnyen rgyal 'bar gyi zhol grub chen pakshi'i chos khri byin rlabs can gyi khar dge 'dun ru gsum gyis spyan drangs/ phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi bar mdzad/ rma chu rgyud kyi lha sde mi sde rnams tshim par mdzad nas 'gro mgon ras chen gyi slob brgyud bcu gnyis skor bas tshem tsi dgon du spyan drangs/ yang dgon du sgrub grwa mdzad/ der phyag mchod mdzad pa na smon bzang dka' bcu pas drung gi phyag mthil du 'od gong dmar po 'od sna tshogs 'phro ba zhig mthong bas byin rlabs zhugs/ gnas sgor phebs/ dbra 'gru gnyis kyi 'khrug chen bsdum/ ka ka ri phug bsam 'grub gling du dbyar bzhugs bug sgo mdzad/ de'i tshe nyid kyi gsungs pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i sgrub pa ni yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin ste/ grub pa'i rten yul mchog tu gyur pa kam po ri khrod du bdag kyang dkon mchog la gus pa skyed cing yang dag 'jog dang kha ton la brtson par bgyis pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yod tan cung zad thob pa snyam mo/ /byang chub sems kyang skyes shing nyon mongs mgo bsnyams so/ /bdag med pa yang mngon sum du gyur ro//

gzhan yang yon tan mngon du bgyis te de lta na yang 'dod pa thams cad dge bas 'grub pas sems can gang 'dod pas phongs pa rnams dge ba'i chos 'ba' zhig la sbyar bar bya'o zhes gsungs/ de nas rong kha bzhi sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ 'brug lo zla ba dgu pa nas sgar bteg /a bzang nang so sogs de phyogs kyi lha sde mi sde khag mtha' dag gis gus pas mchod/ kha ba dkar por sgrub grwa mdzad/ sngags sde rnams kyis spyan drangs te byon/ khrid lcags rar ras 'bud dang sbrul lo'i lo sar mdzad/ der rang byung ba'i thugs dam phyag phreng rdog po btsugs pa las skyes pa'i bo dhi tse thams cad las ches bzang ba'ang yod 'dug /phyi nang gyi 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi bar mdzad/ rdor seng pa bkra chos kyis spyan drangs/ der dbus pa bla ma'i rmi lam du drung nas/ phyag rgya che la skye 'gag 'gro 'ong med// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog/ zhes gsungs/ de phyin chad mnyam rjes kyi dbye ba zad skad/ 'bul chen gyi tshe ngo mtshar gyi ltas sogs rab tu 'byams klas/ 'dob snar spyan drangs/ 'khrug rtsod rnams gzhil/ snar sor mchod rten la rab gnas tshe nam mkhar 'ja' 'od 'brug seng sogs kyi dbyibs sna tshogs pas khyab pa byung*/ rje dus mkhyen gyi sgrub gnas spang phug tu sku 'dra gsung 'byon la mchod/ der dbyar bzhugs mdzad zla ba gsum 'dag sbyar la bzhugs/ 'jang sa tham rgyal pos 'bul zhabs rgya cher sleb/ yang rgya nag nas gong ma chen po ching hwa'i lung gis dbu zhwa/ zhwa nag khyad par can dang*/ mu tig gi snam sbyar/ yol ba/ bla bres sogs mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang gser bre chen gos dar khri phrag sogs kyi 'bul ba bsnyen bkur rgya cher/ kon tīng go'i shrī bsod nams rgya mtsho dang*/ du gang bkra shis bzang po/ gsol ja ba 'od zer rgya mtsho/ nyi ma 'od zer rnams kyis phul zhing gong ma sku tshe chab srid brtan pa'i smon lam gyi rgyun mdzad/
thu 'bor sgang chen du phebs/ sa stod du dge 'dun dpag med la chos gsungs dus ngo mtshar gyi ltas shin tu mang*/

khang dkar dgon sar sogs su phebs/ de rnams su pu sti bsdams pa'i nang du'ang phyag nas phyin pa mang*/ gong du gser yig pa rnams brdzangs/ slar karma si tu pas zhus te zla ba bcu pa'i nang du karma'i phyogs la phyags bteg /mtsho khar phebs/ ras bud dang rta lo'i lo sar mdzad/ gzha' sar rnying gi 'khrug rtsod bsdums/ khrom khri dpon sogs dang kaḥthog pa yon mchod kyis dad pas mchod/ sgrul lce rnam rgyal steng sogs dang stag mgo byang chub gling rnams su byon/ der sgrub sde mdzad/ dri'i dzo lha nang du zhwa dmar bzhi pa dang gling tsan shin wang gis mjal dus ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang*/ shug ri thang du phebs/ chibs pa lhun grub 'das pa'i so la dung dkar mchin pa dang rus pa thams cad ring bsrel du song zhing*/ a dkar po mang du byon/ 'ja' 'od kyis thams cad khyab/ slar kre shod du phebs/ rje dus mkhyen gyi sgrub gnas lha mo phug tu lha mo'i pho brang thod pa skam rlon gyi gur dang bcas pa gzigs te bstod bskul mdzad/ gling tsan shin wang gis spyan drangs/ mched ya dang sras po phul/ bdag po'i thang sku la phyag nas mang du zug /gling bar tshang gi du si ting 'dzin ye shes kyis gdan drangs nas/ dbon po ting 'dzin 'od zer dang*/ ting 'dzin grags pa gnyis phyags phyir phul/ chos sde btab/ 'dan tsan thang lha khang sogs su byon/ khri dpon pas dbon rnam rgyal grags pa phul/ nyi ldan steng du chos sde btab/ mtsho gshis su mtshur phu rin po che gdan 'dren du phebs/ zur mang du phebs/ bde chen rtser sgrub sde mdzad/ ras bud dang lug lo'i lo sar mdzad nas karmar phebs/ dag 'byed sgang du dbyar bzhugs bug sgo mdzad/ mgon po ber can yang yang gzigs te shin tu khros pa gdong pa gsum pa ces pa'i zhal gzigs ltar gyi chags tshad dang bstod bskul mdzad/ spar khar phebs/ sgom sde nang ya gnyis kyi 'dun ma sogs 'di phyi'i don mdzad*/

sma ri dwags su bzhugs dus dgun sgang chen la me tog sdong po gcig la me tog kha bye ba bdun yod pa me tog re re yang ge sar ser po 'dab ma utpal ltar sngo ba bcu gsum re yod pa skyes te ngo mtshar du gyur/ lho rdzong sar sogs su phebs/ nang so grags rgyal sogs kyis mchod/ bla ma 'od bzang sogs kyis lha steng du spyan drangs/ der ras bud dang sprel lo'i lo sar mdzad/ kong po nas bla ma dpal 'byor dang yon bdag seng ges rtse lha sgang gi rten gsum nyams pa rnams gsos nas phyag nas gnang bar zhus pas/ sang nyi ma shar dros tsam la phyag nas mdzad par dus tshod bsgrig thog khrom chen po tshogs pa'i gseb tu 'bru sna tshogs pa char ltar babs/ nang gi rten rnams la mang du zug /lho stod dpal 'bar sogs zhabs kyis bcags/ so so'i lha khang gsar rnying la phyag nas zug/ de nas ri bo che/ ngom rnam rgyal sgang brgyud/ kar ti phug tu ras bud mdzad/ sab mdo sogs su phebs/ bya lo'i lo sar mdzad/ skyo mdar phebs/ sde dgon ma lag bcas phul dbus po sogs brgyud/ la sa mkhan po grags rgyal ba sogs kyis mchod/ gtsug lag gzhung gsum gyi skye bo rnams btul/ 'or rdu byams chen mjal zhing mchod pa cher mdzad/ la sa sogs kyis byams chen chos 'khor gyi dgon sde btab/ gzhon nu dpal bla mar bskos/ re ne rgyal dgon du phebs/ stong dpon sogs kyis mchod 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi/ der skyes rabs brgya rtsa'i don bsdus mdzad tshe me tog gi char cher byung*/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma rdzogs chen pa che chung gi slob brgyud dang chu rgyud pa sogs kyis gang steng du spyan drangs/ smar khams mdo drug pas drung mthong ba don ldan gyi phyag zhabs kyi rjes ngo mtshar can gzigs 'bul bar khyer te gzigs/ 'khrug rtsod rnams bsdums/ slar re ne nas rje dus mkhyen gyi yon tan gyi gdan sa 'phar dgon du phebs/

sku 'bum sogs mchod/ dngul dkar bkra shis phun tshogs kyi dgon pa btab ste brtson grus dpal bskos/ slob dpon padma'i sgrub gnas rdo rje gro lod du phebs/ dri bzang gis yul gang*/ 'bos di sogs rnams su byon/ 'khrug rtsod rnams gzhil/ rdzal sgang nyo le rgyal mo'i zhol du phebs/ kha ba dkar po'i gnas bstod mdzad/ rang byon las rgya bza' kong jos gsal bar bzhengs pa'i rnam snang nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa la mchod pa cher mdzad/ bra ba bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa 'du long dgon du phebs/ dgon pa gsar du yang mdzad ste smon bzang dka' bcu pa bskos/ gnas bstod kyang mdzad/ phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod rnams bsdums/ dmar gshis dpal 'bar dgon gser kha rnams su phebs/ 'bug rdzong nas phyag nas mdzad pas bka' bzhi pa'i lha khang dang tshong dpon tshul rgyan gyi lha khang du phyin/ karmar phebs te lha chen bzhengs/ rab gnas kyi dus ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag med byung*/ de ltar gtso bor mdo khams sgang drug chu bo chen po bzhi'i rgyud kyi bod chen ljongs spyi dang lho ngos sogs zhabs kyis bcags shing dgon sde dang gtsug lag khang nyams pa rnams gsos shing*/ sgrub sde dang chos grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang ba bcas rnams la dbang dang gdams ngag zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i khrid rim gyis dngos dang rgyud nas smin grol gyi lam du mdzad nas/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'chad nyan sgom sgrub 'dzugs pa sogs rgyal bstan rin po cher slar yang ston pa gnyis pa ltar mdzad cing yul phyogs de dang de rnams kyi skye dgu mtha' dag 'jang dang rgya hor phal cher sogs gang 'dul rnams thar pa'i sa bon grung por mdzad cing*/ de nas dbus phyogs su phyags bteg ste/ phebs lam 'dam du rgyal chen bco brgyad sdun bsur byung ba gzigs/ 'ba' rom pa chen po'i zhabs rjes sngon ma mthong ba dag gsal bar bstan/ 'dam gzhung du yor dgon 'debs pa'i rmang bzhag nyin dgun 'brug gi sgra dang me tog gi char byung*/

der sku mtshams la bzhugs pa na yang dgun char 'bab pa dang chos gsungs pa'i nyin zhig chos grwar nas kyi char mngon du 'bab pa byung*/ chu mig gsar du brdol/ de nas mtshur phur phebs te lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan sa g.yos kyis cung zad gnod pa'i zhig gso dang rab gnas mdzad tshe bstan pa'i bdag po dngos 'khor bcas thim par gzigs/ gong ma rgyal po'i gser yig pa chen shri du gang sogs kyis lung 'bul zhabs dpag med phul/ lha sar phyags bskyod de/ dge bo na khar sne'u rdzong pa sku mched dpon g.yog gis lha'i 'byor pa lta bus bsu ba dang bcas te lha sar phebs/ bco lnga'i nyin jo bo rin po cher mu tig gi snam sbyar jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje la snam sbyar gser ma sogs mchod sprin mtha' yas pa dang smon lam mdzad tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung*/ rim pas byang gi phyogs thang lha'i zhol du bzhugs/ chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ sneb lung dgon phul zhing rab gnas mdzad pas 'phel/ 'dam cog tse la kha nas gong du gser yig pa rnams mngags/ gnam mtsho'i do bskor mdzad ste der bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad gzigs/ ra sgreng du jo bo yab sras gzigs/ dgon pa gong gi gdan sa pas des dbang ba'i bskor lam yan chad phul ste bskos 'ja' gnang*/ yang dgon gyi sgrub sde mdzad/ ra sgreng gi bka' srung laṅka mgrin bcu gzigs/ jo mo gangs su phebs pas/ gangs dkar mas bsu bar gzigs/ 'brong bu dgon rnying du sngags pa cig gi thang sku la phyag nas gnang bas phyag nas la ring bsrel mang du byung*/ lha phu gangs rar phebs/ gser 'bum phug tu re zhig dben pa mdzad/ thar 'dod mang po smin grol du mdzad/ chos 'byung steng gi gnas sgo phyes/ yo cag mtsho sman sbrul gyis brgyan pas mchod/ rgya tshor spyan drangs te lha khang la phyag nas mdzad pas bar snang la phyag nas zla ba du mar chags/ thag ring po nas stag sna'i rdzong nang du phyag nas phyin/

'o yug tu rje zhwa dmar pa sogs tshogs pa rgya mtsho la mdo sde las brgya pa sogs gnang*/ za phu lung du gter lung rnams gzigs pa na gter dang gter bdag rnams ji ltar bar gzigs/ rdo ril chung ngu'i steng du chen po brtsegs pa cig dang brag la slob dpon padma'i sku rang byung sngon ma mthong ba bstan/ mtshur phur phebs/ mdo sngags bshad grwa btsugs te ngo khro rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal bla mar bskos/ 'bri khung pas nan zhus kyis khro ba khar phebs/ chos rje rin po che mched kyis gtsos mchod sprin dpag med mdzad/ bka' brgyud kyi chos skor mang du gnang bas thugs tshim/ khra ba kha dgon ma lag dkar leb rdzong bram sogs kyis zhus ste sgrub sde btsugs pa shin tu dar/ rong po dang mtha' bzhi sogs kyis rim par spyan drangs te/ byang rgyud cog tse la'i bar du phebs/ phyogs kyi gdan 'dren yang mang*/ der zhwa dmar pas sne gdong du gdan 'dren nan zhu'i 'bul nod rgya cher mdzad/ de nas lha sa nas rim brgyud kyis/ snye thang 'or du jo bo'i gsol lhung dang lung bstan sgrol ma gnyis gzigs tshe jo bo dang byang sems du ma byon/ 'u shang du khri ral yin pa'i sngon gnas dran/ spre zhing du rje mar pa'i gdung khang rin po che mjal ba na rje mar mi dang rngog pa yab sras rnams dngos su gzigs/ yar rgyab dpon chen rin bzang yab yum gyis lha'i bkod pa lta bus mdun bsus dol du spyan drangs shing byams gling pa dang lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs kyis mjal/ de nas sne'u gdong rtser pheb lam skyid bde phug tu spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po lugs gnyis kyi 'khor dang bcas pa 'khor los sgyur ba lta bu'i 'byor bas mdun bsu dang thab 'dzin la phebs/ zhabs la spyi bos gtugs pa'i dad pa gting phyin pa mdzad/ zla gcig lhag tsam sne'u gdong rtser bzhugs/ mdo sde du ma'i lung*/

chos drug gi khrid sogs kyis smin grol mdzad/ rtses dang du spyan drangs nyin 'ja' 'od dang me tog gis skye bo thams cad yid 'gyur/ tshogs chos su phyag chen lnga ldan gnang bas thams cad grol ba thob/ spyan snga rinapo che lugs gnyis kyi drung skor chen pos bskor ba stong phrag lhag pas zhabs skyel khra 'brug gi bar mdzad ste der gnas mjal ba na sngon rgyal blon gyi sngon gnas du ma dran/ 'phyang rgyas stag rtser phebs/ dgon ri bo bde chen nas phyag nas mdzad pa stag rtse'i rdzong nang du phebs/ de nas shambu'i gangs la re zhig dben pa mdzad/ yar stod pa dang bya pa gnyis kyi sde 'khrug chen po zhag gsum gyi nang du dums gtsang mdzad/ sde drug la sogs pa'i dge 'dun bsdus te/ 'chams sku dar ser gdugs rol gyis bsu ba'i bkod chen sa gzhi khebs pas sngun bsus te chos rgyal lhun por phebs/ zla phyed re la 'bul chen re dang*/ thog tha bar gsum du tshad las brgal ba'i 'bul chen gsum byas pa'i dang po la chos 'khor lhun po'i dgon sdes thog drangs g.ye rong dang mon shal mo tshun bya pa'i mnga' zhabs na gtogs tshad kyi dgon sde/ gnyal sde drug /byar chos sde lho ri smad lho brag mkhar chu lha khang sogs che phra thams cad yi ger btab ste lha sde thams cad phul/ bar pa la khri dpon pa'i sras chos rgyal nor bu dang bkra shis rnam rgyal sku mched dbu skra phul nas mnga' zhabs na yod do cog gi skye 'gro thams cad phul/ gsum par gzhis ka chos rgyal lhun pos gtsos nas shel mkhar rdzong chen/ yang rtse/ shar gzhis ka sogs khong rang dbang ba'i rdzong gzhis mnga' zhabs dang bcas pa phul/ 'di re re dang zla phyed kyi 'bul chen re re la'ang zang zing gi dngos spyad gzhan ni re re'ang khri rwa can gyis bsgrun du mi nus/ spyir khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas 'di ni rnam dpyod dang dad stobs che/

khyad par drung du bcos min du mi phyed dad pa thob ste rgyal srid blos khrol te phul nas smon lam dang bstod pa gsol 'debs kyang du ma mdzad/ sras che ba rwa lung rgyal dbang rje'i sku skyer mtshan chos kyi grags par gsol te go'i shrī'i las ka gnang*/ sgyer gyi zhal ngo dbon po phyogs las pa la bstan pa 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' lung dang karma phrin las pa'i mtshan gnang ste chos 'khor lhun po'i gdan sar bskos/ sngags kyi grwa tshang gnyis la dwags po rab 'byams pa dang*/ dus zhabs pa shākya dbang phyug /mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang gnyis la mkhas pa nam mkha' dpal bzang pa/ sde bdun rab 'byams dbang phyug rgyal mtshan pa gnyis bskos/ zab mo yang dag ri dang rdza dmar sogs su'ang sgrub sde mdzad/ dbyar bzhugs dbyar sar mdzad/ karma grwa tshang gi bshad grwa thog mar btsugs te mi nyag rab 'byams pa klog pa'i slob dpon du bskos/ rje btsun ma mnga' ris rgyal mos 'bul zhabs rgya cher zhus/ der 'chi med grub pa'i sku skye bstan par phan nus pa stag lung gi nyen skor du yod par lung bstan/ seb lung rje dwags po'i ngo mthong phug dang 'khrungs gnas su yang phebs/ de dag tu bla ma lha rje rtag tu gzigs/ ༈¿¿der rgya gar rdo rje gdan du ma hā bo dhi la zhal gser snyan dar sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas la bstod pa smon lam/ rdo rje gdan du sgo yig tu sbyor rgyu bcas rnams legs sbyar du bkod pa/ dzo gi 'chi med mgon po la bskur/ sngon rje dus mkhyen mon du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i sbyin bdag mon gyi rgyal brgyud pa mon/ tsang mi/ ka ra tsa/ rgya gar te de re re la khri skor re yod pa'i bdag po mon rgyal po mjal du sleb/ 'bul zhabs dpag med dang sras po gcig phul ste mon du dgon gnas 'debs par zhus/ gnas chen ngo mtshar rong gi sbyin bdag bgyid par byas te rdor 'dzin bskos pas gnas dar rgyas su gyur/

de ltar mdzad pa'i skor du lo gcig lhag par bzhugs/ 'gro don mtha' yas/ slar g.ye rong brgyud/ spyan snga rin po ches spyan drangs te yang 'on gyi phyogs nas phebs te/ yar chab gtsang po'i chu sgrol nyin spyan snga rin po che dpon slob stong phrag las lhag pa'i chibs rags sum rtsen gyi bkod pa lta bus sdun bsur phebs/ chu phan tshun du chibs rags phebs pa dus mnyam de dag lha mi'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos po gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin lhan cig pas phebs shing zangs ri mkhar dmar gyi gnas gzigs/ der ma gcig dang gcod yul bka' brgyud rnams bzhugs par gzigs/ the thel du phebs te rgyal po hu las phul ba'i 'phan chen sogs bshams/ spyan snga rin po cher thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa du ma dang brag cog pa rin bzang dang lhun bde rab 'byams pa sogs mkhan slob chos gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun thams cad dam chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ der dpal phag gru pa rtag tu gzigs/ mchod yon lhan cig bsam yas su phebs te slob dpon padma dang bo dhi sa twa dang rgyal blon byang sems kyi gzigs snang mtha' yas shing 'di thams cad du'ang 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi ltas kyis skye bo kun yid 'phrogs/ lhan cig mchims phur phebs/ spyir rje rang byung bas sngon der dben pa mdzad/ sgrub sde btsugs/ mkhas pa klong chen pa bskos pa las bla ma mkhas grub pa sogs sgrub sde'i rgyun mchims phu rnying mar grags pa 'di byung*/ 'on te de dag dus kyi brnyings dbang gis chos sgrub pa nyung ngur gyur pa gzigs te sgrub sde sar du mdzad/ mchims phu'i lung nang mchod gzhis su phul te mkhas grub dwags po gsung rab mang thos bla mar bskos/ sgrub sde gtsang zhing thugs dam smar ba zhig byung*/ bka' srung rig 'dzin ma dang rgod po ta ras sgrub pa ba gzhan du 'gror mi ster ba dang*/

sgrub sder gnod pa phra mor byas pa la'ang bka' 'chad cher btang bas bka' srung gi snyan grags cher byung*/ spyan snga rin po ches mi phyed pa'i dad pas gsol 'debs dang smon lam mdzad de phyir thegs/ 'phrang po seng ge sgang pas rdo rje brag rtsa'i dgon pa phul te bla mar bskos ja gnang*/ lha sar phebs/ chu shul lhun rtse'i sa skyong bas phyag nas zhus pa lha sa nas 'thor bas lhun rtse'i rdzong nang du phal cher sleb ste thum po byas nas ngo mtshar la phyogs kun tu bkye/ spyir rgyal ba byams pas lung bstan te jo bo shākya mu ni 'di nag grong gi dbus su bzhugs pa 'dis bstan pa spyi nyams/ khyad par bod du nyams shing mchog sprul la mi 'os pa'i rgyan gyi rten 'brel gyis bod 'ban btsun gyis gang ba yin/ jo bo'i sku 'khor du dge 'dun gtsang seng ba'i sde zhig grub na bstan pa sos bar 'gyur gsungs pa lan gsum du gsan pas de lta bu zhig thugs kyis dgongs kyang gzhis ka snel pa khong rang chags pa nas bzung drung na rim gsum gyi sbyin bdag yin rung gzhan dbang gis bka' ma sgrub pas bar skor gyi phyir dge 'dun bzhugs pa ni ma grub/

'on kyang byams pa'i bka' ma bcag pa tsam mdzad par dgongs nas karma grwa tshang gi bzhugs gnas su chos sde btab pa na skyes bu gsum las gang rung gi lam rgyud la skyes nges kyi dam pa 'ga' zung yang so so na yod par gdon mi za mod kyi de dag la ni sus kyang nyan par mi spyod/ snyigs dus kyi chos byed zer ba'i dge sbyong dang bram ze zang zing kho nar 'du zhing khyim la 'khren pa 'ba' zhig pa de dag gi yid bdud ris kyis mngon par dkrugs te rab byung gi rtags kyi phyi shun go mtshon ci snyed bsdus pas spras te g.yul shom par rtsom pa na/ dad ldan du mas 'di ltar la lan dang srung ba'i sta gon byed na sgar pa kho nar nyis stong du nye ba zhig 'dug par phyag mdzod du 'bul ba'i gri khrab kyi dos bshig na yang khengs 'dra bas ban dmag phyed dang lnga brgya tsam zhig lan gyis gzhil sla bas bka'i gnang ba zhus kyang*/ 'o skol su la yang gnod pa mi byed pa sangs rgyas kyi ring lugs pa yin phyir/ mtshams med kyi las kyis rgyal bstan la rma mi 'byin gyi khyod rang su yin yang nga yi 'khor yin na ni cog ge sdod cig gsungs te ji mi snyam par bzhugs/ nang par glo bur du ser dmag lnga brgya tsam bshams/ rmog med pa rnams lhung bzed mgor gyon/ rten khebs la mdung dar byas te 'ong*/ sa ra ba sogs kyi 'u lag mang du khrid te 'ong bas sgar pa sus kyang bka' las ma 'das shing g.yo 'gul ma byung bas sgar la gnod ma nus par/ chos sde mkhar las spyil bu re gnyis zin/ phal cher ma zin pa rnams bshig sreg byas/ 'di thos pa'i skye bo lha mi thams cad yid 'khrugs/ drung zhwa dmar pa'i sku 'khor lha 'bangs che shos rnams nas kyang 'di ltar btang snyoms su 'jog pa mi 'ong bas 'di'i khag khong rnams kho nas byed zhu ba dang*/ gzhan yang dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag dus dang*/ bya pa khri dpon sogs kyis bstan la tho mtsham pa 'dir mngon sum du nyes chad 'bebs dgos par gdon mi za bas nged rnams nas thal bar bgyid ces dang*/

kong po'i rgya bdag thams cad kyis dmag 'cha' bar zhu ba dang*/ sa skyong don yod pa dang*/ lcags mo 'od zer sogs kyis nged rang gi mnga' zhabs su 'di 'dra'i chos lugs gcig kyang mi 'jog pas gnang ba zhu ba bcas/ de thams cad la nged su la yang gang phan las gnod pa mi byed/ khyed grwa yon bdag gis kyang chos bzhin bstan pa ltar byas na nged kyi dgongs pa rdzogs/ nged la dmigs nas gzhan la gnod pa byas na nged kyi zhabs tog ma yin gsungs nas dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig pa'i bka' nan gyis yang yang bsdams pas/ kha cig legs so phul zhing dad pa bla lhag par skyes/ zhwa dmar pa'i sku 'khor phyogs rnams dang*/ bya pa khri dpon sogs nas khyed bstan pa'i bdag po rnams bstan pa mi srung na nged tsho la 'dra nyan chung zer ba'i thugs chad mtha' yas par mdzad/ phyis bya pa khri dpon gyis 'di thugs la gnag pa kho nas yar gong snel gsum dang srid bshig ste gtsang srid mdzad nas skyi shod du khri dmag gnyis gsum bteg pa'i tshe/ khong rnams ma bzod nas rje zhwa dmar pa la skyabs zhus kyang*/ drung nyid du zhus shig par bka' stsal/ drung rtse lha sgang du bzhugs pa der myur ba'i bo nya brtol ste/ bka' shog nan can mdzad pas khri dpon pas 'dir yang yi chad cher mdzad pa'i zhu yig snga phyi dang lo rgyus mang bar gda'/ phyi bltas rje zhwa dmar bas bskyabs pa ltar la ngo bo rjes nyid kyi thugs rjes skyobs pa ste/ byed pa po de dag gi lus srog longs spyod rten gnas dang bcas la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa stsal te/ dzambu gling gi skyes mchog ni/ nyes pa'i lan yang legs pas ldon/ zhes pa'i rnam thar mngon sum du bstan pa 'di la bsam kyin snying nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa mi skye ba su zhig/ de nas dbur stod kyi phyogs su phebs/ bdud ris kyi cho 'phrul phyogs bzhi nas 'byung ba rlung 'tshubs shing thog lhung ba sogs byung ba ting nge 'dzin gyi zil gyis mnan ste/

skad cig gis zhi/ 'bri khung lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis mchod/ gzhan yang phyogs kun nas dad 'dus kyi skye bo skal can khrom khri phrag lnga drug tshogs par mthong thos don ldan du mdzad cing*/ sgom pas kyang zhal mthong gsung thos kyis dad pa thob/ gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms pas nges shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ bde chen khyung dar du sgrub sde dang sngags rgyun btsugs/ phri khang pa yon mchod kyis mchod/ khre ba kha'i chos khri thang du sku mtshams mdzad tshe mgon po ber can dang dpal lha mos phrin las sgrub par gzigs/ 'bri khung dbang rin po che dang dbon sku mched gsum sogs kyis rgyang ring nas mdun bsus 'bri khung thel du phebs/ dbang gi las ka'i snam sbyar gser ma/ gos ta hung gi sham thams/ tsandana'i ka ba shubs bcas sogs 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ dbang rin po ches lha khang chen mo gsos nas lha chen sar bzhengs la rab gnas mdzad/ 'di skabs 'bri khung na bstan dgongs zab chos dang bcas pa'i chos dang phyag dpe'ang mi bzhugs shing nyams rmas pa'i skabs yin pas bstan pa gso dgos par dgongs/ tshogs chos su bstan snying gi bshad pa dang*/ rin po che khu dbon la zab chos ci rigs dang phyag chen chos drug gi khrid/ khyad par dbang rin po cher phyag chen gyi thugs dam bka' brgyud kyi grwal zin pa skyed par mdzad/ sgrub sde'i sa bon btab/ mkhan po'i bsko bzhag sogs bca' ba chos khrims kyang mdzad de 'bri khung pa'i bstan pa gzhi nas gsos pa lta bur mdzad/ der rje 'jig rten mgon po sogs rtag par gzigs/ rtag zher ru bas kyang spyan drangs/ ser mo pa mi bcom par khas blangs/ sha pho gsang du mi nyag gi ja pa mang pos 'bul zhabs cher byas/ 'dam gzhung du bla ma rin po che'i sku 'bum rtser gser 'phru btsugs/ yor dgon bca' ba chos khrims mdzad/ bra bo dgon pa phul/ der phag mo'i sgrub mchod btsugs/

stag lung phong mdor hor khang pa yab sras kyis spyan drangs te/ mkhan slob kyis gtsos dge 'dun thams cad kyis mchod sprin dpag med kyis mchod/ thor nad mang du yod par sgar phog kyang skyon ma byung bar nad yams kun chad/ kong po'i gdan 'dren snga phyi mang*/ khyad par rje nyid ma gtogs bsam rgyu med cing*/ kong lung kha lo sgyur nus pa sa skyong don rdor dang grogs por 'thams pa'i yon bdag chen po 'bro la hu res/ chos rje rin po che khyed 'jag gi sar byon pa yin na/ 'jag la be rgan gyi me yod/ nas rgan gyi chang yod/ phag rgan gyi sha yod/ ma byon na khyi rgan sgug yun ring na bshang ba grang thag chad zer ba de yong ba zer ba phul/ der khrims dpon rnams kyis bltas nas 'bul ma nus par zhu yig bshig nas phul pa kong po de sngar ma bcos pa zhig yod pa yin/ da 'gyur 'dug mi 'gro gsungs/ dngos de ka phul bas bzhad cing zhal bzhes mdzad klung shod nas nyang kha phyogs su phebs/ brag dkar lha chu zhes bya ba'i ri rdo rje phag mo'i sku rang byung duu gsal ba gsang ba chos 'byung gi rnam pa'i nang du rtsa gsum gsal zhing bdud rtsi'i chu nyin re la dus gsum du 'bab pa/ dbu ma'i nang du gyen du phyin pa na lte ba sprul 'khor sogs 'khor lo so so la lha mang du bzhugs pa/ spyi bo tshangs bug snyan spyan kyi phug dang bcas pa'i gnas sgo phye/ der zhabs rjes zhus pa na yod de 'ong brag logs la ltos dang gsungs pa bltas pa na brag mi'i lag gis mi sleb tsam pa'i ngos 'jam por zhabs rjes gsal zhing dod par mthong*/ 'on kyang da dung bdag rnams kyis mthong par zhabs rjes dgos zhus par/ 'o na 'di na phar la yi ge drug pa 'dug gsungs shing ma ṇi dbyangs gsung chung du mdzad bzhin pas phyag mdzub g.yas pas brag la ma reg tsam du bri ba ltar mdzad pa na bod yig gzab ma'i yi ge drug ma 'bur dod du khyur gyis byung*/

gnas der sgrub sde mdzad bla ma bskos/ der slob dpon padma lhag par du gzigs/ nag phur phebs/ der tshang sar bas phul ba'i chibs gwa pa zhig shig shi bas ring bsrel mang du byung*/ nags mdo'i gsal sgang du brag phug la phyag nas zhus pas brag la nas mang du thim zhing zug /brag gsum du phebs/ zho khar 'phan chen gzigs tshe 'ja' dang me tog gi char mtha' yas/ cung zad nyams pa phyis gso bar mdzad/ mi nyag rtogs ldan sogs kyis btab pa'i mdo chen dgon sogs zhabs kyis bcags/ brag gsum pa spyis bu khral mang du phul ste zho kha'i lha khang la brten chos sde rgya cher mdzad/ kong por rim par phebs/ so so'i ja 'dren sogs mtha' yas/ gsa' phur bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mtha' dag byon par gzigs/ se mo gnyan khrir go'i shri rin po che'i sprul sku dang*/ drung bkra shis don grub pas gtsos bla dpon rgya bdag thams cad kyis mdun bsu byas/ gyad tho skor gsum kong smad kar srid sogs thams cad 'dus te dga' ches pas so so 'chams bro la sogs pa'i gzigs 'bul dang mchod sprin mtha' yas/ khyad par g.yung drung 'dzin du sngon gyi rgan mo blo bde'i bu brgyud yon bdag 'bro la hu res rta bzang brgyas mgo drangs ba'i 'bul chen dang*/ gzhan dag gis kyang*/ rta bzang nyi shu sum cu sogs 'bul ba ni mtha' yas/ lkog phreng du sgrub sde btsugs/ rtse lha sgang du phebs/ der chibs khyud smug shib 'ja' gur gyis mi mthong ba tsam du btum/ me tog gi char bu yug ltar 'tshubs ring bsrel mang du byung*/ mdzod nag sogs gzigs lha khang gsar bzhengs du ma mdzad/ ༈¿¿der rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi seng khrir zhabs zung bkod pa/ 'phags pa'i yul thams cad kyi bstan pa'i bdag po dzam gling na zla med pa'i mahā paṇḍi ta chen po dpal ldan yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba'i rdo rje gdan pa chen po des/ rgya gar gyi rdo rje gdan dang ma ga dha la sogs par bstan pa spel bar phebs dgos pa'i spyan 'dren gyi zhu yig 'di ltar phul ste/

yatra shu bha bhau masthā ne sa ka la su ga ta ma ta byo ma manḍa lā laṃ kā ra// sha ra da mṛ ta du tsi sa ka' khim lakal dha wa li tā khil digmaṇḍa leṣu// zhes sogs phul ba zha lu lo tsā ba chen po dge slong chos skyong dpal bzang po dang*/ glo bo lo tsā ba dpal ldan grags pa dang bcas zhabs phyi'i khrod du bzhugs pas de bsgyur ba ni/ gang zhig dge ba'i sar gnas mtha' dag bde gshegs kyi// ring lugs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi ni rgyan gyur pa// ston ka'i zla ltar rab mdzes mtha' dag dri ma med// cha shas dkar pos ma lus phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// snyan grags 'byor pa gsal ba'i ga bur gyis gang ba// rab gsal mtshan bzang rin chen dpal ldan bla ma ni// lamba karma sho tse'i zhabs kyi padma la// byang chub chen po'i char gnas dpal ldan e raṇḍa'i// chu bo'i drung gnas mkhan chen dpal ldan yid kyi ni// shing rtas sa la spyi bos btud de lan brgyar 'dud// dpal ldan khyod kyi spyod yul 'di ni rgyal ba yi// yon tan gyi ni gzhir gyur rgya chen mtshan mnga' ba// skye bdun dngos por shes pa'i yon tan thob pa yis// bdag cag la sogs byang chub chen po'i char gnas pa'i// 'jig rten rnams ni dga' ba chen po skyes par gyur// dri med spyan gyis nges par gzigs shig thugs kyis kyang*// mtha' dag rnam par sems shig tshig kyang dbyangs kyis sgrogs// gang zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos las mtha' dag dri ma med// mtshan mnga' thub dbang yin slad de phyir khyod kyis ni// blta bar 'dod cing 'dod pa thams cad rab skong bar// bzhed pa gang yin de ni rnam pa thams cad du// de nyid dpal yon yin te de nyid nor ldan no// de nyid tshogs dang yon tan ldan pa'ang de nyid do// gang zhig gzhan don byed pa rang don rgyu gcig snying po mchog/ de phyir dpal ldan gzhan phan ro gcig kun mkhyen gyis// yon tan rin chen rab tu gsal phyir brtson bya 'os//

gzhan don byed pa med par byang chub yod min zhing*// byang chub don du gnyer ba med de gang gi phyir// bcom ldan sangs rgyas gzhan don nyid las rdzogs pa yi// byang chub gyur par kun du rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs// rnam pa gzhan gyi tshul dang rgyu la gnas pa yis// byang chub min zhing nam yang kun mkhyen lta ci smos// nag pa zla ba'i gza' lhag pa la// zhes byang chub shing gi lo ma mang po dang bcas pa dang*/ paṇḍi ta chen po sgra gcan zin gzhon nu zhes bya ba sngon gyi rgyan drug la do bar grags pa des kyang zhu yig 'di dang mtshungs pa tshig don phun sum tshogs pa zhig phul ba dang*/ ma ga dha'i rgyal pos kyang spyan 'dren gyi zhu yig bcas kyi rgya dpe bod dpe rnams mtshur phur yod kyang 'dir ma 'byor/ 'di rnams dang gnas chen po brgyad kyis rdo sogs dang dpal gyi ri'i byin rlabs sogs dzo gi 'chi med mgon po sogs kyis phul/ rten gyi yul mchod par bya ba nyid du byed pa'i sa rdo sogs de dag las gnas chen brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rdo'i ril bu zhes ril bu skya sob che ba zhig mdzad de deng sang yang rgyun yod/ dpal gyi ri'i grub chen rnams la sngon tshogs 'khor dang phrin shog gnang ba la ni dag pa'i snang ba nyid du dngas pa'i chu bo gcig 'dres su mdzad cing*/ slar phrag yul du phebs te de dag gi lan gyi bka' shog legs sbyar du mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan du mchod pa/ siṅga gling pa rnams dge ba la sbyor ba'i chab shog sogs gnang ste brdzangs/ phrag grum tshal du chos sde'i gzhi mdzad/ der gzim khang la mtshan re zhing 'ja' dkar po zug /spyir nyin mo skar ma mthong ba dang*/ mtshan mo 'ja' tshon 'byung ba dang*/ zhes mi shis rtags su 'chad pa yod kyang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mdzad pa'i skabs su 'di 'dra ma nges te/ mig bcu gnyis pa sogs las byis pa skyes ma thag smra ba dang dgod pa sogs dang shing gi grib ma snga dro yod sar phyi dro'ang mi 'pho ba dang bur shing las bu ram rang bzhin gyis 'dzag pa sogs mi shis par bshad mod kyang*/

ston pa sku bltams ma thag bzhad cing gsung chen po bsgrag /phyogs rer gom pa bdun re 'bor ba dang*/ dzambu'i grib mas sku ma btang ba dang*/ 'tshang rgya ba na bur shing sogs las bcud rang 'dzag pa sogs ngo mtshar du gsungs pa'i phyir ro// phrag mi'i 'khrug chen rnams zhi bar mdzad/ tsa gong gnas mdar sgrub sde mdzad/ ba yor zhing skyong gi sngags rgyun dang rten gtor dang bskang rgyun 'dzugs pa/ tsā ri'-i sar ma gnas rnams la ri srid kyi bka' khyab gnang*/ rgya la rtse sdum gyi rtse bcad pa yin zer ba'i ri'i rtsa ba dang*/ spang chu lung dang*/ me rag gi dgon pa dang*/ rgyal grong dgon pa sogs so so'i kha bdag gi lha mis phul te dgon pa 'debs par zhus/ kha cig tu sgrub sde dang*/ kha cig tu sbyin gtong gi khang pa tsam grub/ rta bar chab nag rgyal khang gi phur dben pa mdzad dus chu sgra las/ dag cing dri med sogs kyi mchod dbyangs rgyun du gsan/ 'phan chen mo gso ba'i dbu tshugs/ kong lung ral gsum la chos rgya dkar po sngags sring sogs kyi bca' bas thams cad phan bder mdzad/ der rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i dge slong shī la sā ga ra zhes pa gcig zhal lta ba kho na'i don du sleb/ dad pa cher thob/ paṇa chen gnyis dang rgyal po la chab shog gnang*/ 'di dag las ngag rgyun thos pa na/ rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po sgra gcan zin gzhon nu dang rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇa chen yid kyi shing rta zhes dang*/ phyi ma 'di rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs par thos shing*/ de bzhin bod 'dir rnam thar mkhan rabs par ma sogs na'ang rdor gdan gyi mkhan chen sgra gcan zin gzhon nu zhes snang mod kyang*/ rdo rje gdan pa de ni paṇa chen yid kyi shing rta nyid du zhu yig gis grub bo//

glang po che'i tshal du gong gi gser yig pa rnams nye bar sleb pa'i snga 'gros byung*/ bde yang nas dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyin dus dus 'khrug mi yong ba'i gser yig pa gnang ste re shig bde/ dam can mgar nag gi gnas gri lha rtse rnon gyi mdun du phebs/ gri pas 'bul zhabs dang*/ re kha dgon du dam can gyi rten gtor dang sngags rgyun btsugs/ rta bar phug gseb tu zla gnyis dben pa mdzad/ spo bo'i phyogs su phebs/ bre mo chu mdor rnam rgyal gling gi dgon pa btab sngon zam gla chen po yod pa bcag ste dge zam du mdzad/ spo kong gi 'khrug rtsod gzhil/ spo bo ye gong gi mar khu thang du dgon gnas btab/ rgya nag gi gser yig pa rnams nye bar sleb pas slar kong por phebs/ khyung tho la rtsa'i shing tshul ba dang skyo tshul ba bla ma grags rgyal gyis ber stod dgon sogs yul zhing khang pa dang bcas rang rang gi bdog pa ji snyed pa sa rgya gnam rgya dang bcas pa phul ste zhal bdag dang bsko 'ja' gnang*/ rnam thos lung du gong ma snga ma gnam du gshegs pa'i smon lam zhu ba dang*/ gong ma khri thog tu phebs pa'i bkra shis zhu bar gong gi gser yig pa ta'i go'i shri bkra shis bzang po rin chen/ kwan ting go'i shri blo gros bzang po sogs sleb/ gong ma'i lung 'bul ba rgya ja phyed dang nyis brgya/ phyi nang gi mdzod gos brgya/ tsan dan sdong po sum cu rtsa grangs/ dngul rkyan chen po gnyis sogs pho brang phyi nang gi bdog pa'i dngos rdzas yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ yum chen mos gser 'phan drug /rten khebs khyad mtshar can mang po sogs dang*/ don chos rje/ yang chos rje/ se ra chos rje sogs pho brang gi chos rje rnams dang*/ tha'i kyan wang sogs pho brang gi mi chen thams cad kyis so so nas zhu yig dang*/ 'bul zhabs mtha' yas par byung*/ bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs mdzad/ spo bo nas glo bur du tshur phebs pa'i dbang gis pha gir zhabs phyi rang blo rdzogs pa ma zin snyam nas thog kha nang so/

/ka nam rdzong pa/ g.ya' dman pa sogs spo bo gzhung dang spo stod spyi'i mjal mi sogs khrom khri phrag lhag tsam tshogs nas spo rta legs pa mang zhig gi gtsos 'bul zhabs mtha' klas/ gsa' phur phebs/ brag phyi ba rnams kyis pe te phreng phul te chos sde btab/ rgyal mtshan steng du gtsug lag khang gi rmang bzhag /gser yig pa go'i shri gnyis la 'dod chos gdams ngag gnang bas nges shes cher thob/ rtse lha sgang du gser yig pa rnams la rten zhal bstan tshe ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung*/ kar dbon bkra shis dpal 'byor ba la bsko 'ja' gnang ste karma'i si tu la bskos/ spyir rgya nag gi las ka la mi dpon lha dpon gnyis las re re zhing mchog dman gyi rnam grangs mi dbang de thams cad rgyal po nyid ma gtogs gzhan gyis bskos mi chog kyang*/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa bod la yar phebs dus ta'i ming rgyal pos rgya bod thag ring bas 'phral du zhu bas sleb mi thub/ chos rje rin po che nyid la mgon skyabs zhus pa'i rigs la lha dpon mi dpon gang gi'ang las ka don la zhu ma dgos par chos rje rin po che nyid kyis gnang ba zhu/ las ka'i rgyab gnon nged kyis byed zhus te de phyin go'i shri dang si tu la sogs gnang ba yin zhing*/ si tu ni hor dus kyi las ka'i ming phyis 'jags pa yin/ gong du yang gong ma khri thog tu phebs pa la rnam kun dge ba'i shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rgya yul gyi dgon/ ling gu si'i sde/ tas tu kar sde/ ri bo rtse lnga'i sde/ 'jam dbyangs sprul sde/ shing kun kar sde sogs rgyal bstan la gus zhabs dgos tshul/ rgyal khams la dge bcu'i khrims khyab mdzad dgos pa'i chab shog dang*/ rgya cher bka' yang bstsal te gser yig pa rnams slar gong du brdzangs/ smon lam gyi cho ga yan lag nyi shu pa mdzad de sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi dang khyad par du hor zla dang po'i cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du dzam gling tsam na zla ma mchis pa'i rten ngo mtshar can gzhal du med pa rnams las ci rigs par bshams/

rin po che a li mig /shel spyad kha dog sna tshogs/ gser dmar smug ser gsum/ tha ma dngul spyad dang gu gu shan gyis bsdus pa'i mchod rdzas bod yul ba tshangs par bsnyems pa rnams kyis kyang sngon chad thos pa'i lam du yang ma gyur na mthong ba'i lam du lta ga la zhig pa rnams nyin re zhing gong nas gong du spel nas bshams pa'i spyan sngar rje nyid kyang srab stan nas gus phyag la sogs mdzad cing snga dro smon lam chen mo mdzad/ da lta smon lam chen mo'i nang na bzhugs pa'i bsngo ba rje nyid kyi zhing yongs sbyong gi smon lam du yod pa 'di drung kho nas ljags thog nas gsungs/ de'i ring sgar pa mi mang thams cad bsngo ba nyan zhing zhal lta/ phyi dro rnams sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs du ma/ rgya bod kyi grub chen rnams byon tshul/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal/ rgya bod hor gsum gyi rgyal po/ brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i bkod pa dang rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa'i tshul gyi rtse sna mi gcig pa sna tshogs pa mdzad/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa mngon sum mchod yul du bzhugs pa'i zhal gzigs pa/ me tog gi char rgyun du 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar pa'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung*/ spyir rje 'di dus rtag tu zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ phyag mnyam bzhag /spyan lta stangs dang mi 'bral/ 'jig rten gyi gtam dri mol gsum 'brel phan mi mdzad/ chos kyi 'bel gtam cung zad re ma gtogs gsung cher mi 'byon/ dus rtag tu ting nge 'dzin kho na las mi g.yo/ gzim sgar gar phebs su mjal mi thag ring ba mang dus zhag gsum re/ phal cher lnga'am bdun re la nyin re zhal mjal/ ja gral phyag lcag tsam ma gtogs phal cher thugs dam du thun gyi rnal 'byor chig dril du bzhugs pa las/ skyo sangs ri gzigs sogs la mi phebs*/ de'i phyir sgar pa rnams kyis kyang zhal mjal ba shin tu dka' zhing dkon pa'i 'du shes mtha' yas te cho 'phrul ring snga dro bzhin sgar pa kun dang phyi dro khrom thams cad kyis mjal du yod pas dad can rnams ni zhal mjal kho na'i ched du bsnyag

/skye bo tsam po ba mchog dman kun yang sgar pa lo sar zer nas ltad mo yang rab dang nying rab tu byed/ phyis dbus gtsang lha sa dang mkha' ru steng sogs su rgya zam 'ba' zhig la byas pa'i gur chen gnam sngo leb khang pa ka ba brgya'i tshod/ yol skor/ skar phibs/ sgo zur gyi lcog gaṇd+rir/ gser bya gser 'brug dang bcas pa phub par byes chas kyi mchod shom gzabs rgyas mdzad/ gandho la'i dbu thog tu ta ming rgyal pos phul ba'i mu tig che ba the bong tsam nas chung ba sran ma tsam gyi bar gyi mu tig dkar dmar ser sngo sogs bsgrigs pa'i gdugs bcu sum brtsegs pa'i bdun pa yang pho 'dom gnyis kyis 'khor tsam la sogs pa phub/ dbu thog dang sku rgyab tu mu tig gi bla bre dang yol ba mu tig gi sku snyel dang bzhugs 'bol sogs bshams/ mu tig gi 'phan chen sogs mchod rdzas khyad par can rnams bshams pa na dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i bdag po sa skyong don yod rdo rje sogs kyang ha las te lha yul du mngon sum sleb pa lta bus ngo mtshar che pas dri ba'i spobs pa cung zad tsam yang byar ma nus/ sman thang 'jam dbyangs pa sogs ci 'di rmi lam mam mig 'phrul yin nam/ yang na rnam sras kyi khang par sleb bam ci zhig pa'i bsam mno yang nan gyis 'gugs dgos pa byung skad/ rten mchod rgyas pa rgya nag gis brkos ma'i gnas bcu rgyas pa sogs/ mchog rnams mdzod nag na bzhugs pa yin pas sgar pa la ltos te 'di byes mdzod kyi rags bsdus tsam bshams par zad pa la'ang de lta na gzhan lta ci smos/ sgar gyi rten mchod phyag rdzas mtha' dag gi byung ba yin lugs sogs ni rje na rim nyid kyi so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mkhyen gzigs kyi sgo nas bka' bstsal pa ma gtogs rten sgam gcig gi yang tshang ba su la yang ma 'tshal te gu'i gung pa rnams kyis kyang rags pa tsam las mi mkhyen cing*/ mdor na bod ljongs tsam gyi mkhas pa'i skye bo'i dbang shes kyis yul mtshon pa'i rtog dpyod ji bzhin mi nus pa de ka rjes dpag ma yin pa mngon sum nyid du nges pa rje dpa' bo sogs nas gsungs/
