'on kyang sngon rje bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyi dus la ltos na ni cha tsam du snang ste mchod bsham chen mo mi the ba gandho la'i skor kho na la sngon rten sgam rgyab tshad ma sum cu so gnyis yin 'dug kyang drung gong ma'i dus bcu drug tsam dang phyis ni bdun brgyad tsam du snang ngo*// cho ga yan lag nyi shu pa 'di ni thog mar gsa' phur lha babs kyi dus zla ba dgu pa'i bco lnga nas btsugs/ de phyin sa ga'i bco lnga dus chen gsum 'dzom dang chu stod kyi tshes bzhi chos 'khor gyi dus chen rnams la smon lam kho na mdzad/ cho 'phrul gyi zla phyed kyi ring smon lam dang lha mi'i 'dod yon gyi bkod pas mchod pa bcas mdzad tshe/ de thams cad la 'ja'i gur me tog gi char/ kong por rgod mi 'ong yang rgod kyis bskor ba byed pa sa gzhir me tog skye ba/ char dri zhim po cung zad 'bab pa sogs re re bzhin bgrang du med pa'i ngo mtshar dpag med byung ba brir langs pa lta ga la zhig go/ spyir yang drung gar bzhugs su 'ja' dang me tog gi char rtag tu dang*/ gar phebs kyi nad yam 'chang skya rgyal/ legs pa'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pas kun tu khyab cing*/ lung stong chen po rnams su phebs kyang khrom khri phrag las mi nyung ba rtag tu 'du/ nyin mo mis bskor ba bas kyang mtshan mo lha 'dres bskor ba skor lam byang phul che bar zhib mo'i blo can rnams gleng*/ khal mdzo gzim khyi gzim drel sogs shi ba thams cad la 'ja' 'od dang me tog char ring bsrel 'byung*/ de la sogs pa ngo mtshar chen po'i lo rgyus ches mang ba yod kyang so sor brir ma langs/ sgar dpon rnams kyang tshong mi byed yo byad mi gsog /nang brtag rgyud gsum mkhyen pa/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang rdor dbyings sogs rab 'byams rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor che chung thams cad kyi gar thig dbyangs kyi bar chig rkya pher ba/ gtso bor bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len/

khyad par chos drug gi thugs dam bzang ba kho na byung*/ phyag chen dang gcod sogs zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len las dal 'byor rten bzang du byed do// bu tsha 'bring yan chad yig bcu/ bai ro tsa nī/ mgon po dang*/ rta mgrin gyi sngags thung ste rab kyis dung phyur bzhi 'bring gis gsum/ tha mas kyang gang red dung phyur gcig ma thengs na mi grangs su mi rtsi gdan sa khag sogs bla ma rnam pa/ go'i shri rnam pa/ dpon chen/ dpon chung*/ de 'og rnams khrims pa/ khrims g.yog gnyis rnams sgar pa gral pa dang*/ de 'og rnams bu cha rab 'bring tha gsum/ de rnams shog du mar bgo /sa nas zla ba gsum re tsam go'i shri res khrims dpon byas nas khrims pa sum cu tsam res mos kyis bsko/ yol sgo gdong gi ma tshad du zhogs pa nas 'tshog /khrims rar gos lhan pa can lh+wam krad pa phog pa sogs mi gon/ gzan rkyang sogs mi byed/ mi chen gyi gral gyi tshul ma gtogs sdod lugs gang byung dang lag pa 'gram pa la brten pa sogs mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs mi byed/ skad cha dri bshad gtam gleng ba thams cad la yul phyogs dpon ris sogs kyi phyogs char 'gro ba mi gleng ba sogs mdor na khrims kyi bca' ba'i phyag bris ltar khrims dpon de rnams kyis kyang*/ dge bcu'i khrims gtsang mas 'gro ba 'phral yun du phan bde 'ba' zhig la sbyor ba ste/ ji ltar yul gang khrims gnyis srol// gnas der kun tu bde ldan 'gyur// zhes so// deng dus ljongs 'dir phyi ma zhal bzhes mi mdzad pa'i khrims gzigs pa rnams tshe 'di'i zhag shas kyi khas drag btsan phyug gi longs spyod nor rdzas sogs la brnag pa'i phyogs lhung ba ltar mi rung ba'i ngan g.yo'i khrims rang gzhan ngan 'gro'i 'bab stegs su gzhol ba'i rgyu bsgrub pa 'dis gnas skabs su'ang mi shis pa mngon du gyur pa 'di ka'o// bang chen mjal mi sogs zhu pa ci dgos 'gron gnyer dpon gnyis kyi khrims grar gtugs/

des gzim dpon chen mo dang gu'i gung pa la zhu/ rim par snyan sbron/ 'gron po sleb pa thams cad la thog mar khrims res su yod rnams kyis gzhi len byed/ de nas rim pas chos rje nang so dang*/ gu'i gung pa sogs kyis dang len mdzad/ sgar ston la sha mi 'grim/ sgar nang du sha dang chang mi khyer/ bud med sgar du mi 'jog /khrims res brje khar 'di'i ring nged kyis khrims las 'das ri zhes brang dpon gyis mna' 'phul/ de'i dbang gis sgar pa shin tu mang rung phyi nang gang du'ang 'thab rtsod dang g.yo khrom gyi sbyor ba med par thugs rjes gdul ba'i skye bo kun dad pas kun nas blangs pa'i ring nas ngang tshul dge ba de las cung zad kyang 'da' ba med do// tshe rgyun khang*/ rta mgrin khang*/ rnam 'joms khang*/ dgongs 'dus khang*/ mgon po khang ste sku rim khang lnga/ las sna 'dzin pa'i brang kha chen po drug cu lhag pa/ de re re la dpon che chung dngos lnga drug las mi nyung ba dang khrims pa bcu skor las mi nyung ba/ spyir khrims pa byes 'gro phal cher gzim g.yog khang du 'jog pas der khrims pa bdun cu lhag tsam la sogs pa drung 'khor dngos dang phogs yig gi skabs su thab gsos kyi dpon che chung zhes yi ger btab nas de'i skal pa blangs pas mgron thebs byed/ dbus gtsang thams cad du sgar gyi dpon chung la stan sum brtsegs dang pang khebs/ dpon chen la sum stan mnye 'bol dang pang cog byed pa sogs 'dug /chibs rags kyi dus kyang rkya dar dang rol mo ba las sne che chung gi rgyab cha ba sogs chibs rags kyi snga 'gro ba rnams dang rta dkar po re la rten gandho la bkal ba la gser thog phub pa chibs kyi mdun dang*/ chibs kyi rgyab nas gu'i gung pa sogs go'i shri bla ma dpon chen sogs go rim nges pa can 'byon/ sku'i g.yas g.yon du bsil g.yab nyi zla kha sbyor khyer/ las 'dzin pa rnams g.yon gnon gtsug zhwa/

gu'i gung pa sogs go'i shri las ka can rnams las zhwa las gos/ bla ma sga shubs stan dmar thob pa rnams dang dpon chen rnams gos zlum gtsug zhwa sogs mi chen nges can kho na chibs rags su'o/ /rta chas ngan pa gos chen hrul po sogs mi gyon/ de lta bu'i chibs rags che ba bsgrigs so 'tshal la yang 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char phal cher byung ngo*// spyir drung sku nas phra zhing bla ma rnam gnyis kyis gsung chos 'bul dus dbyar bzhugs dgun bzhugs gar phog tu gzim spyil chung ngu rer sku mtshams kho nar phal cher bzhugs shing gsan bsam sgom pa mdzad/ mi chen gyi zhal ngo dpon po phyags phyir 'brengs pa rnams la go'i shri rin po ches dbang dang rgyud bshad lag len rnams gnang bla ma rin po ches gcod dang phyag chen chos drug sogs bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid rim mdzad/ dbon po rnams kyang bzhugs stan dang bgo ba dros tsam ma gtogs yo byad mi 'tshag /sgar 'degs pa na gzim gur gyi yol sgor chen mo'i gung thig la ras gzan btags nas rgyangs par sdod/ ja tsha bzhes sogs nang so nas gtong*/ nam thegs la chibs rta dang drel sogs gang thob rim par rta mang khang pa dang drel mang khang pa nas gtong*/ de la sga khang las rta dang dre'u sga stan btod nas/ khal bcas sogs bde blag tu phyags phyi byed/ tshul 'dis thos bsam sgom pa shin tu smar/ de dag la yol ba nang par grags/ phyis de lta bu mang ba na der ma shong bas khra gur chen mo zhig tu bzhugs pa rnams khra gur nang par grags/ de gnyis kyi nang nas dge sbyor mtho ba rnams cog pu la brten ste dben par bzhugs pa mang du byung ba la dbon po ri ba dang*/ de las kyang dben pa mdzad pa la yang ri par grags/ phyis yol ba nang pa rnams thog gcig yol sgor gyi phyir ka gnyis ma re la bzhugs sangs rgyas mnyan pa dang zur mang bya bral ba rgya ston bya bral ba sogs mang po ri khrod la thegs/

gzhan phal cher las 'dzin brang dpon bskos/ yang ri ba'i rgyun sgrub sde dge sbyor smar ba zhig byung ba dbu mdzad re bsgos nas nyin bzhin gzim gur gyi phyir yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ sku mtshams dngos med dus zhag gsum re la dmigs pa re zhu/ de lta bu'i chos sgar chen po'i tshul srol phyogs tsam ste smon lam chen mo btsugs pa las 'phros nas mdzad pa cung zad glengs pa'o/

'o thang sogs su phebs/ kong lung ral gsum la chos rgya dkar po'i zhib cha mdzad/ sham po gnas dgon sar lha khang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas la phebs/ zing por yon bdag dbang phyug gis spyan drangs te mchod pa cher byas tshe char pa ro sbrang rtsi ltar mngar ba zhig babs/ nyi ma sum 'gyur gyis ring slar 'o shod du phebs/ rkyal gog bzang po spun tsha bo ste sha brtsod khri mon du tshud pa sdug bsngal ba gsum 'don pa'i don la zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs te gsum ga phan bder bkod/ re shod 'jigs skyob dgon dang lhun grub dgon sar bcas su dar rgyas mdzad/ zing po 'bum pa sgang du phebs/ 'brug lo'i lo sar dang smon lam mdzad/ phyag nas 'thong ba gong du 'gro ba'i gser yig pa rnams 'jam lam du zhag mal bsdad par mang du 'thor yong ba phyag nas yin par shes te bsdus/ kong po'i nas rigs su 'dug pa bcas shes te/ nas phyis gong ma la yang phul zhing gzhan la bkye/ rtse lha sgang rnam thos tshal du bzhugs/ gus ldan chen po bya khri dpon dang*/ sras go'i shri chos kyi grags pa sogs dpon g.yog bzhi brgya lhag pa sum rtsen gyi bkod 'byor lta bus zhal mjal dang spyan 'dren du byon/ gser srang brgya phrag lhag pa bye ru rgyal mo lag pa khru tshad ma/ shel rgyan gzim gur nyi ma lha khang la sogs pa gsum/ rta drel gos dar mang po sogs bcas phul/ de'i tshe khri dpon pa dad pa'i spyan chab dbyar chu ltar brub cing gdung shugs chen pos gser ga sog sgor la sogs pa sku'i rgyan thams cad kyang phul nas dbu skra'i gtsug phud phyag tu phul te rgyal ba'i bstan la rab tu byung bar gsol ba rtse gcig btab kyang sku 'khor rnams kyis nan gyis zhus pas/ rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs na lam gyi chod dang gzhan phan che bar bkas gnang*/ phebs par yang zhal gyis bzhes/ bsnyun gzhi drag po gcig 'dug pa las nad zhig yin pa bka' gnang bas/

bshags pa dang mos gus drag tu mdzad pas bsnyun gzhi de re zhig sangs/ mdzod nag nas gos bzang por rma bya'i mdongs bsgrigs pa'i yol ba sogs bkram/ gnas bcu rgya nag ma khri rgyab sogs bkod pa mtha' yas pa can sogs rten mjal mdzad/ khri dpon pa sku las 'bral mi phod bzhin du bka' lung gis phyir thegs/ phrag tu phebs te chos rgya'i zhib cha dang tshong rgya mdzad klo yul nas sngon rang byung rje seng ger chibs nas byon pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis btul pa klo gra dkar gyi rgyal po sogs mjal du sleb/ ba men la sogs pa'i 'bul ba phul/ srog sdom sogs dge ba mang du khas blangs/ de'i dus tsā ri pang phug tu sgrub pa mngon shes can zhig yod pa na re/ na ning sgar pa phebs zer ba spyan 'dren ma song*/ da lo dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong thams cad spyan 'dren la song bas phebs pa yod zer ba la/ ba yo ri dgon sogs kyis kyang gdan 'dren pa su med pas mi bden zer rung glo bur du ba yor phebs/ rmo lo thang ram gyis 'bul zhabs dang*/ der yang klo mang du byung ste rang yul du dar ba'i rtsed snas mchod/ srog sdom dang ma ṇi mang du khas blangs/ tsā ri'i gnas skor ba la gnod pa mi byed pa dang rang yul du 'khrug pa mi byed par khas blangs/ bkra shis ljongs su phebs pa na sgo mo lar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba dang re ma lar sems nyid ngal gso dang mkha' spyod dkar mo gzigs pa nas bzung*/ nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i ri a ma ra dhū ti'i ngos su bde mchog sogs sngags kyi lha tshogs dpag med gzigs pa'i bar gzigs snang mtha' yas pa lam yig tu 'khod pa ltar dang chus brag tu mkha' 'gro ma'i zhabs rjes kyi gnas sgo phye/ glang gong bde chen steng du dgon pa thob gsungs te phyag nas 'thor/ tsā rir sgrub pa ba mang du bzhag ste skyen nas sgrub rgyags kyi rgyun sbyar/ skyen pa'i 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi bar mdzad ste chos rgya dkar po la sbyar/

de nas zhwa dmar pas dga' ldan ma mor gtsug lag khang sar ma lha chen dang bcas bzhengs grub par rab gnas la spyan drangs glang la nas ba yor brgyud/ phrag yul du rgya brag pa sogs kyi mkhon sdum mdzad/ dga' ldan ma mor phebs te rab gnas shin tu legs/ zhwa dmar pa gtsor gyur lha sde mi sde'i khrom khri phrag mang por chos kyi dga' ston rgya cher mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du lo sar smon lam mdzad/ lha mo rang byung ma'i bsnyen sgrub thog mar gyi ling tshal du btsugs/ phyis glang khrod tshal du bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mdzad/ de dag gi tshe bshugs glu dang thog lhung ba'i sgra lta bu nyin mtshan rtag par grag /gtor len 'jigs su rung ba mngon sum mthong*/ snying gi tshal pa gcig khrag thun du dngos su sleb pa sogs rtags dang cho 'phrul bgrang gis mi langs te rags pa rnam thar gzhung du gsal/ khyad par nyang kha phyogs nas rlung 'tshub dmar nag sngo dkar po sogs kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas dang g.yon 'khyil du mar yod pa'i breng ma chad pa'i dkyil nas thog 'phangs te nyang kha'i shing sdong du ma bcag pa dang 'ur sgra sa g.yo ba tsam byung tshe/ lha mo 'khor bcas mngon sum du gzigs pa la/ bskal pa mang por sogs kyi bstod bskul mdzad/ rnam thos rir bzhugs tshe spo rngod snye gsum/ mdo stod smad/ dbus gtsang*/ bya pa rnams so so nas spyan 'dren mi che dgu mang du sleb/ bla ma kaḥthog par spo bor nged rang gi chos khri'i rgyab tu sngar phyag lcag btsugs pa skyes pa'i shing sdong rtsa ba gcig la 'bras bu mi gcig pa gsum smin pa gcig yod ces bka' stsal ba ji lta bar rnyed/ gsa' phur phebs brag phyi pa'i nang rgya zhi ba tshag mdzad/ rnam thos rir phebs/ 'jang sa tham rgyal pos zhu yig 'bul chen bcas spyan 'dren par sleb/ spo bos spyan drang klu nang du phebs/ der lho rong nang so dpon g.yog rnams kyis gdan 'dren dang ldem rta mang po sogs 'bul chen byas/

bre mo chu mdor spo bo ma che chung rnams kyis chibs brgya phrag la sogs 'bul nod mtha' yas/ zar be ba rnams kyis sa cha dbang ris phul zhing rnam rgyal gling du bla ma 'od zer rgyal mtshan bskos/ slar kong por phebs/ blo bde'i bu brgyud sogs kyis 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ spo bo ye gong dang mar khu thang du mkhar las zin nas khrom bsags/ dus bsgrigs nas phyag nas gnang ba khrom thams cad la char ltar bab pa byung*/ rngod dang lho rgya ston pa'i 'bul chen stong dngul lhag dang mdzo sum brgya sogs sleb/ rgya ston pa'i bde steng dgon du rdo rje 'chang gi sku sar bzhengs dang rngod du shākya ba'i dgon dang gnyis su kong po nas phyag nas zhus pa de dag la dngos su sleb/ slar yang spo bo thog kha nang sos gtsos mdzad/ khrang pa tshun gyis rta 'bul mang po sogs yang bskyar du phul/ lo lo bzhin spo bo'i kar srid kyi ser 'du dang chos khrims spo kong gi chos srid gcig la gcig phan gyi bka' gnang*/ blo bde'i bu brgyud dang*/ 'bro la hu re gnyis kyi khang par phyag nas phyin zhing 'bro la hu res ka ba la phyag nas phyed zug tsam pa mang du byung*/ der shar mon gyi rgyal po jo 'bag dpon g.yog mang pos mjal/ 'bul ba mtha' yas/ kho rang gtsug phud breg cing bstan pa la 'jug par zhus/ mtsho chen po'i nang na glu'i grong khyer 'bum phrag mang po gnas pa'i bdag po snur rje rgyal po la khyod kyi dung dkar mgo dgu pa de bskur zhes bka' shog gnang bas dad cing mngon par mkhyen par go ste de sogs 'bul ba mang du bskur/ rgya la'i nags la seng ldeng sdong po lnga gtso 'khor gyi tshul du yod pa tshol ba'i bka' gnang bas rnyed ste dbus ma de la gsung chos dus kyi ganḍi mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du sprel lo'i lo sar mdzad/ khyad par tshes brgyad la byams pa dang*/ bco lngar ston pa 'khor bcas lhag par gzigs/

mdo khams kar zur sogs kyis spyan 'dren dang ja sig brgya lhag sogs 'bul ba brgya cher sleb/ ༈¿¿sngon gyi lung bstan du ma yod 'dug pa bzhin bkra shis lkog phreng nas slob dpon padmas sbas pa'i tshe chu tshe ril sogs kyi gter 'don par gnang ste thon nas gter tshab kyang bzhag /de'i tshe slob dpon padma mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bskor nas gdams pa dang lung bstan mang du gsungs de ma thag de dag gi thugs dam sgrub pa la bzhugs pas tshe dpag med kyi longs sku'i zhing dang sku mtha' yas pa gzigs/ der bya pa chos mdzad sogs dang dbus gtsang gi spyan 'dren mang po'i zhu nan ltar zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas sprel lo zla ba dgu par rnam thos ri bo nas sgar bteg /kong btsun de mo sogs kyis skyel bar gzigs/ thams cad kyi mthun snang du yang 'ja' sprin la gzhi bdag gi gzugs dang*/ rta dang seng ge 'brug la zhon pa'i dbyibs mang du drung phebs phyogs su 'gro bar snang*/ kong po'i dad can thams cad kyis yid skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur cher byed/ mi rgan thams cad kyang skyo ba'i glu mang du 'then zhing myur du phebs par gsol ba 'debs/ phrag yul du phebs/ phyi nang zhal bskos dang*/ grum tshal du dri med sangs rgyas bskos/ zing po nas chu bsgral/ ba yo tsā ri brgyud/ glang lar bya pa sogs kyis mdun bsu dang*/ skyen rgyal po dang lho sgo bas mchod cing sgo gong 'og gi 'khrug rtsod bsdum pa'i bka' gnang*/ phyis skya ses phrin las 'phro mdzad pas zhi/ bra ba brgyud rnams dang*/ dwags po sku rab pa sogs lam gyi sde thams cad kyis 'bul zhabs/ bkur sti dpag med bgyis pa sogs mthong thos don ldan du mdzad/ dwags lha sgam po'i ri la gzigs snang mang du byung zhing mchod sprin cher mdzad/ sa skyong don rdor ba sogs kyi bsu ba dang spyan 'dren sleb/ byar spungs su bya lo'i lo sar mdzad/

spyir zhal gzigs mang bzhin la khyad par mgon po gzigs snang mang*/ rngo mon pa thang du mgon po'i zhal 'bag sumbha nag po gzigs pas mgon po dngos su gzigs/ gser phye 'bum pa dang grub thob chen po'i lung bstan lha khang sogs mjal zhing phyag nas mdzad/ chos rgyal lhun por go'i shri sku mched kyis zla ba gsum bzhir 'bul zhabs mtha' yas pas mchod/ gshegs bzhugs kyi don du bsngo bas rgyas btab/ bla ma dpa' bos kyang 'dir mjal/ gro bo lung du sgrub sde 'debs par bka' gnang ste mngags/ ya rtser phebs/ ra mor rten mdzo cig gi zhabs rjes byung*/ lhun po sgang du 'bul zhabs mtha' yas kyis mchod/ za hor gyi rgyal brgyud stag rtse bas spyan drangs/ srong btsan du sngon gnas du ma rjes su dran/ sman mkhar sogs nas brgyud yar rgyab dpon chen pas 'bul zhabs rgya che dol mda'i ri rtser rje mar pa'i bzhugs khri yod pa gsos/ de dang zhal sprod mna' 'o la'i rtser drung nyid kyi bzhugs khri mdzad/ rgyal khams la phan bde'i smon lam rgya cher mdzad pa na/ rje mar pa yab sras dang mtshur dbang gi rdo rjes bkra shis mdzad par gzigs/ 'di'i dus sa skyong don rdor bas rtsod pas gzhis ka snel pa'i sa thob pa bdag po byed gzhan dbus gtsang spyi la phag gru'i rdzong ji'i tshul gyis lung rgyug nas lo 'ga' zung song ba'i skabs yin pas khong dpon g.yog 'khor los sgyur rgyal lta bu'i 'byor pas der ja 'dren la byon zhing mdun bsus/ skye bo khri grangs tshogs pas sa gzhi khebs tshe nam mkha' dang sa gzhir ngo mtshar gyi ltas mtha' yas/ 'o rags su ja 'dren 'bul chen dang gzhi len thog ma byas/ de nas lhan cig mchod yon gser ldan gyi chu bo brgal ste lum pa shel grong sogs su rim pas bteg /bzang grong du ser 'bras dge gsum gyis mdun bsu dang ja 'dren sogs phul/ de nas rim pas chos 'khor chen po dpal gyi lha sar phebs nyin gling stod smad kyi chos rje gnyis dang khyad par bod yul gyi bshad grwa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dang phyi mo gsang phu ne'u thog gi dge 'dun dang chos rjes gtso byas/

gung ru shes rab bzang sogs na lend+ra'i tshogs pa/ chos rje smon lam pa dang mkhas pa legs chos pa sogs kyis gtsos pa'i ser 'bras dge gsum/ bde skyor zul gsum sogs shod chen skyi lung gi dgon sde che chung gi dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal rang rang gi bla ma rnams kyis dbu mdzad ste ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa khri dang stong phrag du mar longs ba'i seng sbreng gis mdun bsus shing*/ de'i dus su sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa'i gzigs snang sogs mtha' yas pa byung bar bka' stsal/ der 'dus pa thams cad kyi snang ngo mthun par drung nyid yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes su shar ba dang*/ phyi rol du yang nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char kha dog lnga dang ldan pa 'bab pa sogs ya mtshan che ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ skya ser gyi khrom thams cad dad pas yid 'gyur skad/ so so nas chos 'brel bsnyen bkur zhus bzhin chos dang*/ gzhan yang zang zing gi dngos po ci rigs pas dge 'dun gyi sde mtha' dag la zhabs tog rgya cher dang gtsug lag rten rnams la mchod 'bul dang khyad par jo bo rin po che mched la gser gsos dang mchod pa'i sprin phungs mtha' klas pas bsti stang mdzad/ bstan pa'i mdzad pa du ma lung ston par gzigs/ der khyi lo'i lo gsar smon lam mdzad/ shar kha nas 'dan ma grub thob sogs mdo khams gyi grwa rgyun rnams kyis ja sig chen stong phrag gser dngul sogs 'bul chen skye bo thams cad ha las pa phul/ gro bo lung du dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub kyis kyang gong du bka' stsal bzhin sgrub sde dang gsas mkhar zhig gso sogs mdzad nas 'bul zhabs bcas phyag tu phul yang khyed nas skyong dgos zhes bka' gnang*/ kong po nas drung bkra shis don grub pas dbu mdzad kar srid kyi bla dpon mtha' dag gi 'bul chen du ma dang*/ jo bo chen por mchod pa'i rnga bo che mtha' 'dom nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa phul/

ha cang che bas/ rnga khri la 'phrul gyis bskyon tshe rnga steng nas zhom zhing skye bo stong phrag du mas 'dren ma nus/ bzo bo rnams brtol dang bral ba'i tshe drung nyid kyi bka' gnang ltar karma grwa tshang gi dge 'dun phyed dang nyis brgya tsam gyis/ phyogs bcu rgyal ba ma'i gsol 'debs lan gsum byas nas 'phrul thag 'then pa tsam gyis bya 'phur ba ltar rnga khri'i steng du ling gis song zhom pa de yang tsheg sgra chen po dang bcas te rang byung du sos pa dang mnyam du brdung ba las/ lhag pa'i rnga sgra chen po byung bas ngo mtshar ba dang gzhan yang*/ lcags khra chen mo dang*/ lcags kyi spos phor che ba bzhi/ ra mo cher lcags sgo drwa mig bzo khyad kyis 'phags pa lcags kyi spos phor che ba sogs mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ drung nyid du'ang mchod sprin mtha' klas pas mchod cing*/ der yang 'ja' sprin la mchod lha'i gzugs sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bgrang du med pa byung de rnams bsngo ba rin po ches rgyas 'debs par mdzad/ yang der khams nas rgya ston chos rje dpon g.yog bzhi brgya tsam mjal bar sleb cing*/ gser ka ṭo ra gang dang*/ ja gos dar go khrab/ mar sogs dang*/ rta mdzo lnga brgya sogs kyi 'bul ba phul zhing*/ zhal mjal gsung chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ yang mtha'i rgyal po chen po ljang rgyal po rnam thos shes rab kyi lung gis bsngags pa'i 'bul skyel gtos cher dang*/ ja ljang nag ral par grags pa sogs kyi 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'bri stag skyid 'phan dbus stod kyi sde bdag ser skya mi dmangs dang bcas pas 'bul zhabs rgya chen po dang*/ de ltar lha ldan gyi sde chen po de nyid du/ paṇḍi ta shākya mchog ldan dang*/ dpal zha lu lo tsā ba dang*/ byams chen chos rje sogs mkhas btsun bzang gsum grangs las 'das pa dang*/ rgya gar rgya nag ljang bal po/ kha che/ mnga' ris/ glo bo/

mdo khams/ dwags kong*/ lho mon/ dbus gtsang*/ yar 'brog byang ris sogs mi rigs mi gcig pa'i skye bo mchod dman bar mar bcas pa rnams la dbang po'i rim pa dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gzhal du ma mchis par bskor zhing smin grol gyi lam du bkod nas/ gtsang phyogs kyi spyan 'dren pa'i ngor rim bzhin mtshur phur phebs/ mtshur phu'i khri thog pa dang rgyal ba nyid kyi phrin las kyi sprul pa ngo khro rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal la sogs bla ma slob dpon dge 'dun rnams kyi ser sbreng dang bkra shis khra ring 'phyar ba mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gar mchod sogs bsu ba'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bkod pas mdun bsus shing sngar gyi rten gsum la gzigs rtog phyag nas mdzad tshe yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi gzigs snang byung ba ni dpag tu med do//

de nas gzhu dang snye mor byon/ der de kho na nyid kyi gzigs pas/ e ma ho/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab tu bkra ba du ma'i ri mo 'di ni su yis bris so kyai/ /zhes sogs kyi rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs/ gzhu'i gru bzhi dgon du phebs/ rje dus mkhyen sgrub phug la phyag nas mdzad/ si tu bkra shis grags pa dpal 'byor/ sprul sku bkra shis don grub rnam rgyal/ go'i shri bkra don sogs rnams la/ rje rang byung ba nas brgyud pa'i rdor phreng bla med kho nar bkral ba'i dbang*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang*/ ba ri lo tsā'i rjes gnang*/ mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang rnams gnang zhing*/ gzhi byes dge 'dun mang po'i tshogs pa rnams lam mchog phyag rgya chen po'i rgya gzhung gi glegs bam rnams rgyal ba nyid kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i rgya gzhung chen mo'i lung dang*/ rje mthong ba don ldan pa'i bka' 'bum gyi lung dang*/ zab mo'i rdzogs rim phyag chen chos drug sogs khrid ka mang po gnang zhing*/ der rgya nag yul nas gong ma hung ji rgyal po'i lung gis bsngags pa'i/ ta'i go'i shrī chos rje skyabs/ kwan ting go'i shri rdza dge /gyog yi sangs rgyas bzang po du khang bzang po rgyal mtshan rnams kyis thog drangs rgya mi khag gsum gyis sleb/ gong gi lung dang 'bul ba ja sig brgya phrag drug tsam dang*/ gos chen gser ma'i na bza' mang po dang*/ gan gos dang gan dar yug grangs las 'das pa/ 'phan che chung ding phon gyi yol ba dang*/ gos ta hun gser ma'i yol ba bla bres ngo mtshar can du ma/ chibs chas/ dngul gyi rti ri 'jing sngon ma cha/ dkar rtsang cha/ gser bris can cha/ gu gu shel gyi mchod rdzas dang*/ ti ri cha sogs rin po che'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ gan spos dngos du ma tsan dan dkar dmar gyi sdong po sogs rgya zog rigs mi gcig pa mang du phul/ gong ma chen po sku tshe brtan pa dang*/

rgyal khams chen po bde ba'i smon lam sogs mdzad/ gzhan yang mdo khams kyi 'bul mchod pa mang po dang*/ phyogs de'i lha sde mi sde sogs kyis mchod sprin rgya chen pos mchod de/ skye bo mang po dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis ngom par mdzad/ smyug lar mkhar las so ma byas nas phyag nas zhus pas/ ga dar gyis sgo thams cad sdoms la zhog gsungs pa ltar byas nas nas dkar ka to ra gang phul/ de nas gzhu snye'i la kha nas lan 'ga' zung 'thor ba mdzad/ smyug lar sgo phye nas bltas dus steng shod thams cad du sa bon las 'thug pa nas de nyid kyis skya chag gis gang ba de rnams bsdus pas sngon las ches mang du byung ba nas khang du btab pas nas 'phel ba'i bka' drin bsab phyir dpon sa gser khang ma yum sras kyis karma grwa tshang la rtag tu phogs 'debs par zhus pa yin no// de nas rong chen brgyud/ rje mar pas lung bstan par grags pa'i gzhis ka rin spungs su phebs par nye ba na sa skyong don rdor rnam sras kyi 'byor pa lta bu'i rkya rags ches mang po dang*/ byams chen chos lung so so'i mkhan pos gtsos pa'i dge 'dun/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang la sogs pa'i 'bras yul rdzong dkar ba/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan la sogs gser mdog can pa/ kong ston dbang phyug grub pa sogs/ rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi tshogs pa sogs mdor na la stod man/ rong ngur smrig yan gyi dgon che chung gi rang rang gi bla mas gtso byas dge 'dun pa thams cad kyis gnas 'di lta bur gus pas ri mo byed du 'os par thugs 'dun gcig tu mthun pas 'dus te khri phrag gnyis gsum du longs nges zer ba'i ser sbreng gis bsu ba dang gos sku chen mo bshams pa sogs byas tshe/ lha rnams kyis kyang der co 'dri ba ltar/ nam mkhar 'ja' tshon gyi bla bres dbyibs sna tshogs par bres shing*/ me tog gi char gyis bar snang 'gengs par byas te mi'i mchod pa gyi nar byas tshe mkhas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyang mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhi ste dad pa'i spu long cher g.yos/

chos sde so so'i mkhan slob kyis gtsos dge 'dun thams cad kyis mchod dang bsnyen bkur zhing chos 'brel du ma gsan/ thams cad la chos dang zang zing gi tshogs kyis ngoms par mdzad/ khyad par phyi dus mkhas pa rnams kyi nang nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal ba paṇḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan ni ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa la thugs ches te/ theg chen gyi yongs 'dzin dam pa'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par gzigs pas zhabs pad yun du bsnyen zhing*/ slar yang byams chen chos rje sogs gzhi byes kyi bla ma dpon slob dge 'dun khri phrag mang po tshogs pa rnams la/ mdo sde bskal bzang*/ rgya che rol pa/ brgyad stong pa/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po 'dus pa rin po che'i tog sogs mdo sna mang po dang*/ byams chos sde lnga/ dbu ma'i rigs tshogs bstod tshogs kyi lung dang khrid kha mang du gnang*/ byams chen du 'jig rten gsum sgron dang rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i bshad srol 'dzugs pa dang*/ mes ston gyi dgon pa chos rdzong du gsang 'dus kyi sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa gnang*/ rje mi la'i sgrub gnas la phyi gangs/ phung po ri bo che nub chos lung gi yang dgon/ stag chos byang chub gling sogs su sgrub sde mang du btsugs/ gser mdog paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan dang*/ rta nag chos rje dbang phyug grub pa 'bras yul skyed tshal chos rje 'jam dbyangs pa/ chos lung mkhan po/ 'ba' ra ba bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs gtsang phyogs kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba mang pos/ mdo mang la sogs pa'i lung dang bshad pa phal cher/ phyag chen chos drug sogs khrid ka mang po/ rje'i rigs gzhung rgya mtsho dang 'jig rten gsum sgron sogs gsan zhing*/ 'di skabs paṇḍi ta chen po shākya mchog la/ drung nyid nas mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i dpe stsal nas dag byed mdzod ces bka' bsgo gnang bas/

paṇḍi ta chen po yang phar tshur zab chos gsan bzhes kyis thugs g.yeng che tshe/ phyags phyir mkhas pa don yod pa bzhugs par/ phyag dpe stsal nas gang gzhan lugs 'dres pa'am khyad thon gyi zur cha gang 'dug la shog gzer thob ces gnang ba ltar mdzad nas phul bas/ rin po che paṇa chen pas zhogs pa'i yun tsam gzigs te zhag 'ga'i bar du rigs gzhung rgya mtsho las brtsams pa'i bshad pa kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad rjes/ sngar rje nyid kyi bkas bskul ba'i dbu tshad kyi chos 'byung rnams phyag tu bzhes nas 'dus pa'i dbus der re re nas dri mol gnang ba las 'phros pa'i zab bshad 'ba' zhig pas zla ba tsam gyi yun 'da' bar mdzad/ drung nyid nas kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khrid du ma tshur gsan ste thugs dam gyi spangs rtogs du ma 'khrungs shing*/ der drung nas kho bo cag dang nyid dag gang 'dul du bkod pa tha dad pa las thugs rgyud gcig par gsungs shing rgyun du bzhugs khri mnyam par zhal rgyas mdzad pa'i lo rgyus sogs kyang don du nges par gda'/ de nas dbus kyi bar du zhabs skyel mdzad/ der thegs kar zhabs spyi bor blangs te spyan chab mang du bsil zhing smon lam yun ring du mdzad de phyis sgar chen thegs pa'i 'og tu'ang sa skyong don yod pa la khyod kyi sgo drung na gser gyi pha wang chen po zhig byung 'dug pa khyod kyis len ma shes par 'dug ngas de nas dum bu cung zad cig lon pa shin tu phan thogs par byung*/ zhes paṇa chen pas bkyon thabs su'ang gsungs skad/ mon nas gter ston padma gling pa dang nub mon gyi rgyal po sogs mang pos mjal/ gter kha nas gdan drangs pa'i dam rdzas/ rgyal ba nyid kyi lung bstan gyi yi ge /mon zog bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gzhan yang kha che grib bstan gyi rgyal po/ bal po khu spom rgyal po/ pu rang gangs kyi rgyal po/ gu ge g.ya'i rgyal po/ mang yul chab kyi rgyal po/

glo bo'i rgyal po/ la stod lho byang gi rgyal po/ gtsang stod kyi rgyal po seng ge rtse pa/ rgyang mkhar rtse ba sogs kyi ja 'dren gser yig pa gtos che ba sleb/ sku gsung thugs rten/ glang po che'i mche ba/ byeru rgyal mo lag pa/ tsan dan dkar dmar kyi sdong po/ gser dngul dang rin po che'i bye brag mang po/ gos dar sogs dngos chas mang po phul zhing*/ mdor na mtha'i rgya mtshor khad nye ba tshun gyi yul gru so so'i stobs che ba rnams dang*/ gtsang phyogs kyi bla dpon lha sde mi sde'i khrom tshogs bcas khri phrag mang pos rang rang yul gyi longs spyod dang mthun pa'i dngos bshams mchod sprin dpag tu med pas mchod cing*/ gang 'dul chos kyi bdud rtsis ngoms par mdzad nas 'gro ba de dag thar pa'i 'bab stegs su gzhol bar mdzad do// mkha' ru steng du phag lo'i lo sar mdzad/ mchod yon lhan du dbus phyogs su chibs bsgyur lam ngur smrig nas mdzad/ der phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa'i rgyud zhal 'don du mdzad pas lung bstan rgya cher thob pa byung zhing bstod pa yang mdzad/ der sgrol chod gi sgrub mchog 'dzud sa pa yang mdzad/ gzhan yi dam gyi zhal gzigs kyang 'byams klas/ de nas yar 'brog stod du phebs/ yar 'brog sna dkar rtse pa dang*/ stag lung pa/ yar 'brog mngon dga' ba/ dpal sde ba sogs kyis dgon pa 'bul ba sogs so so'i bla dpon mtha' dag gis ja 'dren 'bul zhabs stobs cher zhus shing*/ de dag kyang mthong thos don ldan du mdzad nas/ gom pa la brgyud de chu bo rir phebs/ nang so don rdor bas/ la kha shar gyi dgon pa phul/ chu bo ma hā lo hi ta brgal/ der kha rag man skyi shod smad yan gyi dgon che chung gi dge 'dun mang pos mdun bsu ser sbreng sogs byas/ lhun po rtser bkra shis khra ring 'phyar ba sogs mchod sprin du mas mchod cing*/ me tog gi char dang 'ja' tshon kyi drwa bas g.yogs pa'i ngo mtshar bcas/

chu shul blar thang du phebs/ thub bstan legs bshad gling gi dge 'dun rnams la phar phyin gyi ljags bshad sogs gnang snyug la ba sogs lam gyi sde rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya chen dang*/ ljangs pas 'bul chen gyis bsnyen bkur bcas karma dge 'phel gyi dgon par phul/ mnyes thang du phebs/ jo bo rje'i sku 'bum dang thugs dam gyi sgrol dkar gsung 'byon ma sogs rten gsum rnams mjal tshe/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha zhal gzigs pa sogs gzhan yang rab 'byams zhi khro'i lha tshogs dpag med gzigs par gsungs shing*/ spyir dag pa ye shes chen po'i klong yangs por/ longs spyod lha'i 'khor lo'i rnam pa 'gag med cir yang rol pa de/ byis blo'i mtshan mas brtag pa'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar re re bzhin bgrang bya'i yul du blta ba ni ches tha shal du zad de yi ger bri ba lta ci zhig des na rje nyid kyi rnam thar du 'khod pa phal cher las kyang phyis nas tho re ba tsam las bri bar ma langs so// de nas chos 'khor lha sar phebs/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs dam rten tsan dan dkar po'i sgrol dkar khye'u lo brgyad kyi tshad tsam pa dang*/ rje mar pa'i sku bya khur ma si thang zla zhal ma sogs sku gsung thugs rten khyad par ba kho nas gtsos pa'i 'bul chen/ lha sa rnam gnyis/ tshal gung thang*/ byang chub gling ste gtsug lag khang chen po gsum dang*/ yer pa gnas chen sogs kyis gtsos pa'i 'bul chen dang*/ gzhan yang so so'i mkhan slob kyis gtsos pa'i chos sde mtha' dag nas kyang sngar bzhin zhabs pad dam par bsnyen bkur pa'i bsti stang dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pas mchod cing*/ thams cad la chos dang bdog pa'i dngos rdzas ci rigs pas tshim par mdzad/ jo bo chen po mched la yang mchod rdzas dang mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' klas par mdzad cing*/ lha sa'i shar du thub chen chos 'khor gyi sde'i rmang bting*/

'di la rten 'brel ha cang 'grig che ba ma byung bar rje phrin las pa gsung bzhin bstan pa'i rgyun 'bring tsam zhig byung*/ der chos rje mi nyag pa gshegs nas karma phrin las pa bskos/ thub chen du nang so la 'dan ma khrims dpon/ mtshan nyid kyi slob dpon la dbu mdzad bde legs pa dang*/ chos rje legs bshad pa/ sngags kyi slob dpon dkon rgyam pa dang*/ drung blo gros pa/ yer par dwags po rab 'byams rnams bskos/ kong po'i grwa yon rnams kyis spyan drangs te phyags btegs/ yar rgyab dpon chen pa mchog tu dad pas gus zhabs dang*/ sne'u gdong rtser spyan drangs te/ lha gzigs ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa dgung lo bcu drug pas mjal/ phyags phyir mi chen du ma dang bcas pas lnga ldan dang*/ dwags po'i chos bzhi sbyar ba'i chos 'brel zhus pa na/ ches ngo mtshar ba zhig gnang ba la/ zla gcig tsam na mkhas dbang 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang gis zin bris mdzad pa ngo mtshar che ba zhig bzhugs/ rim gyis dwags po nas brgyud pa'i lam gyi sde ris so so dang kong po'i yul so so'i 'bul zhabs kyis mchod/ thams cad kyi rgyud thar pa'i sa bon can du mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du byi ba lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam mdzad/ go'i shri sprul sku khams su thegs par dgongs pa thog mar bkas ma gnang*/ phyis thams cad kyis nged dang khyad med par khur gsungs pa'i bka' bkod gnang ste don kyi rgyal tshab tu bskos/ der lo gsum du mtshams dam pa bar chad med pa cig grub na sku tshe mthar phyin zhing bstan pa la phan zhes lung bstan nas rnam thos kyi ri bo nyid du gzim khang bang sgrom zhig mdzad par thugs dam sku mtshams la bzhugs te sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po nyid gdul bya rnams legs gsung 'doms pa nyan du mi 'dun pa na dbyar zla gsum nang du yang dag 'jog la bzhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jug sred rgyal po'i zhing du sangs rgyas bgro bar ston pa ltar/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dam pa'i chos bgro ba'i phrin las zad mi shes par bstan pa ni gor ma bkum mo// de ltar gangs can 'dir 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal karma pa chen po rim par byon pa de rnams kyi nang nas 'di nyid kyis yul gangs can gyi ljongs su ma zad 'phags yul dang rgya nag sogs dzambu'i gling 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan la phrin las kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'gro ba mang po smin grol du mdzad cing*/ mdor na 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar/ karma pa bye ba phrag brgyas gdul bar lung gis grub pa de kho na'o// khyad par tshad ma kun las btus bshad gzhir mdzad ste de la sde bdun mkhan pos tshad ma rgyas pa rnam 'grel/ 'bring rnam nges/ bsdus pa rig thigs gsum du ji ltar bkral ba dang*/ zur gyi dka' gnas rnams gyes pa yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhis ji ltar bkral ba rnams rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i gseb tshags su bshad cing*/ sde bdun la lha shāka rgyan sogs rgya 'grel du ji ltar bkral ba thams cad mdor bsdus pas brjod de tshad ma'i legs bshad kyi chu bo kun 'dus rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bod gzhung gang la yang ma ltos par rang stobs kyis mdzad/ mkhas dbang dwags ram pas/ 'jig rten gsum sgron 'di la zhu ba po nga rang 'dra ba zhig yod na myur du 'grub pa yod ste de med pas lan/ rigs gzhung rgya mtsho 'di la rtsom par yang ngas gsol ba btab/ rtsom yig pa yang rang gis byas/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa de gzhan dang rang mi 'dra/ tshad ma'i gzhung tsam yang sku 'khris na mi bzhugs/ phyag dpe ni mi gzigs/ dus rtag tu phyag mnyam gzhag spyan lta stangs thugs ting nge 'dzin las mi 'da' ba de'i ngang nas/ bka' chos gdams ngag chos kyi char pas mdzad skyong zad mi shes pa dgos pa'i gsol lcog gi 'khris su bdag gis snyug gu nag tung nge bzung nas bsdad/

gseng nam byung du thugs rtsom zhus pa na gang na yod gsungs pa tsam las thogs pa med par spyan lta stangs kyi ngang nas sha ra ra ljags dpod mdzad/ deng sang gi tshad ma pa rnams dang sgros mi mthun pa che ba 'ga' rang gi blo gros nyi tshe ba'i ltar snang gi rgyar ma chud nas ci 'di dag zhus pa na ljags dpod 'phro bcad de ci yang mi gsungs/ zhag 'gar yang thugs rtsom de mi mdzad/ de nas bla ma'i gsung la yid ches dgos pa sogs kyi bka' gnang*/ phyis nas de ltar ma zhus par gang gsung de ka bris pas de'i rtsod spong sogs ha las pa re gnang ba ni tshu rol mkhas pa'i rtog ge pa su yis kyang gsung sgros gcig gi zur gyi cha shas phra mo tsam la'ang dpyod cing*/ co 'dri ba'i go skabs nam du yang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro//

go la'i rtsis kyi skabs su cung zad go tshod zhus pa na/ de lta min pa'i rgyu mtshan mtha' dag nges pa dang bcas te bka' stsal nas phyag g.yas pa nam mkha' la cung zad brkyangs nas nged bgro gleng de ltar byed pa yin gsungs nas zhal 'dzum tsam mdzad byung*/ drung gi phyag brkyang ba rdzogs par mthong ba sku 'khor ba la yang nga las med pa yin gsungs te/ gzur gnas kyi mkhas pas bltas na tshad ma'i bstan bcos 'di lta bu bod yul lta zhog 'phags yul du'ang 'ga' dang 'ga' yang ma byung bar mngon no/ /des na/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang*// rigs gzhung so so'i rnam 'grel mdzad pa mang*// mdo dang sde bdun 'grel par bcas rnams kun// tshig don gnyis car glegs bam gcig nyid du// ha cang mang dang nyung sogs skyon med cing*// gzhung don 'khyogs dang phyin ci log med par// ji bzhin bshad 'di rgyal ba sras bcas mthus// yin gyi gzhan du blo yi spyod yul min// zhes bka' stsal pa kho na ltar yin la tshad ma mdo'i gzhung la zhes bya ba gsungs te ces gzhan gzhung 'grel pa'i tshul dang*/ rnam 'grel gyi gzhung rnams la zhes bya ba smos te ces rang gzhung 'grel ba'i tshul du mdzad kyi des na dpal chos kyi grags pa yang rje 'di nyid kyi sku'i bkod par bstan pa rje rang byung rdo rjes zhal gyis 'ches pa dang rje nyid nas kyang zhal bzhes gnang ba de lta nyid do// rgyal ba byams pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel chung don gsal dang sbyar te 'grel pa 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me zhes bya ba mdzad cing 'di'i spyi don gyi skabs su mdo sde thams cad kyi bka' ba'i gnas mtha' dag gtan la phab cing chos 'khor rim pa gsum yang skabs de dang der nges don yin na'ang*/ nges don mthar thug pa 'khor lo tha ma kho na yin pa dgongs 'grel gyi mdo las gsal bar bstan pa dang*/ gzungs dbang gi mdor gang zag gcig gi dri ma rags pa phra ba sbyong ba'i go rim du gsungs pa dang*/

klu sgrub kyi dbu ma tshogs gsum po las nges don mthar thug bstod pa'i tshogs kyis bstan pa dang*/ drang nges 'byed por rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa thogs med kyis de ltar bkral ba bzhin/ nā ro dang mai tri'i bzhed pa/ rje lo tsā chen po'i thugs su byon cing*/ rgyal bas lung bstan zla 'od gzhon nu dang dpal karma pa rang byung zhabs kyis rtsal du bton pa'i bzhed pa ltar/ lta bas spros pa gcod byed la 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs pa rig tshogs kyi dngos bstan thal rang gi lugs de bzang zhing*/ gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa la 'khor lo tha ma dang bstod tshogs kyi dgongs pa gzhan stong bzang zhing*/ rgyal bas lung bstan shānti'i bzhed pa ltar shing rta'i srol gnyis dgongs pa gcig tu bzhed pa yin no// gzhan yang 'dul ba la gzhi gsum gyi cho ga gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i mngon rtogs la sogs pa bstan bcos khyad par ba mang du mdzad cing*/ de ltar thugs rje'i phrin las zab mo nam mkha' dang mnyam pas skye bo gaṅgā klung gi bye ma snyed phyir mi ldog par smin par mdzad nas dgung lo nga gnyis pa glang lo'i mjug tu song dus kong po'i mi mang rnams kyang zhal lta ba ches dungs pa dang*/ kha cig zhal ma bzhugs par yang gleng*/ sgar pa byin yang longs spyod srab pas yid byung ste stag lo'i lo sar la zhal mjal dgos par thams cad kyis nan zhus skyed/ khyed tsho ba la 'o ma nur gyis mi bzho bar ba bsad pa'i sha la za ba 'dems pa yin nam zhes kyang bka' stsal/ ha cang nan zhus ches pas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis nas nang mjal ci rigs pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa la lha sde mi sde'i khrom chen po 'bum phrag tu longs pa tshogs pa'i khrom chen por chos khri la phebs te kho bo'i sprul pa'i sku bsdus zin 'di longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin gsungs nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad la mu tig gi dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i rgyan drug bzhes te thams cad la zhal mjal gnang*/

de'i tshe 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char yang sngon gyi thams cad las ches bkra zhing gsal/ yul so so nas 'bul zhabs ni sprin ltar du 'dus pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis thams cad ngoms par gyur/ spyir sku tshe 'di'i phrin las rdzogs par dgongs nas khams su drung si tu pa la ngom gyi gnas 'di 'dra bar sprul sku 'byon zhes yab yum dang bcas te lung bstan pa'i chab shog snga nas gnang zin pa dang*/ der dgongs mo zhal chems phyag bris mi gsal tsam zhig gsol cog gi steng du gnang ste tho rangs ston pa byang chub pa'i dus tshod la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang chos kyi dbyings nyid du bsdus te 'od gsal ba chen po'i dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad dang rnam dbyer med pa'i ngo bo nyid du zhugs so// de'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang 'ja' dang me tog gi char nyin re zhing 'phel yang spyir drung gar bzhugs su spyi ngo mtshar gyi ltas dus rgyun du 'byung bas skye bo dag the tshom du yang ma gyur/ bla ma chu dka' thub pa ri pa rnying pa nas gzhal ba'i gzim spyil zhig na bzhugs pa na re/ gnam sa'i ltas 'di dag yang ha cang mang drag nyams dang rmis rtags kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra/ sngar zhabs skor thun du bcad nas mdzad pa mthong gi yod pa'ang ma byung*/ zhi ba'i dbyings su bzhugs sam zhes gsungs skad/ de nas sgar gzhi byes kyi gros dbang rnams bka' bgros/ re zhig phyi rol du gsang ba ltar byas nas sku rim gyi tshul gyis mchod sbyin dang gsol 'debs la brtson par mdzad/ de nas rim gyis rje btsun skya se rin po ches dad can gyis phul ba'i yo byad ri bo ltar spungs shing bod yul gyi mchog dman thams cad kyis rang rang gis dad 'byor dang sbyar ba'i mchod sprin rgya cher spros pa dang slar yang sgar gyi dngos rdzas yo byad dpag tu med pa dang*/ don rdor ba'i 'byor rlabs bcas/

rje phrin las zhabs dang*/ 'dan ma khrims dpon pas phyag len du btab ste gtsang dbus khams kong gi mchod sbyin gyi gnas su 'os pa mtha' dag la mchod sbyin rgya cher mdzad/ pha rol du phyin pa'i rnam pa thams cad pas bgos pa'i sku gdung rin po che 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi gzhir snang ba ni/ ba yo nas mtshur phu rin po ches zhugs la bzhen ste sku gdung yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel sran rlon tsam pa kha dog sna tshogs pa mang po dang*/ khyad par sku'i sgal tshigs sku rtsib sogs ma nyams shing ma 'thor bar 'brel ba nya phyis kyi kha dog lta bu la mgrin pa yan gyi sku tshigs zhal bcu gcig tu dod cing sku rtsib rnams re re'ang phyag mang po'i ri mo phyag mthil gyi spyan dang bcas te ches cher gsal ba spyan ras gzigs dbang bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stong pa'i rnam pa rgyan thams cad ring bsrel las byas pa ches gsal bar byon pa rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skus rtse lha sgang du gser gdung rin po che bsgrubs par bzhuḍa su gsol/ 'on kyang rje brgyad pa'i bka' las de lta bu ni sngon rgya bod gang du su la yang ma byon pa'i rten mchog tu snang zhing da dung de las ngo mtshar du ma 'byung rgyur snang bas phyi rol du zhal ltar yod na 'gro don che bar snang ste zhes bka' stsal to// spyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi skad cig re res kyang gdul bya'i khams smin grol du mdzad pa ni ches mang gi stong gsum gyi rdul phra rab ni de lta ma yin la/ gzhan dag gis sku gsung thugs btang snyoms su gnas pa tsam las mdzad pa mi snang ba de'i tshe'ang gdul bya gaṅgā klung gi bye ma snyed mchog gi lam du 'god par mdzad na chos bstan pa'i phrin las kyis lta ci smos/ chos kyi rnam grangs tshig bzhi pa gcig gis btul ba'i sems can gyi grangs kyang ji ltar dpogs te/

de'i phyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa dang 'khor mdzad phrin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la tshad ni su zhig 'dzin/ 'on kyang deng tshu rol mthong ba pa kha cig mthong ba dang sbyar na/ ༈¿¿de la ltos che ba'i bu slob rnams ni/ rgyal tshab sprul sku bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga rin po che zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa sogs sprul pa'i sku du ma dang*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi gdan sa khag lnga'i khri zur/ phag gru'i spyan snga tshes gnyis pa/ 'bri khung dbang rin po che/ 'bri khung chos rje kun dga' rin chen mched gsum/ sgam po'i spyan snga sne'u thang pa sogs bka' brgyud kyi chen po rnams kyi gdung rigs dang chos las 'khrungs pa'i zhal ngo gdan sa'i ge'i khri chen po gnon pa'i skyes chen rnams dang*/ rtogs pa don gyi bu slob/ rje btsun skya se rtogs ldan/ grub chen chu 'phur ba/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub thob/ gzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal/ zur mang bya bral/ rgya ston bya bral/ gsi dkar kun spangs pa/ bla ma grags rgyal ba sogs rtogs ldan rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sgrub brgyud nges don bstan pa'i snying po ba du ma dang*/ ༈¿¿paṇḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan/ mi nyag rab 'byams pa mgon po dpal/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal/ dul mo bkra shis 'od zer/ smyug la pan chen ngag dbang grags pa/ karma phrin las pa chen po/ /dwags po rab 'byams pa chos rgyal bstan pa/ dwags po rab 'byams pa gsung rab mang thos/ sde bdun pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dus zhabs pa shākya dbang phyug /shel khog pa stag ra'i karma dka' bcu pa dang gtsang nga rab 'byams pa/ rta'u nor bzang pa/ ra ti mkhas grub seng ge dpal/ byams sar ba dbus dge shes rab bzang*/ nyag rong na chang yo chos dpal dang ab se grags pa dang*/ byams mgon pa sogs bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams dang*/

༈¿¿dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub/ mkhan chen shākya bzang po/ 'grus khang pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ khre ba kha pa don grub rnam rgyal/ ra sgreng bsam gtan gling pa/ cham dgon pa grags pa dpal ldan sogs sgrub brgyud kyi bstan 'dzin du ma dang*/ 'bro bu go'i shrī pa/ bya go'i shri chos kyi grags pa/ lcags mo go'i shri 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ 'dan ma go'i shri bsod nams bkra shis/ lho rong go'i shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan yab sras/ gling du si ting 'dzin 'od zer la sogs las ka can gyi bla dpon chen po du ma dang*/ phyi ma 'di par rje brgyad pas sku bstod bla lhag tu che bar mdzad mod/ dom tsha nang so dang chen shri du gang la sogs phrin las sgrub pa'i rgya bod kyi gser yig pa pho brang gi las ka can mang po dang*/ byams chen sku skye sna tshogs rang grol/ bya 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal/ sgom sde nang ya gnyis kyi gdan sa pa la sogs rgyal rigs chen po'i mkhas grub mang po dang*/ bya btang thar pa rgyal mtshan la sogs pa thugs rje chen po'i phrin las tshad med du mdzad pa du ma dang*/ zho kha ma ṇi pa lhun grub rgya mtsho la sogs ma ṇi ba'i bskor 'ja' bka' shog gnang nas mdo dbus su yig drug gi phrin las can du ma dang*/ chu dka' thub pa dang*/ grub thob tshem bu pa dang*/ rtogs ldan 'dan chung sogs sbas pa'i rnal 'byor du ma dang*/ smyug la'i nang so 'brom pa/ khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas la sogs pa khyim pa'i tshul can gyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug yang mang bar byon te/ de rnams la sogs pa ni rje nyid kho nas smin grol du mdzad pa'i slob ma sha stag yin la/ ༈¿¿spyir chos 'brel mang nyung ci rigs gsan pa'i dad thob ni/ lhun bde rab 'byams pa/ brag cog pa/ shar smad pa/ mkhas pa'i dbang po/ 'bri khung mkhan chen zhor ba/ stag lung ka drug pa sogs 'bri gdan stag lung rnams kyi mkhan slob chos gsum rim pa du ma/

chen po 'bras gling pa dang*/ rtse nyag pa sogs chos grwa chen po rtses dang gi chen po gzhung las rim pa du ma/ chos grwa chen po gsar phu ne'u thog bde skyong zul gsum/ ser 'bras dge gsum byams chen chos lung la sogs pa'i dbus gtsang gi chos sde chen po thams cad kyi bla ma chos 'chad snga phyi rim pa du ma/ rdo ring kun spangs pa sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i skyes chen du ma/ dpal rgya drung dge pa sogs mdo khams gser mdog pa'i bla chen snga phyi/ pa pom zhwa dmar pa/ rta rna dka' bcu ba sogs smar tshang bka' brgyud la sogs pa'i skyes chen phrin las can du ma/ mkhas pa mi lnga la sogs pa mi nyag rab sgang gi bla chen rnams sogs mkhas pa'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa dang*/ 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chag lo tsā ba rin chen chos rgyal sku mched/ rje zha lu lo tsā ba sogs/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po du ma dang*/ sha ra rab 'byams pa/ shar kha ras chen/ 'khrul zhig sangs bsam pa/ gtsang smyon/ dbus smyon/ 'brug smyon kun dga' legs pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang po ste rgyas par ni rje brgyad pas bka' stsal ba'i bu chen gyi tho yig tu lta'o/ /mdor na yul dus de'i rgya gar*/ rgya nag 'jang*/ khyad par bod yul gyi skye bo mchog dman thams cad kyang dam chos kyi 'brel pa ma thogs pa dang zhal mthong gsung thos kyis smin par ma mdzad pa ni 'ga' yang ma mchis so// ༈¿¿de la go'i shri sprul sku ni/ snye bor 'khrungs/ rje chos grags rgya mtshos lung bstan zhing sku skye ba gong ma'i dpon po bkra shis sogs la ngos 'dzin gsal bar mdzad pas spyan drangs te drung du gtsug phud phul/ mtshan bkra shis rnam rgyal dpal bzang por gsol/ drung gi bkas gdan sa khag lnga sogs mchog dman thams cad kyis drung dang khyad med par bskur/ rje bdun pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu kar bstan gyi bdag po mdzad de rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skur mtshan nas brjod/

rje na rim brgyad pa seng ge'i khrir spyan drangs/ dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa dang gsung chos du ma phul te mi ring ba na mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan te ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma byung ngo*// ༈¿¿zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa ni/ dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos shar nas shar gyi phyogs su skye ba 'dzin pas 'gro ba'i don byed par lung bstan pa ltar snga ma'i 'khrungs sa las shar phyogs mdo smad kre shod khang dmar du yab sdong dgon pa skyabs dang yum dbra bza' bsod nams sgrol ma'i lhums su zhugs tshe mkha' la zla ba gnyis shar ba'i nub mo de ches gsal ba dang lo legs kyi dbus su sdod pa sogs rmis shing*/ yul de'i skye bo mang pos kyang dge mtshan mang du mthong zhing*/ mi ma yin dag kyang kre khang dmar du karma pa byon zhes bsgrags pa dang*/ de nas chu mo bya lo 'brug zla'i tshes gsum gyi nyi shar gyi dus sku bltams shing de ma thag karma pa zhes gsungs shing zla ba bdun na rta ra gdan sa pa'i ngor ngos 'dzin du ma mdzad/ khang dmar dgon par gdan drangs tshe 'ja' 'od kyi drwa ba bres pa dang tshogs dbus su nyam nga ba med par skyil krung du bzhugs pa dang karma pa'i gsung 'bum dang a khrid kyi tshig mtshams phye ste bstan/ bde dgyes dang karma rnam thar gyi zhing bkod sogs 'di dang 'di zhes ngos sprod mdzad pa dang*/ yi dam dang chos skyong mang po'i zhal gzigs/ mngon mkhyen mang du gsungs/ char gyis phongs pa dang lo thog srin bus gnod pa sogs la bden tshig tsam gyis zhi/ tshems brjes par ring bsrel sngon pos spras pa'ang byung*/

dgung lo bcu'i dus shar phyogs su phebs par gzhi bdag gis bsu ba dang bcom ldan 'das zhal gzigs/ gso thog tu rten 'brel du ma gzigs/ lcags mo'i sar sngon rje mthong ba don ldan la ma dad par byas pa zhig mngon par mkhyen te bka' stsal bas bshags pa byas/ dmar gyi 'bring po chu bo cher brub pa la gtor ma gnang bas zhi/ ras su nags tshal me'i 'jigs pas nyen pa na mgon pos chu rgyun 'bebs par gzigs te zhi/ gnod byed mang por chos skyong gis chad pa phab/ sha ba'i khyus bsu skyel byed pa yul lha yin par grags/ yab yul phebs khar 'brug glog skyi 'dang drag po byung tshe zhing skyong bsu bar byon pa gzigs/ de ma thag dpon chen go'i shri pa dang sngon gyi zham ring pa sogs rje chos grags rgya mtshos bkas spyan 'dren par byon/ go'i shri rin po che dang mjal te phan tshun mnyes shing chos du ma gsan/ gling dpon chen du si sogs rnams kyis gus pas btud/ ra slag sku 'bum du zhing skyong gzigs/ yid lhung du gzhi bdag la chos gsungs/ 'dan klong thang du bka' brgyud kyi bla ma kun gzigs/ 'bri chur rlung chen byung ba rten 'brel mdzad pas zhi/ tshal mdor rlung nag gi nang nas mi sdug pa'i gzugs kyis bar chad byed par rtsom pa bskyed rim gyis btul/ zur mang dgon du rta lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lngar rje karma pa bdun pa dang thog mar mjal te gtsug phud phul/ mtshan chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang por gsol/ zhwa dmar gyi cod pan dang*/ tham ga gnang*/ mkhan po go'i shri rin po che dang*/ las slob kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang pos mdzad de rab byung dge tshul mdzad/ mkhan slob las chos du ma gsan/ de nas karma/ ri bo che/ sogs su byon gzigs snang mang zhing thog gi 'jigs pa zlog spo bor nad yams cher byung ba la bka' shog gnang bas khyed cag 'khor bcas la gnod par mi 'gyur zer zhes gsungs pa thog tu bab/

shing dmar/ ro ldem sogs su yi dam chos skyong dang bka' brgyud bla ma gzigs/ brang byi'i yul bdag la bka' bsgos pas nad yams chad/ kong po'i lha mis bsus ste dgung lo bcu gnyis pa spre lo la kong por byon/ mar steng du zhal bzhi pa gzigs pas phyi nas gtor ma gnang*/ ma ra steng*/ stag rtse/ dga' ldan ma mo rnams su so sor yi dam chos skyong gzigs snang mang zhing sngon gnas dran tshul gsungs/ dga' ldan ma mor sku mtshams zla drug mdzad pa na dkon brtsegs gsung chung ngus ljags klog mdzad pa'ang rgyang ring du thos pa dang de srid du lha'i rnga sgra dang me tog gi char yang yang byung zhing rmis nyams su sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' klas pa gzigs/ mi las lung bstan te rje rang byung pa bzhugs pa'i ri khrod rdza rar byon te dben pa mdzad/ gyam steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang de mo thang du spyan ras gzigs gsang sngags sgrogs pa gzigs/ dam can gyis bstod pa 'bul ba gsan zhing kong btsun de mos 'dud cing legs nyes lung du bstan/ de mo thang gi bzhugs khri'i rtsa bar sngon ma mthong ba'i me tog gi sdong po yal 'dab 'ja'i mdog can skyes pas ngo mtshar du gyur/ thim yul du slob dpon padma gzigs/ stag rtser dpal mgon po la phyogs bcu'i mgon pos bskor ba dang zhing skyong yang yang gzigs/ phyi rol du rlung 'tshub pa 'dar ba tsam snang*/ rgya gar du 'byon dgongs kyang thog tu ma khel/ tsā rir byon pa na/ ba yor lha mo rang byung rgyal mo gzigs gnas nang du byon pa na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gzigs/ byin legs su dben pa mdzad pa na mkha' 'gro ma brgyad kyi glu gsan/ rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas tshul ji lta bar gzigs te mgur mdzad/ gzigs snang nub pa gso ba dang gsar du phye ba du ma mdzad/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs pa na gzhan dag gis kyang 'ja' 'od tsam du snang*/

mtsho dkar du mtsho dbus na shel gyi mchod rten bzhugs par bshad bzhin gzigs/ rin phug tu mkha' 'gro ma seng gdong can gsum gyis dri ba'i lan mdzad/ ri bo a ma ra dhū ti'i phyogs bzhi nas chu dkar bzhi 'bab pa'i 'gram du byon pa na 'o ma 'ba' zhig par bab pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ bkra shis ljongs su mkha' 'gro dang chos bgros/ gting zab phug par tshe chu zad med du 'phel/ nub phyogs dbang phyug gi ri bo 'khor lo sdom par gzigs shing 'jigs byed kyi sku gzugs gsal bar bstan/ sngon phyogs de srin po'i grong du yod pa'i dus srin rgyal gdong brgyad par skyes te de rnams la chos bstan pa'i sngon skabs dran zhing gsungs/ gsar ma gnas sngar zhal gzigs gsar du brgya lhag gsal bar mdzad/ paṇa zhwa yug dang byin legs su gzim skyil chung ngur yang skye bo dpag med shong ba'i ngo mtshar bstan/ lam du brag la zhabs rjes bzhag lding tsho brgyad par ches bsnyun pa na rtogs ldan pa zhig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po bgrod par 'dod do zhes gsungs shing des bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa'i thugs nyams shar ba dang dus mnyam par mkhas grub gtsang chen pa'i gzigs snang la sprul sku rin po che 'di nyid phebs te snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul bar dka' bas kho bo zhing khams gzhan du 'gro khyed rang yang 'dong gsungs pa na cis kyang bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes so gsungs shing ltas 'di ltar nas bzhugs par zhu yig yang phul/ lhun grub steng ri khrod du bzhugs dus sngags bdag gis gus par btud cing bsngags pa brjod par gzhan dag gis kyang mthong*/ dbyangs can mas mnal lam du a ru ra dang pu ti gtad cing lung bstan pa gzigs te snyan dngags kyi mkhyen pa rang byung du byung*/ 'ja' tshon gling du dgyes rdor shin tu gsal ba yum gyis ma bsgribs par gzigs nas de'i sgo phye/

dga' ldan ma mor khri mthon po'i steng du bzhugs nas skye bo dpag med la 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa gang blo ma'i glegs bu phyag du bzung nas don bshad de zhal du mid par dgongs snang las sad tshe bstod pa de thugs la snang zhing ting nge 'dzin du ma 'khrungs/ de phyin gsung rab kun lan re gzigs pas mkhyen/ slar slob dpon rin po che 'jam dpal bzang po las bka' brgyud rin po che rnams kyi bka' 'bum dang o rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ nā ro chos drug sogs bka' brgyud rin po che'i zab khrid khyad par can rnams dang nag rgyal phag gsum gyi skor/ rdo rje phreng ba/ bde mchog lu nag dril gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ gnyis med rnam rgyal sogs gsar rnying gi dkyil 'khor brgya phrag mang po'i dbang bskur rgyud 'grel dang*/ bskyed rdzogs man ngag snyan brgyud mtha' dag gsan zhing thugs dam gyi sgo du ma shar/ dkyil 'khor so so'i thig rnams gsan tshe slob dpon a bha yā ka ra paṇḍi ta dkar gsal ngur smrig can du byon nas mngon sum ltar khrid pa'i mnal sad pa na ji lta bar mkhyen/ kun mkhyen chen po'ang de la thugs mi phyed pa'i dad pa 'khrungs/ de'i tshe dngos nyams mnal lam du rgyud sde'i lha de dag thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob pa'i snang ba du ma gzigs/ sngon gnas mang du dran pas gzhan la yid ches bskyed cing khyad par du rtogs ldan chos bzang la de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag tu gyur pa'i rnam thar gsungs/ de'i tshe kun mkhyen chen pos yon tan khyad par ba dag gsongs shig par bka' gnang bas de phyin cher ma gsungs so// lo ras kyi sku'i skye ba gtsang chen chos kyi dbang phyug gis kyang mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan la thugs dad cher skyes te dbu ri ba'i dgon gnas thams cad phul/ bka' brgyud 'di'i bstan pa sgrub tshugs sha stag gis 'dzin dgos pa yin pas rje nyid 'bras bu mthar phyin rung*/

sgrub brgyud kyi mig ltos kyi slad re zhig sgrub pa gnang bar yang zhus bzhin/ sgam por sku mtshams la thegs/ bya rgod mang pos bsu ba ltar dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bsus/ shing spang thang du bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlob par gzigs/ rje sgam po'i chos khrir bzhugs ste dwags po'i chos bzhi gsungs pa na me tog gi char bab/ de dag tu zla ba dgur sgrub pa mdzad pa na dag snang dang ngo mtshar mang zhing tshe sgrub mdzad/ tshe'i bum pa drug cu rtsa gnyis rnyed pa'i ltas gzigs/ thugs dam ches 'phel zhing rten 'brel mang du gzigs/ phug mo cher trag shad yang yang gzigs/ dge bshes chos grags kyi bdun tshigs byang bzhus mdzad pa na lhar skyes par gzigs/ kong por phebs bzhed tshe/ dwags lha sgam pos bzhugs par gsol ba yang yang btab cing*/ mngon sum du'ang char chen pos phebs lam bskyil/ zur mkhar du rje dwags po'i 'phel gdung mjal tshe de ma thag tu 'phel/ rim pas dga' ldan ma mo gsa' phu sogs su phebs/ rje mar pa zhal gzigs nas bstod pa yang mdzad/ de'i tshe phyogs kun snyan pa'i 'od dkar pos khyab pas dbus gtsang nas 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang*/ mkhas pa nam mkha' blo gros pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po du ma ched du mjal du byon zhing gus pas mchod cing chos du ma gsan/ dbus phyogs su phebs par gsol ba yang btab/ zhing skyong gis gnang ba phul te sgrub thabs rgyas pa'ang mdzad/ dga' ldan ma mo/ karma phog rtsa/ stag rtse sogs su yi dam chos skyong gi zhal gzigs mang zhing bstod pa mdzad/ de nas rnye bo rngod/ spo bo rnams brgyud mdo khams kyi lho rong nas lho lung chen bco brgyad/ 'dan ma/ gling be ri la sogs chu bo chen po bzhi'i rgyud kyi skye bo so sos spyan drangs shing so sor ngo mtshar gyi gzigs snang dang than pa sel ba 'ja' dang me tog la sogs pa'i ltas dang mi ma yin so sos bkur sti byed pa sogs ni bgrang gis mi langs/

dgung lo nyer gnyis pa rta lor dar dang rdo sogs brgyud kre rong lcags gsum sogs shar kha'i yul du byon/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho phyogs der phebs pa'i drung du byon/ rje'i drung du bstan pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas dang*/ bla ma rnam gnyis las gsung chos mang du gsan zhing dpon slob lhan cig par re zhig bzhugs/ slar gling tshang*/ ri che sogs nas dgung lo nyer bzhi pa sprel lo dga' ldan ma mo nas brgyud/ gdan sa thel dang tshong 'dus brag kha la sogs par phebs/ rje yid bzang rtse pa dang rje nam pa gnyis lha gzigs rlangs kyi ti shrir gyur pas gtso bor zhabs tog gis gus mchod mdzad cing phar yang bkur sti cher mdzad/ dpyid 'bring gi tshes bzhi'i snga dro yid bzang rtse pas mkhan po dang dge 'dun sgang gi tshogs pa'i chos rje rab 'byor seng ges las slob mdzad/ chos rje nam pas gsang ston mdzad de dge 'dun mtshan nyid dang ldan pa grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan po las dus kyi 'khor lo/ sgyu/ gsang*/ bde/ dgyes/ mkha'/ gdan/ gshed skor sogs kyi skor mtha' dag dang don dam nges 'byed dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid 'phags pa byams pa'i chos sde lnga sogs snga phyir gsan pa mtha' yas/ slob dpon gnyis las kyang chos mang du gsan zhing las gral la bzhugs pa'i slob dpon gzhon dbang la yang chos mang du gsan te phyis yid bzang rtse pa phyi mar grags/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho las ni mar lugs dang paṇa chen lugs sogs dang gsar rnying gi zab chos cir yang gsan pa mtha' yas/ rje lo chen gyi bka' dang*/ yar rgyab nas dpon sa sras mched bcas nas dad gus chen po gtan gyi sbyin bdag tu gyur nas phyis gnas nang gi byams pa'i sku dang*/ dga' ldan ma mo'i rten gtso thub chen sogs kyang de nyid du bzhengs pa mdzad/ byams gling smon lam gyi gral dbur yang lan mang du phebs/ lha sa dang mtshur phur phebs jo bo chen po mched dang dzam gling rgyan gcig sogs rten mchog rnams la mchod sprin dpag tu med pas mchod de dbus gtsang gi chos sde mtha' dag la zang zing gi tshogs 'bul rgya cher bskrun/

lha grags pa mtha' yas kyis spyan drangs te g.yam bzang la sogs par 'gro don mdzad/ sa byi zla ba gsum par gzhis ka gri gu nas brgyud lha sar mchod pa mdzad cing gnas nang du slob dpon bla ma rgyal mtshan las chos mang du gsan/ mtshur gnam sogs nas/ gnam mtsho phyug mo'i bkra shis do bo che'i bar du byon te ban sgar dbon po sogs chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ ra sgreng du mchod sbyin mdzad/ stag lung du spyan drangs te chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ 'phan yul sogs nas brgyud mngon dga' chos rdzong du rje yid bzang rtse pa la chos mang du gsan/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa sogs phar yang zab chos mang du gnang*/ tshong 'dus su spyan snga rin po cher chos mang du gnang zhing bsam yas srin po ri rnams su mchod pa mdzad/ dol lhun rtser rje lo chen la rngog chos rnams gsan tshe mkha' las lha'i rnga bo che grags pa dang mtsho chen po zhig lhag med du gsol ba'i dgongs ltas shar/ rje lo chen gyis kyang phag mo zhal bzhi ma la sogs mang du gsan/ rje mar pa'i sgrub gnas gzigs par bzhed pas lho brag phyogs su phyags bteg sa mo phag lo shar ba na sras mkhar gro bo lung du phebs te mchod bstod mdzad/ mkhar chu'i bar gyi yul gru rnams su byon te thams cad rtse gcig gus pas bsti stang dang mchod sprin rgya mtshos bsnyen bkur chos dang zang zing gi 'gro don rlabs cher mdzad/ lha lung du sgrub sde mdzad par brtsams pa na de yi yul gyi lhas sa gzhi phul ba gzigs pas bkra shis dge 'phel gyi sgrub gnas mdzad/ der lo gcig tu sku mtshams mdzad tshe rang gi phyag g.yas pa lhung ba'i mnal ltas byung tshe mtshur phur gtsug lag khang cung zad zhig pa dang lha chen gyi phyag la chud zos byung ba gsan te gso ba'i yo byad rgya cher gnang*/ gro bo lung zangs phug tu sgrub pa ba sum cu'i 'du thebs sbyar/ lcags byi zla ba gsum pa nas mon bum thang nas ba ru ṇa chos 'khor gyi bar du byon te zla gcig gi khongs su btsun sar sum brgya lhag pa byung ba rnams btsun gos kyi sbyin pa dang bcas rab byung gi rtags su bsgrubs te hor zla drug pa'i bco lnga nas lhun grub chos sde'i gtsug lag khang mdzad/

slar bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs te sgrub pa po bzhi bcu'i sgrub rgyags sbyar zhing bca' ba legs par mdzad/ slar yang rgyab 'on sogs su phebs te bla ma rnams dang chos phar gsan tshur gsan gyi bgro bas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing rje 'gos la phur pa'i dbang gsan tshe mnal lam du slob dpon padma gzigs/ spyan snga rin po che dang sde snod 'dzin pa du mar so so'i 'dod chos mang du gnang*/ de'i tshe sprin nag gi nang nas mi nag phur thogs thon te thugs kar bsnun pa'i mnal ltas gzigs pa na ro snyom gnad du bsnun/ bad mkhris kyis bsnyun byung yang de ma thag zhi/ yab yum gyi don du mi 'khrugs pa dang tshe dpag sku yar stod du bzhengs par bar chad srung ba'i phyag nas mdzad pas lugs blugs pa na nas 'bru ma tshig par lugs gseb na gnas pa byung*/ spyan snga rin po ches sne gdong du spyan drangs te der thugs 'dun ci lta ba bzhin du chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ rin spungs nang so sogs par 'dod chos gnang*/

hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la khri ston gyi shis brjod mdzad/ yar stod du rten chen grub pa'i rab gnas mdzad/ bya pas spyan drangs pa'i ngor chos rgyal lhun por phebs te ches gus pas mchod/ gser phye 'bum pa dang*/ khyad par grub chen karma pa'i lung bstan lha khang la mchod pa cher mdzad/ zangs po che sogs par gyon/ sde drug gis mchod/ byar chos sder bla ma 'phags chen sogs la gsung chos mang du gnang*/ tsā rir phebs te yul stod du chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa cher mdzad/ yul smad bsil tshal du phag mo'i dbang skyed rdzogs sogs kyis 'dus pa rnams tshim par mdzad/ de dag gi tshe sku rgyun du cung zad bsnyun par sman dpyad kyis ma phan yang*/ sa phyogs de skyes bu mtshon thogs pas gang zhing gad rgyangs drag tu sgrogs pa'i mtshon chas bsnyung ba'i gnas rnams dum bur gtubs pa'i dgongs nyams shar ma thag sku 'phar g.yo drag tu byung bas dngas/ slar chos rgyal lhun por phebs pa na rje yid bzang rtse pa dgur lo go gsum du phebs pa sku na bgres thal rung thugs rtsom sogs mi 'chag pa dang sku zor yang zhing bde ba yod kyang sku grib kyi rnam pas cung zad bsnyun par gsan te sku rim du ma mdzad kyang zhi dbyings su gshegs pa'i mtshan ma mkhyen te de lta'i zhu yig phul te mi ring bar zhi bar gzims/ rdza dmar bas spyan drangs dgon ma lag phul te yom la sogs pa dang chab gcig par bdag rgyan mdzad/ rte'u rar spyan drangs/ rje nyid kyi gus ldan gyi slob ma chag lo rin chen chos rgyal gyis rten ngo mtshar can du ma phul/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes drug la chos 'khor lhun po'i mchod rten gyi rab gnas mdzad/ rje 'gos kyi dgongs rdzogs gsol 'debs du ma mdzad pa na dag snang mang du gzigs/ slar go ra chos rdzongs su phebs pa na rje lo chen gyis brtan bzhugs phul mi gnang ba sleb/

rtses dang du bla yel chen mor rje 'gos kyi gshegs rdzongs su bzhi stong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs la 'gyed chen mdzad cing chos kyis kyang tshim par mdzad/ yang dgon du sku gdung la mchod pa mdzad cing rin po che'i za ma tog tu bzhugs su gsol/ chu stag hor zla dang po'i tshes gsum la 'phyong rgyas stag rtser spyan drangs te ri bo bde chen la phyag nas mdzad cing zhabs tog rgya cher mdzad/ mi phyed par dad de sbyin bdag gi rtsa bar gyur/ slar yar rgyab tu rje lo chen dang chos bgros nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa mdo khams nas dbus su phebs pa la mjal du thegs pa na yar rgyab nas 'bul zhabs rgya cher spros bzhin phebs/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pas phyag 'tshal sgang nas bsu ba mdzad/ zla ba dang po'i nyer drug gi nyin mtshur phu'i bkra shis sar mar dpon slob mjal/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la gzhi len gyi dga' ston 'bul zhabs cher mdzad/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa las mdo du ma'i lung gsan pa dang 'gro don yang mang du mdzad/ stag lung pas spyan drangs te skyi 'ban brgyud/ ka drug pa sogs dge 'dun gyis bsus te/ mchod khang chen mo'i thil du mjal/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gnyis nas kun mkhyen ngag dbang grags pa'i drung du 'bri gdan stag gsum gyi chos mang du gsan/ chos rje sku mched sogs la zab chos nang don dang mkha' spyod bka' 'bum sogs gnang zhing tshogs chos su dwags po'i chos bzhi gnang*/ phan tshun gnyis ka nas 'bul nod mtha' yas/ rim pas skyi shod nas spre zhing du gdung khang rin po che sogs mchod/ dol bsam gling du rje lo chen las sbyor drug nyams khrid du mdzad pas stong gzugs rgya cher gzigs shing zab gnad du ma gzigs/ 'dul ba'i phyogs rnams rgyas par gsan/ rje don ldan zhabs kyi dril bu lus dkyil chen mo'i dbang dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa tshur gsan/

dpon slob lhan cig pas brag kha yang dgon sogs su phebs/ rje 'gos kyi mchod rten la rab gnas mdzad/ byams gling smon lam la phebs chos mang du gsungs nas 'brog lam brgyud de lha grags pa mtha' yas kyis mchod/ lho brag shar gyi smra bo cog po'i gnas gzigs/ cha lung du zhag nyi shu dben pa mdzad/ drug ral dang khyung tshang zhing chen rnams yon bdag so sos phul te bdag rgyan mdzad/ ya 'brog khri dpon pas mchod/ bkra shis dge 'phel du mtshur phu'i slob dpon gu'i gung pa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs mdzad/ de ma thag gong ma kun dga' legs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi dbur spyan drangs te yar 'brog brgyud byon/ hor zla bdun pa'i nyer lnga phyi mar rtse'i tshoms su tshogs chen pa dang thel rtses dang gi stod rag lnga brgya tsam gyi dbus su gdung mchod kyi bsngo ba gnang*/ zla ba brgyad pa phyi ma'i tshes bcu gsum la rtses dang gi bla yel chen mor lnga stong gi tshogs pa'i gral dbu mdzad/ dpon sa la bka' chos du ma gnang*/ bya mdar rje lo chen dang mjal zhing slar yang*/ 'phrog dang sman thang sogs su 'gro don ci rigs pa mdzad tshe mnal ltas ngan pa du ma byung bar/ bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs par rje lo chen gshegs pa'i pho nya sleb ste hor zla dgu pa'i bcu bdun la btegs/ lhun rtser sku gdung la mchod pa mdzad pa'i nub gcig rje 'gos dang lo chen gnyis sku drung na bzhugs par snang ba las gnyis ka sku lus me'i phung po lta bu'i 'od phung du gyur nam mkha' la je mthor gshegs pa na thugs dad pas de'i rjes su snyegs pa na ci zhig na lho nub kyi mkhar mda' 'phangs pa ltar bzhud cing nyid de nas slar log par gzigs te 'di ni dus 'khor las bshad pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa'i mtshan mar rje 'di nyid bzhed do// slar sku gdung sbyong ba dang dge 'dun sgang pa dang rtses dang sogs su mang skol dang tshogs 'gyed rgya cher mdzad/

yar rgyab nas dgongs rdzogs kyi thang ston mo mdzad pa'i gral dbur bzhugs/ rje lo chen gyi bstod pa dang rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho yang mdzad/ de dag gi bar du chag lo gsum pa sogs la brtag gnyis kar lugs sogs gnang*/ bcu gcig pa'i tshe gsum la gong dkar du spyan drangs te rdo rje gdan du mchod pa rgya cher mdzad/ chos rje mthu stobs dbang phyug kun dga' rnam rgyal la dbang du ma gnang*/ lhun rtser rje'i sku 'drar rab gnas sogs mdzad de slar yang lho brag tu phebs/ gro bo lung du mchod pa mdzad/ bum thang du spyan drangs/ lhun grub chos sder phebs te gtsug lag khang sar bcos rgyas par mdzad/ gzhi pa'i 'dus pa dang khyad par phyags phyir chos 'dod mkhas btsun dang rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa ches mang pas gar bzhugs su dbang lung zab khrid rnam bshad sogs kyis 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad cing nyin re zhing mdo sngags ci rigs pa'i thugs rtsom yang mi 'chag par mdzad pa ni rgyun gyi rnam thar yin/ der sde 'khrug byung bas sku 'khor pa rnams nad yams kyis nyen tshe slongs su dgongs te lhag par thugs stobs skyes nas mchog gsum gyi thugs rje ched bskul gyis sku 'khor pa rnams kyi nyer 'tshe zhi/ sman 'dam sogs kyis dus gsum sangs rgyas/ nye ba'i sras brgyad/ khro bo gnyis dang bcas pa legs par bzhengs te mchod rdzas rgya cher mdzad/ pa gro sogs mon shar nub du mas spyan 'dren zhus kyang zhal gyis ma bzhes/ tshur mjal mi 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ btsun gzugs tsam las bslab sdom gang yin mi 'tshal ba mang du 'dus pa la bslab sdom ji bzhin dgos pa'i dge mtshan stsal bas go ba skyes te gsol ba 'debs pa na mon btsun mtha' yas par bslab sdom gnang*/ kong po nas bla ma ye rgyam dpon slob 'byor/ glang mthil sogs pa'i yul du dgun nyi ldog skabs phebs shing*/ shing thams cad lo 'dab rgyas/

skyu ru ra la sogs pa smin/ ge sar gsum pa la sogs pa me tog rgyas te bod kyi dbyar sos las mdzes par gzigs te thugs spro bar gyur/ zla ba bcu gnyis par re phal dang*/ chos sde sogs su phebs/ 'brug lo zla ba gnyis pa'i yar ngor rab gnas dang dga' ston mdzad/ skabs 'dir skye bo bdud ris kyis rgyud dkrugs pa 'ga' zhig chibs rags su rgyug cing mtho 'tshams pas/ kam po gnas nang bde tsha mkhan po'i dbon gcig gis rta las babs nas bsrung bas chibs rags rnams de las brgal/ kho rang bsad pa phyis mon yul du mir skyes te bag chags gsal por byung ba ni mon bla ma bde chen zhes 'gro don rlabs cher mdzad pa de'o// zla ba gnyis pa'i mjug la bod du chibs bsgyur te sras mkhar sprul pa'i pho phrang du phebs/ de tshe sku mkhar la zhabs tog ches ngan par gzigs te skyes mchog gzim spyil du skyes mchog 'khor bcas dang sngags sku rnams sman thang pa zhi ba 'od la 'brir 'jug pa'i bka' stsal pa grub zin pa'i rab gnas mdzad cing mchod pa phul/ 'di dus rje dpa' bo bya btang mdzad nas de phyogs la phebs pa'i thog mar sras mkhar gzim chung gi rab gnas mdzad pa dang mjal nas chos 'brel gsan bzhed gnang*/ slar bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs/ sbyin bdag rnams la sgrub sde gnyer bcol bsgos gdams mdzad/ rnam thar du sgrub sde 'di la shin tu do gal can mdzad 'dug pas bstan pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyis lhag par skyong dgos par nges so// dang spro nas brgyud bkra shis rnam rgyal du dpon nas rdo rje bde ma yum sras la bka' chos gnang*/ bla ma'i sgrub sde bsam gtan gling du gdams pa zab mo gnang*/ byams gling du sa skyong dge dbang la bla ma'i rnam thar sogs gsungs shing chos 'khor du ma bskor/ lhun gling du rgyal bu yum sras la dbang bskur mdzad/ drug pa'i bcu gnyis la spyan snga gong ma chen mos mdun bsus te sne'u gdong rtser phebs/

dbang chos du ma dang tshogs chen lnga ldan gyi chos gnang*/ slar yang der phebs te chos stsol ba na rje karma pa'i bkas bcu pa'i tshes drug la bteg yar gong sogs brgyud/ rin spungs sogs sbyin bdag so sos zhabs rim bkur bzhin/ 'u yug phu dkar du thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa dang mjal/ thams cad la kun nas smin slad mdo sde las brgya pa sogs tshogs chos su stsol bar gsol btab bzhin gnang ba gsan/ kar dbon mched sogs sgar chen gyi 'dus pa rnams la dbang khrid rnam bshad mang du gnang*/ dbus phyogs dang lho rgyud kyi che dgu la phrin las spel ba'i grogs gyis shes pa'i bka' stsal zhib mol gnang ste/ shing sbrul zla ba gsum par bteg gos sngon gyi gtsug lag khang mjal/ snub mdar chos lung mkhan chen 'dus pa dang bcas pas mjal tshe bka' brgyud kyi bzhed pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi chos 'brel gnang bas mos gus cher skyes/ rin spungs sa skyong la sogs pas sngar ltar bsti stang rgya cher byas te rim par byon/ bar chad kyi ltas cung zad byung bar yar 'grog gi mtsho 'gram rgyan dang nye ba'i dben gnas gcig tu zhag bdun sku mtshams mdzad pas bar chad sol ba'i ltas gzigs/ rngog lo dang mar do'i 'khrungs sa gzigs pa la mos gus mdzad/ yar rgyab sbyin bdag chen po'i bsod nams kyi zhing du dam pa'i chos kyi phrin las rlabs chen mdzad/ slar sne gdong rtser bka' chos mang du gnang*/ yar stod lho brgyud nas ya rtser phan tshun rtsod pa sdum/ g.yam bzang spyan sngar bkod rgyu sku chung ngu rab du phyung*/ stag rtse sogs brgyud/ rtser bka' chos gnang zhing dpon blon gyi thugs mkhon bsal/ ta si'i sku brnyan dang nyang po gru'i lcags zam la phyag nas 'thor/ yar rgyab dge 'dun sgang pa sogs la chos 'khor bskor/ kun spang chen po rab tu phyung*/ dpal mkha' spyod pas mnal nyams su byams pa'i sku 'di khyod kyi ma 'ongs pa na 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsan pa bzhin byams pa'i sku bzhengs pa'i zhal bskos mdzad/

der gong ma bsnyun nas spyan drangs te 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang sogs gnang bas mnyel las grol/ slar yar rgyab dpon chen sogs la phyag chen gyi nyams khrid gnang*/ rje karma pa'i bka' shog phebs te bdun pa'i tshes bzhir bteg gsang phur sgrol ma rtsod rgyal ma la rgyab yol phul/ lha sar mchod pa du ma mdzad cing gzhis ka snel pas mchod/ 'dir/ de tshe bco lnga'i dus kyi rmi lam du// rin chen ind+ra nī la 'od 'bar ba// dbyibs legs zung du 'brel pa rnyed pa ni// phyi ma'i dus kyi lung bstan yin par zung*// zhes so// de nas stag lung du spyan drangs/ zla ba de'i gnam gang gi dus 'dam stod du rje karma pa mjal/ de'i dus mtshur phur go'i shri mched la bar nas thugs 'tshe cung byung ba zhi bar gyis shig pa'i bkas stod lung du phebs te de dag zhi bar mdzad/ slar bcu gcig pa'i tshes bzhir lha sar rje karma pa dang dpon slob mjal/ go'i shri rin po che'i lung lag rtags shis brjod gnang ste gu'i gung par mnga' gsol yang phrin las rgya ches pa dang*/ spyir go'i shri rin po che'i zhal chems su sprul sku zhwa dmar pa 'di la bdag gi shul 'di gnang ba dang*/ khyad par kong po'i gzhi ba 'di khong rang gi sku skye ba snga ma gnyis kyi 'phros yin pas gnang ba dang*/ gong du dpon slob gnyis po ya ma bral ba zhig zhus ltar yin rung*/ re zhig zhabs phyi'i shol thog nas bzhugs dgos kho nar ma shar bas/ de ma thag gi gu'i gung pa 'brong bu go'i shri la gnang*/ kong po'i gzhi pa gdan sa bar pa la gtod pa gnang*/ de nas rje 'gos kyis kyang nan gyis spyan drangs pas dbus phyogs su phebs par shar/ de'i phyir mdo sngags mtha' dag gsan bsam nyams bzhes kho na gtsor mdzad chog pa byung zhing zhar nas 'gro ba yongs la gzhan phan khyab cher grub par 'dug /yab sras lhan cig lha sa nas gra dol brgyud/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu la bsu bkod chen pos spyan drangs te spyan snga gong ma tshes gnyis rin po ches rje karma pa dang dang por mjal/

lug lo zla ba gnyis pa'i bar du yab sras gnyi gas chos 'khor bskor zhing mchod sprin mtha' klas/ slar yab sras lhan cig yar stod shar nub phebs tshe bsam bde skyid tshal du kar dpon rnam gnyis sogs par mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang soḍa gnang*/ ya rtse thang gi bar zhabs phyir bzhuḍa te yab sras lhan cig pas sde phan tshun bder 'jaḍa mdzad/ lho rgyud dbang pos zhabs 'deḍa zhus te sgar chen de phyogs thegs/ rje nyid zla ba lnga pa'i nang du yar stod shar nub dang yar rgyab tu phebs/ byams pa'i sku grub par zla ba gnyis par rab gnas thog ma dang yon rdzongs gnang*/ slar spyi shod la spyan drangs te gnas nang gi mchod khang sar mar rten bzhugs grub par de'i rab gnas dngos gzhi dga' ston dang bcas pa mdzad/ bcu gcig par lha sa nas rim gyis byon te rdo rje brag rtsar yab sras mjal/ slar yar rgyab tu lha chen rgyab mtho so gnyis pa zangs gser las bskrun pa kong por spyan drang pa'i ngor phebs/ dwags po yom dgon par re zhig bzhugs/ grum pa yab sras kyis bkur sti rim gro cher byas/ sku rab gdan sa kun rgyal pa khri thog tu mnga' gsol shis brjod mdzad/ kong stod dung dkar brag gi ri bo 'di mchim lhas mnal lam du phul nas der chos sde mdzad/ rin phug gi gnas la sogs pa rnams la dar rgyas mdzad/ yul gru so sos mchod dang bsnyen bkur bzhin dga' ldan ma mo'i gdan sa chen por phebs/

sa sprel zla ba gsum pa'i nyer gnyis la ras bud sgang gi gzhir sa chog mdzad ste ka chen dgu bcu rtsa bzhi'i khyon gyi gtsug lag khang chen po dri gtsang khang*/ khyams skor khang*/ rung ba'i khang pa/ phan tshun sgo khang dang bcas pa legs par mdzad cing*/ rig byed pa rnams kyang yar rgyab nas zhabs tog bgyis te zhal ba'i bar dpyis phyin par grub cing*/ de dag gi tshe thams cad lhag bsam bzang pos yid drangs pa'i dge ba'i las kyi mthun grogs dang*/ zhal mjal gsung thos kyi 'du ba phyogs kun nas mtha' yas kyang de dag gang la'ang nad rims dang gru ko sogs la nyes pa gtan ma byung bas thams cad ya mtshan du 'dzin/ skabs gcig tu bdud ris kyis yid g.yos pa'i dus 'khrug ldang par brtsam pa na dkon mchog la bstod pa dang chos skyong gi phrin las bskul/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mang du mdzad pas zhi bar gyur/ zla ba bcu pa nas phrag yul sogs nas bya lo shar ba nas phu gseb sogs yul gru so sor phebs te snga srol gyi me tog bzhes/ stag rtse thugs rje sgang du sgrub grwa mdzad/ lung bstan mkhar du shel las grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi nang rgyal ba'i sku 'od zer 'phro bas gang bar gzigs pas dge las bar chad med par 'grub pa'i ltas su gzigs/ de tshe rje karma pa nyang kha nas phebs par kong po'i gzhi byes lhan cig pas rta pa stod du bsu ba dang gzhi len mdzad/ dga' ldan ma mor phebs shing dgung skeg gsum pa'i bar chad sel nas slar bkras ljongs sogs su phebs/ zhal gzigs nub pa rnams gsos sngon med du ma zhal phye/ slar dga' ldan ma mor phebs pa na gnas kyi rnam bzhag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal lung yang mdzad/ de tshe rje zha lu lo tsā ba zhabs phyir bzhugs pas sngon bod du ma 'gyur ba mdzod 'grel gnam lcags thog gzer bsgyur ba'i bka' gnang ste bsgyur/ khyi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu tshun gyis gtsug lag khang grub nas rnying mar bka' brgyud kyi bla ma'i bris sku mdzad/
