dbus nas lha chen spyan 'dren pa'i slad du chibs bsgyur te chos rgyal lhun por phebs/ lho rgyud dbang po mched dang skal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs par dbang dang bka' brgyud rnam thar sogs gnang*/ yar stod du sbyin bdag rnams la gra lnga'i dbang bskur sogs mdzad/ sne gdong nas yar rgyab du phebs te yum chen rdo rje bde ma zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dge rtsa chen mo'i bsngo ba mdzad/ rgya gar shar phyogs pukkaṃ gyi dge slong dzñā na maṅga las bskul te ma hā bo dhi la bstod pa legs sbyar gyi skad du mdzad/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshe gsum la spyan snga gong mas bsam yas nas mdun bsus te mchod yon lhan cig pas gdan sa thel du phebs/ rten gsum phyag rdzas thams cad spyan ras kyi gzigs lam du zhib mor phul ste don gyi gdan sa'i rtsis phul zhing slar go sa mdzad dgos par yang gsol ba btab/ 'jang pho brang du khu dbon gdan 'dzom tshe gdung brgyud la mtshan dang dge bsnyen gnang*/ rtser mchod yon phebs te bsnyen sgrub kyi nyams khrid mdzad/ dbang brgya rtsa gnang tshe ltas mtshan cung rtsub pa gzigs/ de nas 'phyong rgyas nas dgon thang bar zhabs skyel tha ma mdzad/ lnga pa'i nyi shu la bkra shis brtsegs pa'i khang bzang gi rab gnas mdzad nas yar rgyab tu phebs/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sku'i rab gnas mdzad/ de'i tshe gong ma glo bur du mnyel bas spyan drangs ltar rings par thegs kyang zhi bar thim pas mjal ni ma grub/ gdung mchod dang dgongs rdzogs chen mo'i gral dbu mdzad/ kun spang chen pos khur bzhes te lha chen legs par grub pas dga' ldan ma mor spyan drangs/ 'di rnams kyi tshe skabs dus ngan pas ches dka' na'ang mdzad pa la bar tshegs ma byung bas dkon mchog la thugs gcig tu 'dun 'bras su mkhyen te mdzad pa brgya pa mdzad/ chu byi sar nas bla ma ye rgyam pas dga' ldan ma mor rten gyi khri rgyab byas zla ba gsum par rje 'gos kyi sku gdung zhugs la bzhen tshe rtses dang stod rags la gser 'gyed mdzad/

yar lung du dmag gi 'du 'tshogs byung ba bka' stsal yang yang gnang bas byer/ gri gur bya pa skal bzang bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa skyong don rdor ba'i dpung gis yar gong pa rnams 'jigs pa la skyabs kyi sbyin pa mdzad/ dpal snam rgyal dbang pa la chos du ma gsan/ chu glang zla ba gnyis par yar rgyab nas ston pa'i gos sku la sogs pa'i 'bul chen mdzad/ sde srid phag gru'i gros dbang rnams kyis 'gro mgon rin po che'i gdan sar phebs te mgon skyabs gnang dgos par zhus/ dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos ma 'ongs pa lung bstan du rje btsun badzra rā dza'i dgongs pa sgrub par dga' bas de'i dgongs pa sgrub pa'i phyir chu bo lo hi ta'i klung 'gram du 'byung ngo zhes pa'i dus su son par yang mkhyen nas gdan sa chen po'i khri gnon par zhal gyis bzhes te phyis khri thog tu phebs nas sde srid phag mo gru pa'i lugs gnyis kyi dbu 'don mdzad/ sngar zhal ngo shin tu phra ba'i skabs su gdung ba rgyud kyi smon bskul mdzad pa'i rten 'byung bslu med kyis phyis bltams pa nas sku nar ma son gyi bar du brtse bas rjes su bskyangs pas tshes gnyis rin po che tshun gyi lha gzigs kyi zhal ngo rnams kyis rje 'di'i bka' drin 'khor mtha' bral ba'o// slar sa skyong don rdor bas spyan drangs chu shul lhun rtser phebs te thugs bzhed bskangs/ stag lung rin po che der spyan drangs te dgyes par mjal 'dzom sogs mdzad/ mtshur gnas nang du phebs te ngo khro rab 'byams pa sogs la grub snying gi skor gnang*/ mtshur phur rten chen dzam gling rgyan sogs mjal mchod mdzad/ de nas gnam rtse ldeng la sogs par 'gro don mdzad/ yor dgon du kun mkhyen chen po'i mchod rten la mchod pa mdzad/ hor zla bdun par stag lung rin po che las chos du ma gsan zhing chos rje sku mched bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i las slob mdzad cing chos du ma gnang*/

de'i tshe thog babs kyang gang la'ang ma gnod/ phan tshun chos kyis mnyes/ slar 'ba' rom brgyud byang ris du mar gzhan don mdzad/ cing nyang kha brgyud thams cad du bkur sti dang gus 'byor gyis mchod/ jo gdan dgon par bla ma bskos/ stag lo sar nas gun tshang du bzhugs pa na dpal phag gru dngos su byon te thugs kar thim pa'i mod la thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs/ gsa' phur zho kha'i 'phan chen gzigs/ rnam thos kyi rir rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal/ rten gsum khyad nor rnams zhib par gzigs mo gnang*/ dga' ldan ma mor lha chen gyi bzhugs 'bul legs par mdzad/ de'i ring nye sras brgyad kyi ldem sku shin tu legs pa rnams bzhengs/ ri mo shing rtsi rnams mdzad/ de skabs bya skur ngos su gsol btab bzhin phebs te 'khon zlos zhi bar mdzad/ kun spang chen pos thugs rtsol mdzad de gtsug lag khang spen ban kyi bar grub/ phrag grum tshal du rnam sras kyis dar dpyangs phyag tu gtad pa bzung bas rnam sras steng phyogs su gshegs pas zhing khams mtha' klas pa cig tu sleb pa na 'di dga' ldan yin gsungs pa'i mod la lha gnas 'og mas gong ma mi mthong bar gsungs pas ji lta bu snyam pa na byams pa'i pho brang gi khang brtsegs sprin ltar mtho ba 'od zer g.yo ba tsam las ma gzigs par sad/ yos lor kong smad dang sogs nas/ phu lung dgon dang nye bar mnal lam du 'bri khung thel ji lta bar gzigs/ chu nyi ma'i dpal mkha' spyod pa gshegs pa'i sar mchod rten mdzad de dge ba'i rgyun sbyar/ slar kong por phebs/ rnam thos tshal du karma phrin las pa sogs la dus 'khor dbang sogs gnang*/ gtsug lag khang phyi nang legs par grub cing dga' ldan ma mor phebs nas zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nas 'chi bdag 'joms pa la brten nas rab gnas bcu bzhi la sta gon dang bco lngar dngos gzhi mdzad cing sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa rgyun chags dang las kyi 'khor lo 'di'i dge ba rgya cher bsngo bo'i smon lam mdzad/

slar dga' ston chen mo'i phyag nas 'thor ba'i gral dbur rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin bkra shis gnang*/ kar srid kyi bla dpon mi sna sogs skya ser khri phrag tu longs pa la 'gyed ston rgya cher mdzad/ zla ba gcig tsam du dgyes ston rgyun ma chad par mdzad cing 'dus pa kun la 'thab brjod sogs med par ya mtshan byung*/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa la rtse lha sgang du phebs/ 'brug lo gsar pa'i lo sar chen mo'i gzigs mo mdzad/ rje'i drung rin po cher bka' lung mtha' dag sgrub thog mi khel ba la tshig gi sbyong ba 'bul ba dang*/ thel gyi go sa byed dgos pa 'char ba nas yang yang mjal dka' bar 'dug pas gus phyag nan bskyar dang smon 'dun gsol/ slar dga' ldan ma mor phebs gang ci'i bka' bsgo gnang 'os rnams mdzad de/ dwags po sogs brgyud thel du phebs/ gzim mal gser sku'i rab gnas mdzad/ bla yel chen mor 'dus pa rgya mtsho la sku 'khyos gnang thog dpon sa gdung brgyud kyis 'bul chen mdzad/ de nyin nas gdan sar phebs/ sngon kun tu rgyu'i spyod pas 'jug go zhes pa gdan sar car bzhugs mi 'char bar sgar pa'i tshul gyis phyogs kun tu rgyu ba la dgongs/ lugs gnyis kyi mi chen thams cad kyis gdan sar phebs pa'i legs so'i 'bul ba rim par phul/ chu bar gyi ri thebs brdzangs/ yar rgyab tu phebs te dpal 'byor rab brtan gyi shis brjod mdzad/ yar stod du sa skyong gshegs pa'i gral dbur spyan drangs/ sa skyong rnam rgyal 'od kyis gus pas mchod cing chos kyi bka' drin bstsal/ chos lung tshogs pa dpon slob rnams la gsung chos ci rigs pa gnang*/ sku rten gyi rab gnas mdzad/ rtses dang gi 'dus pa dang tshogs sde gsum sogs la mang skol dang gser 'gyed mdzad/ dpon chen kun dga' rin chen dbang gi rgyal po rab tu phyung ste e waṃ thams cad mkhyen par grags/

stag lung rin po che sku gshegs te chos rje sku mched sogs kyis spyan drangs te byon/ lam na gnas pa'i bla dpon dang na lend+ra dang ri bo dge ldan sogs kyi dpon slob chos sde thams cad kyis 'dud cing mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed pas bsnyen bkur zhing dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin zhus ltar thugs tshim par mdzad/ stag lung thang du phebs te sku gdung rin po cher mchod pa mdzad cing dgyes rdor gyi sgo nas gdung mchod mdzad/ 'dus pa mtha' yas pa la mchod sbyin chen po mdzad pa'i gral dbu mdzad te mchod bsngo gnang*/ phyag nas kyang dgongs rdzogs kyi ched du 'bul 'gyed rlabs chen mdzad/ dngul gdung gi rgyur yo byad rgya cher gnang zhing chos rje sku mched chos mthun gyis dbu 'don mdzad/ der sgom sde nang chen pa sogs dang*/ bra ti phur tsha sogs mdo smad kyi mi chen mjal mi mang por chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ slar lha sar jo bo rin po che la mchod pa mdzad/ sa skyong ngag rnam pa rgyal bur bzhugs pas sne'ur mchod cing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang bskur mdzad/ gsang ne'u thog tu chos rje rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun rnams la mchod dang 'bul 'gyed kyis bsnyen bkur/ slar gdan sa chen por chos dang zang zing gi sku skyos gnang ste sku mtshams dang thun bar du dus 'khor gyi mngon dkyil dang rnam bshad mdzad/ khang sar chen mor tshogs pa rnams la mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po'i bshad pa mdzad/ rten gsum rnams la na bza' la sogs pas rgya cher mchod/ me sbrul gyi lo gsar la dpon sas mjal zhing lo der yar stod smad sogs su 'gro don mdzad cing gdan sa'i 'jag spyil la zangs gser las bskrun pa'i dbu gdugs/ ston pa'i tshems la dngul gyi za ma tog mkhan po bodhi sa twa'i zhal kos sogs zhal ko rnams la rin po che dang tsan dan gyi bzhugs khang rnams phul/

gdan sa nyid du 'gro don dang tsu rir ri thebs brdzangs/ dbu gdugs 'jag spyil gyi sgo la shong thabs ma byung bar gsol 'debs mdzad pas bde blag tu tshud/ e waṃ thams cad mkhyen pa gshegs rdzongs kyi gral dbu mdzad/ sa rta la gnas nang du gser 'bum la zangs gser gyi char khebs phul zhing stag rtse'i sa skyong zhing 'phos pa'i gshegs rdzongs kyi gral thog dang*/ nang rten 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan rab gnas mdzad/ rje zhwa lu lo tsā ba la ming gi mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba bsgyur bar bkas gnang ste bsgyur/ ti se dang chu bar du ri thebs gnang zhing mnga' ris skor gsum so sor bka' shog gnang bas gnas chen gyi zhabs tog thams cad kyis sngar med bla lhag tu bskrun/ yar rgyab la sogs pa thams cad du so so'i mos 'dun bzhin chibs yang yang du bsgyur te gzhan phan mdzad/ de'i tshe bya gtsang gi dpung chen skyi shod du lhags te gzhis ka snel pa 'jig par nye ba na sne'u pa nyid dang*/ stag lung pa dang 'ol kha bas ngo chen zhus ste dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la gdan sa nas bteg ste bkra shis sgang gi na khar phebs/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i drung rin po cher yang 'jigs skyob zhus pa bcas thugs rje'i rlabs che ba dang rgyal po rnams kyang sngon gyi lugs bzang ches ma nyams pa'i skabs yin pas dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa'i bka' nan yang yang bstsal ba tshad mar bzung ste ser 'bras kyi dgon sde la gnod pa med cing mchod gzhis kyang so sor gnas/ snel pa'i sa skyong ngag dbang lhun po mched la'ang sku skal gyis phye ste bzhis ka sne'u rang gi yong sgo'i khung ji lta ba gnang nas gegs skyon med par mdzad/ khyad par du lha sa rnam gnyis la 'tshe ba cung zad kyang med/ tshal gung thang dbus gling la sogs pa gzigs/ chos 'khor bsam yas sogs nas brgyud de dpon sa khri thog tu bskos shing shis brjod mdzad/

chos du ma gnang*/ dpon blon rnams kyis gdan sa yun bsring dgos kyi zhu ba phul/ lho rgyud dbang po sku gshegs par zhal ngo rnams la 'khor ba'i chos nyid kyi ngang tshul de lta bar thugs mi ngal ba'i chab shog gnang*/ yang dben tu sku mtshams mdzad pa na mtshan ltas rtsub par byung ba la phyis gdan sar rtsub 'gyur 'byung ba'i ltas su gzigs/ slar yar rgyab dpon sa gshegs rdzongs kyi gral dbu mdzad cing bde mchog gi sgo nas ngan song sbyangs/ nye gnas chen mo 'das pa'i dge rtsa rgya chen mdzad/ sgam po'i chos rje bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa skyong don rdor bas gtsang du spyan drangs/ thu btsun bsod 'byung pa rab tu phyung*/ bsu ba'i bkod chen gyis rin spungs su spyan drangs/ sa skyong khu dbon la rdzogs chen rdo rje zam pa sogs dang chag lo gsum pa dang byams chen mkhan po sogs la rang byung ba'i bka' 'bum dang khrid sogs du ma gnang*/ za dor rje mar pa yab sras kyi rten la bkur sti mdzad/ mar pa'i chos khrir bzhugs te brtag gnyis rgyud gsum du bsdus te gsungs/ shangs 'brong khang gi bar du byon/ sa skyong chen po sogs la sbyor drug khrid mdzad/ phyogs de'i ser skya mchog dman mtha' dag gis gus pas bsnyen bkur zhing tshogs chos mang du gnang*/ der bla ma chos 'phags ltas bzang po dang bcas gshegs par dge ba rgya cher mdzad/ slar gtsang po brgal te gser mdog paṇa chen rin po ches gzhi len mdzad/ bsam 'grub rtser bsu ba'i bkod pa chen pos phebs shing dpon blon la dus 'khor rgyud phyi dang sangs rgyas dbyangs kyi sbyor drug la sogs pa gsungs/ bkra shis lhun po'i dge 'dun la tshogs chos dang khyad par de'i 'dren pa paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud sogs dang*/ rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi 'dren pa kong ston dbang phyug grub pa la o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung bshad sogs bstsal/

snar thang gnas rnying dga' gdong sogs kyi chos dpon thams cad kyis gus pas btud/ zhwa lu gdan sa pa rig 'dzin rgyal po sogs zhwa lu sde dgon gyis gus pas mchod/ sku cung zad bsnyun pa sgrol dkar la gsol ba btab pas dngas/ dpal snam skor du spyan drangs te mchod/ lam du gnas pa'i skye bo mchog dman so sos mchod de rin spungs su phebs/ byams chos lung gi dpon slob thams cad la gsung chos rgya cher gnang*/ bde ldan rdzong gi dben gnas gsar pa la rab gnas mdzad/ rtse shar nub la stod lho byang rnams so sos ja 'dren phul/ sa skyong chen pos gzhis ka thams cad du 'bul bsnyen dang khyad par rin spungs su mthong thos kyi skye bo ha las pa'i 'bul chen byas/

slar dbus su chibs bsgyur/ yar 'brog dpon gyis 'bul chen dang*/ lhun rtser phebs/ gdan sa'i khur gnang bar nan gyis zhus par zhal gyis bzhes skyi stod smad du phebs/ lha sar mchod pa dang*/ po ṭa la'i khang gsar gyi rab gnas mdzad/ gsang phu/ gung thang*/ dga' skyor zul gsum/ ser 'bras sogs bshad grwa rnams kyi chos smra ba rnams dang sgo yab la sogs sgrub gra'i bla ma thams cad kyis mjal zhing so sos 'dod chos zhus/ mon dang kong po'i 'bul skyel rnams 'byor/ rje 'jig rten gsum mgon dngos 'byon par lung bstan pa'i 'bri khung gdan sa pa rje kun rin mjal slad lha sar phebs pa dang khyams khra chen mor mjal/ dbang rgyud man ngag mtha' klas pas thugs tshim par mdzad/ slar 'on phyogs la chibs bsgyur ba nas/ smon mkhar du mchod yon mjal/ gdan sar phebs te sku skyos gnang*/ gnas nang dang dga' ldan ma mor gdan sa pa gsar du bskos/ rtser phebs te chos du ma gnang*/ kha rag tu phebs te gnas gzigs/ sa skyong mchod yon la dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma mdzad/ zla ba de'i nyer gsum nas lo mtshams kyi bcad rgya dam par mdzad/ thun bar du chos drug lung sbyor chen po mdzad/ lcags bya sar nas mā ya'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad/ mnal ltas la spos kyi glang po che gangs ri lta bu la chibs nas 'byon pa dang*/ 'brug ring zhing che ba du ba 'khyil ba lta bu sngo nag la chibs te nub nas nub byang du song ba na de'i mgo bo sprin gyi dbus su zhugs shing 'brug sgra drag po yun ring du grags pa'i ltas gzigs pa bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos sde'i ltas su dgongs/ dbyar g.yul rgyal gyi rdzong du bzhugs te sku mtshams thun bar du gdan bzhi'i dkyil chog dang 'dus pa'i bskyed rim rnam bshad sogs mang du mdzad/ jo mo kha rag gis bar chad sel ba dang phrin las sgrub par gzigs/ rgyal ba'i mchod rten rin po che rang bzhin 'od 'bar ba mnal lam du gzigs pas rten 'brel du rnam rgyal mchod rten mdzad/

sku mtshams nang ma grol nas yon bdag chen po mchod yon sogs la dus 'khor gyi dbang rdzogs sogs dang byang chub sems sdom gnang*/ mchod yon lhan cig lhun rtser phebs/ mi dbang chen po la phyag rdor 'khor chen dbang dang*/ byams chen gdan sa par chos drug khrid rim sogs gnang*/ mdo khams rgya ston sogs mang du 'dus par chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ sa skyong chen pos khyad nor mang du phul/ srin rir bde mchog rang byung la mchod cing smon 'dun mdzad/ byang kha brgyud thu btsun mched kyis bsnyen bkur/ zla ba bcu gcig par thel du phebs/ sku skyos kyi mchod sbyin mdzad/ thar mar 'od dpag med kyi sku rgyab mtho bco brgyad pa zangs gser las bzheng du gcug de'i tshe nag po chen pos 'dud pa'i mnal ltas shar/ chu khyi zla ba dang por thel gyi mkhan slob sogs du mar bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang gnang zhing sgrub mchod kyi rgyun mdzad/ rten chen thel du spyan drangs te gzungs gzhug grub cing rab gnas mdzad/ dga' ston yon rdzongs sogs snga srol ltar mdzad/ chu bar du ri thebs brdzangs/ rtse dang 'phyong rgyas su phebs te skyed mos tshal du sku mtshams mdzad/ ti ser ri theb gnang*/ dpal ri'i lha babs mchod rten grub par rab gnas mdzad/ lhun sgang du phebs te lha rigs kyis mchod/ g.yam bzang spyan snga sogs bsnyen par rdzogs/ slar srong btsan du sbyin bdag chen po rnams la dus 'khor dbang rdzogs par mdzad/ 'phags sde la mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i dbang mdzad de chos skyong du 'dzin par mdzad/ sne'u gdong dang brag khar mchod yon mjal zhing rdor dbyings kyi dbang sogs gnang*/ slar thel du phebs nas chos mang du gnang*/ skyi shod la thegs/ 'phan yul rgyal phu nas sa skyong chen pos stod lung bde chen lha 'bangs su phul ba der phebs/ zla ba brgyad par sa skyong chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i skye bo mtha' yas pas bsus te ar byang chub ye shes kyi chos gzhi gnam rtse ldeng du phebs/

rje karma pa gzhur gdan chags pa dang dus mtshungs pas mjal bar bzhed kyang der dngas mjal rang ma grub/ dgu pa'i tshes gnyis la sa skyong chen por 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang brgya rtsa gnang zhing*/ tshes drug la tshal pa bka' 'gyur shin tu dag pa gsung rab zhus dag gi ma'i thes su bzhengs pa de sogs dngos spyad du ma dang*/ 'thus btsun nyis brgya de'i phogs thebs kyi mchod gzhis rnams phul te sar pa rnams dge bsnyen du bcug bcu par snying drung sogs nas stag lung thang du phebs/ chos rje mched la rdor dbyings kyi dbang sogs chos bka' du ma gnang zhing tshogs pa thams cad la chos dang zang zing gi 'bul 'gyed rgya cher mdzad/ 'bri khung du spyan drangs te lam du 'gro don mdzad bzhin pas chos rje thog kha ba dpon slob kyis sngun bsus te mtshe'u kha'i gzim khang chen po phebs/ mkhar thog dpon blon gyis 'bul zhabs mdzad/ chos rje khu dbon la 'bul nod tshogs par mang skol 'gyed bcas yo byad gnang*/ bcu gcig par thel du phebs te mchod pa dang skyob pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ mkhan slob sogs bla ma rnams la dbang chos du ma gnang*/ chos rje rin po che khu dbon la tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs kyis bzhed pa bskangs/ chu phag lo sar pa'i nyer brgyad la chos rjes skyel thung bcas bteg byang gi sa ci rigs par byon te nyi khri la sogs par gzhan don mdzad/ 'dam gzhung rnams su phebs/ yor dgon du sku 'bum la mchod pa mdzad/ dam can pas bsuu ba dngas rgyan dgos tshul ston par gzigs/ rtse ldeng du byon te sa skyong chen pos zhabs bkur gyi mthun spel rtag par sbyar te dgon sa brtags pa na lha brgyad gangs kyi ra ba'i dbus/ ri bo 'brang rgyas shes bya ba gnyan chen po thang lha'i shar phyogs bde chen gyi ri bo nyid 'thad par gzigs te gsum pa'i bcu gsum nas sa slong gi cho ga nyin gsum mdzad pa'i tho rangs mnal ltas dge ba gzigs nas de'i nyer bzhi gza' skar bzang ba la dus 'khor thugs dkyil dang 'brel bar lto 'phye brtag pa sogs sa chog bkra shis dang bcas pa mdzad/

dgung lo nga gcig pa chu mo phag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu gza' skar sbyor byed dge bar gtsug lag khang bla brang dang bcas pa ka ba bdun cu don drug gis yul bla yel chen mo skor lam grwa khang brgya dang go bdun rnams kyi rmang bting*/ nyer gsum la dkon cog mchod pa rgya chen dang lha sa bsam yas sogs la'ang mchod 'bul ba brdzangs te gegs med du 'grub par gsol 'debs mdzad/ sa skyong chen pos zhal bsgos gyis gtsang dbus khams 'brog gi las mi mtha' yas pas brtsigs/ zla ba dgu pa yan gyi gtsug lag khang 'og thog sgo gnyis thog khang phran rnams phal cher grub/ dgu pa'i nyer gsum la 'du khang zhal bsro'i 'bul zhabs rnams sa skyong rin chen rgyal mchog gis bsgrubs/ rtse 'bri gdan stag lung sogs thams cad nas legs ja phul/ de dag gi skabs khrid lung du ma gnang zhing sar bu rnams rab tu phyung ste dbang chos rgya cher gnang zhing rgyud sde'i lag len du ma btsugs/ gnas nang chu shul sogs par bzhugs cing 'gro don mdzad/ shing byi shar nas bslab btus sogs gsungs glo bo chos rje blo rgyam gyis gangs can dang ti se gcig gam dris pa'i lan mkhas pa'i rna rgyan mdzad/ skyor lung lum pa sogs nas phebs/ rtser mchod yon mjal/ slar gdan sar phebs te chos kyi phrin las dang phyogs kyi 'bul skyel ba rnams la chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ yang dgon pho brang gi rten sar bzhengs rnams la shis brjod mdzad de byams pa'i gser sku rgyab mtho drug pa bzhengs par bka' dang bcas gnang zhing phyis grub pa na rab gnas mdzad de mon chos sde'i rten gtsor gnang*/ ti ser ri thebs brdzangs/ bdun par sne'u gdong rtser dpon sa la 'ja' sa zhu ba dang*/ sprul sku chos dpal ye shes kyi phrin las kyi rgyun gyi rta 'bul dang bcas/ dzam gling bdag po hung ji'i drung du gnang*/ spyir g.yung pas rgyal rtse ba'i steng du dmag bteg pa brgyud 'ded kyi le lan 'ga' dang 'gas rin spungs pa dpon blon lho stod pa la thugs ma gshin par yod pa la dpung rnams kyis lho stod pa bsdigs par chas pa na sngar gyi sbyin bdag yin pa'i rgyun dang thugs brtses nye bar dgongs te dpon g.yog zhu 'jags ched bzhes gnang bas gzhis ka nas kyang gsan pa sna tsam phul bas chog pa byung ste lho stod pa'i srid brtan pa'ang rje 'di'i bka' drin yin/

'di skabs spe chung ba'ang bder 'jags kyi bka' drin bstsal zhing*/ de ltar 'phyong rgyas su bzhugs te 'khrug rtsod rnams nye zhir mdzad nas mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas 'gro ba de dag bde bar bkod de/ rtse brag kha thar ma sogs brgyud gdan sar phebs/ de thams cad du rgya ston dbon sogs mang por chos dang gdams ngag ci rigs pa gnang zhing rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du bsgrubs/ rtser sman khang pa rab tu byung*/ yar rgyab sogs nas so so'i zhabs tog dang dbang chos mang du gnang zhing sne'ur phebs/ 'bras spungs gdan sa mkhas btsun pa sogs la dbang chos mdzad/ gnyis pa'i bcu gcig la sa skyong chen po dang bcas mchod yon lhan gcig po ṭa lar phebs/ sgo yab gdan sa pa dang snyug la chos rje rnams la chos du ma gsungs/ slar yangs can du phebs/ gtsug lag khang sogs spen bad kyi bar du grub 'dug pa'i ri mo shing rtsi sogs kyi mgo brtsams/ phyogs kyi 'dus pa rnams la gsung chos ci rigs gnang*/ nad yams cung zad byung ba dkon cog la gsol 'debs srung mar phrin bcol mdzad pas zhi/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod brgya phye dang nye ba gtsugs/ phyogs thams cad du chos sde'i grags dkar gyis yongs su khyab pa sngon 'brug mgo sprin gseb na sgra sgrogs pa'i rten 'brel du snang*/ sngon dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos 'di dang mi ring ba'i phug tu sgrub pa mdzad pas mkha' spyod pho brang du grags shing de nas ma 'ongs pa 'dir kho bo'i gnas 'byung zhes lung bstan pa ltar ro// de ltar dgung lo nga bzhi yan gyi rnam thar rje nyid kyis tshigs bcad du mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod utpa la'i do shal las cung zad bsdus te bkod pa yin la/ de nas yangs can du rten chen gtso 'khor rnams bzhengs pa dang*/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa na rim gyi gser sku sku tshad ma/ mgon khang du kar lugs dang thel pa'i chos skyong gi sku/

steng 'og thams cad du ri mo'i bkod pa khyad mtshar sman thang pa sman bla don grub yab sras dang mkhyen brtse bas bris/ gtsug lag khang phyi nang thams cad lhan cig tu grub pas grub sla ba dang dngos gtsang ba sogs ya mtshan che bar kun gyis gleng ngo*/ /mdun gyi ne'u thang la gos sku'i tshad kyi ras bkram pa'i steng du sman thang 'jam dbyangs pas za 'og gi lh+wam gyon/ sol pir yu ba can phyag tu thogs pas thub chen gyi sku bris te tshon yig btab nas ji lta bar gos chen kha dog so so dras nas bsgrigs pa'i gos sku shin tu che ba bsgrub te rab gnas la sogs pa'i dus su ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung skad/ gos sku chen po 'di lta bur thig 'debs sogs mi dgos par 'ol spyis bris pa'i lan cig las spo len sogs ma dgos pas bzo bo mkhas pa'i phul dang rje nyid kyi thugs rje gcig tu 'jug pa'o// zhing skyong mi la brloms te dga' ldan ma mo'i gtsang khang gi ka ba nang ma rul yod pas brje ba la phebs dgos par zhus te rta lor phebs te 'phrul gyis gso pa mdzad/ de tshe mthu stobs chen po'i dmag dpung g.ye bla 'bring du lhags pas kun gyis mgon skyabs zhus te dmag zhi ba dang sde dpon mang zhig la skyabs sbyin mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu pa sprel lor rje dpa' bo sprul sku gtsug lag phreng ba rab tu phyung*/ de tshe rgya nag gi pho nya rnams 'khor te lung ling ji 'bul nod rgya cher byung*/ sa skyong don rdor ba gnam du gshegs/ dus tha'i cho gas rjes su bzung*/ skyi g.yor sogs phebs lam du 'gro don mdzad cing gdan sa thel du phebs shing phrin las chen po du ma mdzad/ slar yangs can du byams khang chen mo khyams rung khang dang bcas pa ka ba brgya lhag gi sa mdzad de/ byams pa'i sku bzhengs par bzhed kyang mnal ltas su bdag cag gi ston mchog shākya'i dbang po chos 'chad can gzigs pas de lta bu'i gser sku shin tu che ba 'khor dang bcas pa bzhengs par mdzad nas/

bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal yang gser 'ba' zhig las bzhengs pa dang thugs dam bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa yang mdzad/ mtshan ldan thod pa smug chung gi mkha' 'gro ma de'i sku skye ba lnga pa rje btsun ma snyan grags bzang mo rab byung mar bsgrubs shing gsung chos du ma gnang nas rtsa ba'i slob mar gyur/ mkhas pa chen po 'chi med dpal bzang pos gsung chos mang du gsan/ thugs dad pa mi zad par thob cing phyag chen rnam bshad kyi thugs rtsom zhus/ 'bring khung dpon phu lung pa'i bdag rgyan mdzad de/ rab tu phyungs nas gsung chos ci rigs par gnang nas 'grus khang pa dang dpon slob gnyis kyis 'bri khung gi gdan sa par nan gyis bsko ba mdzad/ gdung brgyud sku gzhon pa dge tshul bsgrubs nas thel gyi gdan sa'i go sar bskos/ rje karma pa brgyad pa kong por phebs par gdan 'dren yang yang du gnang zhing khyad par dbon po chos skyong ba gnang ste khong gis kyang phebs pa'i zhal bzhes ma byung gi bar du ci la thug nga mi 'gro zhes yun bsrings nas bsdad/ rje karma pa nyid phebs par spro na'ang sgar pa rnams kyis mi phebs par zhus/ spre lor rtser bzhugs dus rje rang gi phyag bris su nged rang mjal shin tu spro bar yod rung sgar pa rnams kyis dbang ma 'dus pas phebs par rngo ma thogs la mi ring bar mjal spro ba phebs pas chab shog dbur bzhag ste nga'i bla ma de'i drung na mi gzhan med na nga la bka' shog nang gtsang 'di lta bu phebs shing yod pa yin gsungs/ dbu phyag gis 'phur zhing da ni kho bo bsdad pa la dgos pa mi 'dug gsungs nas de ma thag rtse nas phyags bteg thel nas dgon thang bar zhabs skyel mdzad/ gdan sa thel gyi go sa 'di nga la shin tu gnod par byung gsungs shing lam du'ang myur bas phebs te lha sar jo bo la rin po che'i bzhugs khri phul te yangs pa can du phebs/ rje karma pa'i drung du kong stod dam/ dwags kong gi mtshams tsam du mjal i grub smon zhes dang*/

dbon po chos skyong ba la'ang log shog gi bka' lung phebs te/ dgung lo don gnyis pa sprel lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings chen po'i klong du thim zhing sku gdung rin po che ni dngul gyi mchod rten rmad du byung ba bsgrubs par bzhugs su gsol/ mdor na rje 'di ni gsan pa rgya che zhing rnam par dag sgrub thabs rnam bshad dkyil chog dri lan la sogs pa'i bstan bcos ches mang du mdzad pa thams cad kyang tshig don bzang po zab brlings phun sum tshogs pa sha stag la/ de'i dus kyi dbus gtsang dwags kong mnga' ris phyin gyi 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal bas nyen pa thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs sbyin gnang*/ bla dpon thams cad kyi 'di dang gtan gyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gcig pur bzhugs la/ rgyal bstan gyi rtsa lag mkhan slob 'dus pa'i sde ris su ma chad pa mtha' dag la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pas yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur pa la slob ma'ang re re bzhin bgrang ba'i gnas su spyir ma lags kyi phal cher rnam thar gyi zhar du cung re smos la 'on kyang sger slob tsam gyi kha shas zur du smos na/

༈¿¿yangs can gyi 'dren pa'i gtso bo snar thang mkhan chen shes rab dpal ldan pa ni/ snar thang mkhan po dpal ldan bzang po dang*/ shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs las bka' gdams rin po che'i chos skor rnams gsan/ shākya mchog ldan dang glang thang pa las dbang lung 'ga' zhig zhus/ spyan snga rin po che dang mjal/ man ngag zab rgyas mang po stsal/ stag lung rnam rgyal grags pa dang*/ chags lo gsum pa/ zha lu lo chen/ mkhan chos grub seng ge sogs bsten/ yangs can du klog pa'i slob dpon dang*/ dus 'khor gyi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad/ phyis gdan sa'i mkhan po mdzad pas zhal slob gra ris bcas kyis rje spyan snga dang mnyam pa tsam gyi gus zhabs phul/ gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gi sprul par grags/ 'bri gung ratna/ rje dbon chos skyong*/ dhī tsha kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs kyi yongs 'dzin mdzad/ rje spyan snga rin po che gshegs pa'i rjes su yang dgongs rdzogs rten bzhengs sogs kyi thugs 'gan mdzad/ sku tshe mthar phyin/ sku gdung bzhus pa'i tshe thugs ma nyams par byon pa yang nyid kyi gzim sku'i nang rten du bzhugs so/ /de las 'phros te yangs can gyi mkhan rabs rnams skabs 'dir 'god par rigs te/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs gnyis pa/ slob dpon dge 'dun bzang po ni/ rong po 'dam du 'khrungs/ spyan snga rin po che'i zhabs phyir 'brangs/ sdom gsum rim par nod/ rig gnas kun dang gar 'chams bri thig thams cad la mkhas/ rje'i mchod shom pa yin/ rdor phreng mi tra brgya rtsa/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam/ phyag chen chos drug sogs dbang lung gi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ mkhan shes rab dpal ldan gshegs nas yangs can gyi mkhan po mdzad/ sbyor drug gi rtags rnams rdzogs/ gdan sa 'dir ras chos kyi srol btsugs/ rje brgyad pa dang zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag dbus phyogs su phebs pa'i zil ma bzod nas yangs can zhwa dmar pa yang gshegs/ rje zur pa ratna yang sprul sku 'das pas ngo skyengs nas rten mchod phyag dpe rnams bsnams te bros ma thabs su phebs skabs rje 'dis sgar dgon gyi mgo sdud mdzad/

gnam khog gi yul 'brog thams cad kyis zhabs pad spyi bor mchod/ rje yab sras lhan rgyas gdan sar spyan drangs/ zhwa dmar lnga pa seng khrir mnga' gsol gyi zhabs phyi zhus/ rje brgyad par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rgyas par phul/ khri thog tu gnam lo nyi shu bzhugs/ ba le sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ dhī tsha kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpon go shri karma bstan 'dzin sogs zhal slob kyang mang du byon no// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs gsum pa/ chos rje khyam ka ba ni/ stod lung phyam ka gong ma'i zhal ngor 'khrungs/ yangs can gyi chos grwar zhugs/ spyan snga'i zhabs zin tsam yin/ mkhan dge 'dun bzang po dang*/ snar thang mkhan chen nas spyan snga'i bka' 'bum las bshad pa'i dbang lung rnams zhus/ tshogs chen gyi byang 'dren yun ring gnang*/ mi bskyod zhabs las kyang bka' chos 'ga' re nod/ zhabs drung rin po che nas sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang skyes rab brgya rtsa sogs kyi lung zhus/ rje dkon mchog yan lag gis gdan sa'i mkhan por bskos/ lo bcu tsam du khur len mdzad/ de nas gnas nang gi mkhan por yang phebs/ 'di pa sku tshe ring po rang ma bzhugs/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bzhi pa/ drung pa legs spyad dpal bzang po ni/ khams pa ngor pa'i grwa rgyun zhig ngor du sde snod dang rgyud sde'i thugs sbyong mang po gnang*/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje dang mjal te phyag dbang thob pa tsam gyis byin rlabs zhugs/ rje yab sras las dbang lung man ngag zab rgyas su thob/ sras kyi dam par song*/ cog gra'i slob dpon du bskos/ dge 'dun rnams la cho ga'i phyag len dang thugs dam gsal 'debs sogs zhib nan gnang*/ phyag rjes kyang che/ de nas yab sras lhan rgyas yangs can du phebs skabs mkhan por mnga' gsol/ lcags ri chen po btab/ dge 'dun rnams thel lugs ltar zhwa ser dang zla gam dang*/ tshogs su dkar yol stegs bcas dang*/ rab byung rnams kyis chos gos rgyun bcang sogs kyi srol btsugs/

slob ma yang*/ ri nya mchog gyur sogs mang du byung ngo*// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs lnga pa/ chos rje karma phun tshogs ni/ tre shod khang dmar du rje spyan snga'i dbon rigs su 'khrungs/ rje dkon mchog yan lag gi drung nas tshigs gsum rim nod du bsnyen par rdzogs/ ming karma phun tshogs su gnang*/ rdor phreng*/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs dang*/ phyag chen chos drug sbyor drug sogs zhus/ cog gra'i sgrig la zhugs/ de nas yangs can gyi khrir phebs/ spyan snga'i dbon rigs yin pa sogs chos sdes mthong bkur che/ tshogs khro chen mo bzos/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho sogs la mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang bskur/ byang nas dkar me'i rten rnyed tshol rgya chen bsgrubs/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug seng khrir spyan 'dren pa'i zhabs phyi zhus/ lo bcu drug tu gdan sa'i khur len gnang*/ de nas gdan sa thel dang thar pa gling gi 'dren pa mdzad/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs drug pa/ ba le pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang ni/ ba le ston pa shākya rin chen gyi dbon rgyud du gnam khog 'brog sder 'khrungs/ sngon gnas mang po dran rgyal tshab 'od srungs kyis rjes bzung byams pa'i bshes gnyen/ slob dpon padmas rjes bzung sangs rgyas ye shes/ dbon gyis rjes bzung shākya rin chen/ chos sku o rgyan mgon po/ yu mo'i sras chos dbang sogs yin pa dran/ mi bskyod zhabs la skra phud phul/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang du btags/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub/ bde mchog lha lnga/ gsang 'dus gnyis sogs kyi dbang dang*/ yab kyi drung nas stag lung pa'i zab chos rnams dang rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi drung du dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ mtshan rnam rgyal rin chen dpal bzang por gsol/ bde mchog phag mo sogs dang*/ kun dga' bkra shis kyi drung nas/ bde mchog nag po pa sogs dang*/ mkhan dge 'dun bzang po las dus 'khor dang rngog dkyil/

spyan snga'i bka' 'bum lung sogs dang*/ gtsug lag phreng ba las sems bskyed sogs dang*/ dkon mchog yan lag drung nas/ mi tra/ sbyong dkyil sogs zhus/ rje 'di gnas nang gi 'dren par bsko bzhag gnang*/ rje dgu pa/ zhwa dmar drug pa/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ 'bri gung ratna/ rje grol mchog sogs las dbang lung 'ga' re gsan/ rta rdzi sogs su sgrub pa mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang dang bka' brgyud gong ma/ bla ma mtshan brgyad/ re ma ti rnams zhal gzigs/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang yangs can gyi dbu mdzad sogs la dus 'khor sogs kyi dbang lung mang po mdzad/ de nas yangs can gyi mkhan por phebs/ chos sder dbang lung brtse gzigs gang zab gnang bas phyag rjes che/ stag lung du phebs nas zhabs drung khu dbon la dbang lung lhag ma rnams phul/ dgung lo re brgyad par sku gshegs so// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bdun pa/ chos rje do bo ri pa ni/ legs bshad gling du zhugs/ mdo phyogs kyi sbyangs pa mthar phyin rab 'byams grwa skor gnang*/ yab sras rnams las bsnyen rdzogs dang*/ dbang khrid mang po nod/ g.yung do bo ri'i 'dren pa mdzad/ sog po'i rgyal po kha dan gyi bla mar phebs/ pha bla ma zhes bskur bzos zhus/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug gis yangs can gyi mkhan por bskor pa yin no// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs brgyad pa/ chos rje karma tshul khrims ni/ stod lung du 'khrungs/ yangs can sgrig la zhugs/ zhwa dmar lnga pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ mi tra brgya rtsa dang dus 'khor sogs kyi dbang khrid lag len bcas zhus/ yangs can pa'i dbu mdzad gnang*/ zhwa dmar drug pa gdan sar phebs nas sgrub mchod rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad/ de nas rje 'di mkhan por bskos/ rje dgu pa/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen ba le pa rnams las dbang khrid phal cher zhus/ mkhan 'di'i dus tshogs pa rgyas shing chog grwa 'grigs pa/

gdul bya rgyas pa/ rje bcu pa spyan 'dren la khams su phebs/ gdan sa lo bcu gsum du mdzad do// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs dgu pa/ ma ṇi ba ni/ gnam khog tu 'khrungs/ yangs can gyi sgrig la zhugs/ zhwa dmar lnga pa'i drung nas sdom pa gsum ka nod/ mtshan dkon mchog bsam 'grub tu gnang*/ gar dbang drug pa'i skabs sgar gyi ma ṇi ba mdzad/ gsung skad bzang ba'i zi thogs/ sgar gyi chos khrims pa yang gnang*/ rje yab sras bzhi dang*/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan las dbang khrid rnams zhus/ tsa rir zhing skyaung dang dpa' bo dpa' mos bsu ba byed pa gzigs/ de nas yangs can gyi mkhan por bskos/ nus mthu che/ de skabs sog dmag gis sde yul rnams bcom pa'i skabs yin yang gdan sa 'di ni 'di pas bde bar skyong thub pa yin/ gdan sar lo bdun du bzhugs/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bcu pa/ dbon go shrī ni/ dbon nam rin pa'i sras su stod lung du 'khrungs/ rje dgu pa las sdom gsum rim nod mdzad/ mtshan karma chos rgyal zhes btags/ gdan sa dga' ldan ma mor go shrī'i las ka bcas bskos/ de nas gnas nang gi 'dren pa yang gnang*/ drung pa tsher lung pa las nyams khrid mang po zhus/ de nas yangs can gyi gdan sar bskos/ sgrig rnam bzhag skong gso'i dbyangs gdangs sogs btsugs/ sprul sku ba nam mkha' bkra shis kyi phyag ris si thang lugs kyi gnas bcu'i sku thang sogs spyi bzhag mdzad/ gdan sar lo drug bzhugs/ de nas gar dbang drug pa'i phyag mdzod yun ring mdzad/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bcu gcig pa/ ba le rab 'byams pa ni/ stag lung rnam rgyal dpal bzang gi sku tsha yin/ 'og min gling du byon/ rje dgu pa las rab tu byung*/ mtshan karma mkhyen brtser gnang*/ zhwa dmar lnga pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ ka chen bzhi la slob gnyer mdzad/ rab 'byams kyi gra skor gnang*/ sog po'i rgyal pos spyan drangs nas sog yul du phebs/ spyod 'jug sog skad du bsgyur/

der karma pa'i bstan pa btsugs zang zing gi longs spyod char ltar babs/ yangs can dang stag lung du 'bul chen bstabs/ yangs can gyi mkhan por bskos/ lo ngo drug la bzhugs/ sog dmag gi skabs ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub gdan sar spyan drangs nas thabs mkhas gnang bas sog dmag gis gnod pa ma byung ngo*// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bcu gnyis pa/ chos rgyal pho brang ba ni/ chos rgyal pho brang du 'khrungs/ dga' tshal gyi slob dpon phyogs glang pa dang*/ 'brug pa'i bla ma zhig gi sku skye yin pa'i ngos 'dzin dang*/ rje thams can mkhyen pas rgya gar gyi slob dpon ratna bardha'i skye ba yin par gsungs/ rje dgu pa'i drung du skra phud phul/ karma 'jigs med du gnang*/ gar dbang drug pa'i spos 'dzin pa mdzad/ yab sras rnams las rang lugs kyi dbang lung thams cad gsan/ sdom gsum rim nod du mdzad/ rig gnas dang bri thig dbyangs gsum la mkhas/ e pa drung yig pa dang*/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon pa las dbang lung mang du gsan/ zhwa dmar rin po che gar phebs pa thams cad du phebs/ rje bcu pas yangs can mkhan por bskos/ kharkha ar sa long gi dmag byung zhing*/ 'di dge phyogs la sdang che/ kar lugs la dad pa'i khung yin yang gdan sa'i ru bar gnod tshab che zhing mkhan po 'di par yang thugs so mi sod pa kho na byas/ dus phyis kyi ma legs pa'i gzhi yang mtha' mi 'dis byas pa yin/ mkhan po 'dis li ma lha khang du li ma brgya skor sogs bsags par mdzad gdan sar lo drug bzhugs/ sbrul lor o rod kyi dpung chen lhags te bod yul bdag gir mdzad skabs/ stag lung rin po che dang*/ rgyal tshab rin po che gtsang phyogs su phebs/ dbyings pa mchog nas kar lugs pa'i chos sde rnams la bkod 'doms gang yod la mkhan po 'dis thugs khur gang gzabs gnang*/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bcu gsum pa/ karma tshul khrims phyi ma ni/ bra bo 'brog sder 'khrungs/ yangs can gyi sgrig la zhugs/

mkhan po las dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhus/ mtshan karma tshul khrims zhes gnang*/ dus 'khor dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs kyi dbang bskur ba sogs zhus/ 'don chos bri thig dbyangs gdangs sogs byang bar mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang po/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub sogs la chos 'brel zhus/ mkhan po pho brang ba las dbang lung mang du zhus/ ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub drung nas bde mchog lha lnga sogs dbang lung mang du zhus/ yangs can mkhan por bskos/ gzhung sa nas lcags ri rmang nas bsgyel ba'i bka' phebs par/ sle'u chung pas bzhengs pa'i 'jigs mdzad dngul sku bu chung lo brgyad pa tsam gyis gtsos rta khrab gos dar sogs phul nas 'dam phyed de'i dpangs lhag mar lus pa 'di'o// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bcu bzhi pa/ bla ma stag tshang pa ni/ stag tshang pa'i dbon rigs su 'khrungs/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal las rab tu byung*/ mtshan ngag dbang bkra shis btags/ stag lung grwa tshang du zhugs/ ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ phyag chen chos drug sogs zhus/ gar dbang drug pa'i drung nas dus 'khor gyi dbang zhus/ shag ram du sgrub par bzhugs pas yangs can bas bla ma 'di zhus pas rgyal tshab rin po che gsang dbyings pa nas kyang bka' lon te mkhan por bskos/ gdan sar lo drug bzhugs/ de nas gnam mtsho do dang*/ lha nang shel phug tu lo bzhi tsam sku mtshams gnang*/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bco lnga pa/ karma nyi ma ni/ bkra shis mthong smon du 'khrungs/ zhwa dmar drug pa'i drung du gtsug phud phul/ mtshan karma nyi mar btags/ de nas rab byung gi sdom pa stsal/ karma pa bcu pa dang*/ zhwa dmar drug pa/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho rnams kyi drung nas dbang lung 'ga' re thob/ drung yig blo gros nor ldan las zab khrid thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du nod/ gtsang du zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung nas/ rgyal tshab rin po che sogs dang lhan cig rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur lung sogs dbang lung rgya mtsho tsam thob pa'i thob yig pu sti zhig 'dug go/

gar dbang drug pa'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa zhus/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang*/ kun rig gi dbang stsal/ byang sdom lugs gnyis phyag chen dang chos drug gi smin khrid zhus te nyams len tshad du phyin pa dang ras bud kho na mdzad/ rje tā ra nā thar yang chos 'brel zhus lcags stag gi lor rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs kyis yangs can gyi mkhan por bskos/ 'dus sde dang phyogs 'dus rnams la dus 'khor/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ bde mchog lha lnga/ phag mo hriḥskyed ma lha lnga/ 'dus pa lugs gnyis/ rngog lugs dgyes rdor/ mā yā/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu lnga/ 'chi 'joms/ kun rig sgrol ma brgya rtsa/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus zhi drag tshe gsum/ rtsa gsum dril bsgrub/ ma mgon 'khor lnga/ tshe ring ma/ thig le bcu drug brda bzhi'i dbang*/ me dbar dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang bka' brgyud gong ma'i bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung sogs gnang*/ sku tshe yang mthar phyin te zhi dbyings su gshegs so/ /mkhan po karma phrin las sogs zhal slob kyang du ma byung zhing*/ rje 'di ni rang lugs kyi bstan pa la bka' drin shin tu che zhing da lta rgyud sde rin po che'i dbang lung gi rgyun bzhugs pa 'di dag ni rje 'di yi thugs rje'o//

༈¿¿mkhan rabs bcu drug pa/ karma thos pa rgya mtsho ni/ stag lung pa'i lha dbang zhig tu 'khrungs/ zhwa dmar drug pa dang stag lung khu dbon las sdom gsum rim par nod drung yig chos rje'i drung nas phyag chen dang chos drug zhus/ sgrub pa kho na mdzad/ rje grags pa mchog dbyangs kyis yangs can mkhan por bskos/ zhwa dmar ye shes snying po mjal/ ༈¿¿gdan rabs bcu bdun pa/ karma gnas brtan ni/ gnam lci ba steng du 'khrungs/ rgyal tshab pa dang drung yig pa las sdom gsum rim nod du zhus/ sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ mkhan por phebs/ rje chos dbyings rdo rje dang zhwa dmar ye shes snying po mjal nas zhabs brtan phul/ ༈¿¿gdan rabs bco brgyad pa/ nya ri bla ma ni/ rje drug pa'i zhal slob rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhen med ras pa zhes rig pa brtul zhugs spyad pa'i rig ma/ en cha tshan ma zhes par dmar gan khang gi nye skor sa phug la bzhugs skabs tshes dgu zhig la cha tshan ma chang mgyogs par tshos/ tshes bcu'i tho rengs tshogs 'khor byed gsungs/ chang gi ro gzhan dang mi 'dra bar langs 'dug pa tshogs 'khor mdzad/ rje rang gis mang du bzhes/ thod phor gang a ner gnang nas de ring dag pa mkha' spyod la 'gro ba yin phyis yangs can gyi khrir sleb par 'dug de dus khyod kyang dge slong gtsang ma zhig tu skye nga dang 'phrad 'ong gsungs nas sku gshegs so// de nas dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung nya ri'i brgyud par bsam bzhin du skye ba zhes/ rgyal tshab drung nas sdom gsum rims nod mdzad/ yangs can sgrig la zhugs/ rtse thang zhabs drung las yab mes kyi chos skor dang sa phur sogs gsan/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ nged rang gi dbon dri ma med pa yin pas mchog dman kun gyis bla mar 'khur dgos kyi bka' phebs/ yangs can mkhan por mnga' gsol/ lo lngar gdan sa'i khur bzhes/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs bcu dgu pa/ chos rje karma phrin las gsum pa ni/

gnam lha brgyad kyi sar lcags lug lor 'khrungs/ ba le rab 'byams par skra phud phul/ mtshan karma phrin las su gsol/ nyi shu lon tshe rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs kyi drung nas gcig rdzogs mdzad/ bde mchog lha lnga/ phyag chen dang chos drug gi khrid zhus/ karma nyi ma'i drung nas/ dus 'khor/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang sogs gsan/ sgrol ma brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang*/ ma mgon 'khor lnga/ tshe ring ma'i bka' gtad sogs dang*/ sems 'grel skor gsum/ thar rgyan/ bka' gdams glegs bam/ spyan snga'i bka' 'bum yongs tshang sogs dbang lung gi gsan rgya che/ lo bco lngar sku mtshams kho na mdzad/ rje ye shes snying pos yangs can mkhan por bskos/ gdan sa'i mkhan po lo drug mdzad/ rgyal tshab nor bu bzang por dbang chos du ma dang*/ rje bcu gcig par dus kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyud sde'i dbang dang*/ lung thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du phul/ dgung lo bdun cur mya ngan las 'das/ rje 'di pa rang lugs kyi rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dbang lung gi rgyun la thugs drin shin tu che zhing rje yab sras kyi dbu bla'i gral yin cing phrin las gsum pa zhu ba yin no// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs nyi shu pa/ go shri karma bstan srung ni/ yar lung sde pa dgon stod nas kyi sras su 'khrungs/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i drung nas sdom gsum rim nod mdzad/ rgyal tshab sku gshegs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mtshur phu go shrī'i las ka gnang nas mtshur phu'i gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong mdzad/ zhwa dmar bdun pa gdan sar phebs skabs/ rje bcu pa'i sku gdung dang rgyal tshab sprul sku gdan sar phebs chog pa ni rje 'di gzhung sa rin po che dang thugs 'dris zab pa'i bka' drin las byung*/ zhwa dmar pa'i bkas yangs can mkhan por bskos/ rgyal dbang bcu gcig pa khams nas phebs skabs yangs can du spyan drangs nas zhabs brtan sogs phul/

༈¿¿mkhan rabs nyer gcig pa/ karma rab 'byor ni/ mkhan po nyi ma las rab byung dang*/ mkhan po karma thos pa las bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ karma phrin las drung nas zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung zhus/ 'chams dpon dang dbu mdzad gnang*/ yangs can gyi mkhan po mdzad pa yin/ ༈¿¿mkhan rabs nyer gnyis pa/ karma bde mchog ni/ karma thos pa las bsnyen rdzogs dang*/ karma phrin las drung nas spyan snga'i bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs dbang lung thams cad zhus/ yangs can gyi mkhan po mdzad pa yin cing*/ 'di skabs yangs can lcags zam sprul sku blo gsal nyi zla 'od 'bar la lcags po ri'i sa tshab tu gnang 'dug kyang*/ 'di pas zhu grogs mdzad nas zhwa dmar ye shes snying po'i phyag tu sbrul lor rtsis sprod gnang ba yin no// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs nyer gsum pa/ ding ri ba karma rnam grol mchog gi sde ni/ chu dbar rdor 'dzin karma bdud rtsi las tshigs gsum rim nod bcas zhus/ mtshan karma rnam grol mchog gi sde zhes gsol/ ding ri mkhan chen sogs yongs 'dzin du ma bsten/ sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ zhwa dmar brgyad pa nas/ spyan snga'i gzim dpon dang*/ mkhan po pho brang ba karma 'jigs med kyi skye ba yin tshul gsungs/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po mdzad/ zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gyi dbang lung thams cad phul/ khams su rje bcu gnyis pa spyan 'dren la phebs nas kun spangs mdzad pa'i ngos nas sku gshegs so// ༈¿¿mkhan rabs nyer bzhi pa/ go shrī karma don grub snying po ni/ zhwa dmar brgyad pas/ grags seng ba'i dngos slob lta rje g.ya' bzang ba/ de nas zhwa dmar gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i skabs ba yo chos bzang*/ spyan snga'i skabs gnas nang pa dge 'dun bzang po/ zhwa dmar lnga pa'i skabs gu'i gung pa mchod sprin rgya mtsho/ rje drug pa'i skabs 'jam dbyangs pa sogs yin tshul bka' stsal pa dang*/ rje nyid kyis rgya gar du bram ze'i paṇḍi ta padma'i snying po zhes bya ba zhig yin pa dran pa dang*/

gnas nang pa dge 'dun bzang pos yangs can du phag mo'i dbang mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor skabs grwa pa zhig la zhing skyong babs nas/ bdag ni mkhan pos ga ya dha ra sku bskyod 'tshal gsungs pas 'ong ba yin zhes dang*/ lung bstan mang po dang*/ mkhan po'i skye ba phyi ma 'ga' sa 'dir 'ong*/ bstan la phan khyab che zhes gsungs so// rje 'di'i gdung rus ni g.yu thog yab a sngon/ yum lha 'dzom ma'i sras su shing 'brug la g.yang rar 'khrungs/ karma thos par skra phud phul/ mtshan karma skyes mchog gsol/ grwa sa'i 'don chos bri thig thams cad la mkhas par mdzad/ dkon mchog 'gro phan dbang po tshe dbang brtan pa las gso ba rig pa dang 'bri khung dgongs gcig sogs zhus/ rgyal tshab nor bu bzang po'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang*/ phyag chen lnga ldan/ blo sbyong don bdun sogs zhus/ karma phrin las drung nas dus 'khor/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ bde mchog lha lnga/ bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil/ phag mo bam̐ bskyed ma dang*/ hrīḥbaskyed ma lha lnga/ me dbang*/ rngog lugs dgyes rdor lha dgu gshed dmar lha lnga/ tshe dpag lha dgu kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ gcod dbang sogs dang*/ phyag bzhi pa'i bum dbang bcu bzhi pa/ ma mgon 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang sogs dang*/ rje ye shes snying po las byang sdom lugs gnyis sogs zhus/ phyag chen dang chos drug gi nyams bzhes dang sku mtshams kho na gnang*/ bal yul du zhwa dmar brgyad par ja 'dren la phebs/ rang byung gi mchod rten sogs mjal/ stag rtse pa mi pham shes rab las ras chung lugs kyi gtum po lha lnga'i dbang sogs dbang lung mang po zhus/ yangs can gyi dbu mdzad dang slob dpon sbrags rgyag gnang*/ 'di skabs lcags zam par yangs can lcags ri'i sa tshab tu gnang ba'i skabs yin kyang rje 'dis thabs mkhas kyis rje lcags zam pa dang grogs su 'thams pas gdag pa 'di zhwa dmar phyag tu thob pa yin/ rje ye shes rdo rje'i drung nas dri med 'od dang*/

thar rgyan sogs kyi lung mang po nod/ zhwa dmar brgyad pa gdan sar spyan 'dren pa'i zhabs phyi 'byor zhing zhabs pad du rgyun bzhugs mdzad/ tre ho chos kyi dbang po'i drung nas ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang sogs dbang lung mang po stsal/ dul mo dar rgyas las dbang lung mang du gsan par mdzad/ zhwa dmar brgyad par/ dus 'khor/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ bde mchog lha lnga/ phag mo lha lnga sogs rang lugs kyi dbang lung thams cad phul/ na lend+ra'i chos rje mkhyen rab ngag dbang mkhyen brtse las rdo rje phreng ba rgyud sde phyes pa'i lugs/ dar pan gyi bya btus dang chu bo gnyis 'dres lugs de dang sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang bskur zhus/ rab 'byams ratna'i mtshan can drung nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur lung gsan/ zhwa dmar sku zhabs su rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang dang sbyong dkyil gyi dbang sogs phul/ mkhan po rnam grol las do ha skor gsum sogs zhus/ gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung nas mkha' spyod dbang po dang dkon mchog yan lag gi bka' 'bum lung zhus/ de nas go shrī'i go sar dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ /rje 'di ni zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang lung gi pho nya ba mdzad nas rje'i yongs 'dzin du gyur pa yin no// ༈¿¿zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje ni/ yab rig 'dzin phun tshogs dang yum dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi lcam sring ma gnyis la sras gsum yod pa'i che ba yin/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i skye ba dngos yin pa'i bag chags dran cing dgung lo bzhi bzhes tshe yum gnyan kha med bsnyun par sman dpyad mdzad pas sos pa na bzung gso dpyad kyi 'gro don mdzad pas a bo chos rjer grags/ khrus khang lo tsā ba sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang du bsten/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs du ma gsan/ khyad par du spyan snga chos kyi grags pa nyid skye ba du ma nas dpon slob kyi 'grel pa zab par dgongs nas rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten/

nā ro chos drug dang dpal mkha' spyod pa'i zab khrid skor dang phag mo brda bzhi'i dbang sogs gsan/ sngon rgya gar du/ spyan snga nyid paṇa chen nyi ma'i snying por gyur tshe/ kha che zla dgar gyur/ rdo rje gdan du sngags 'chang gzi brjid can du gyur skabs/ pa ra mi ta zhes bya ba dang*/ bal yul du shrī dhwa dza zhes bya ba'i skabs/ gzungs ldan zhes bya ba dang*/ bod yul du sprul pa'i skur bstan tshe lha gzigs zhes bya ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na mi bskyod rdo rje'i dus su blo gros rgyal por 'gyur ba dpon slob gnyis kas mkhyen/ klu'i pho brang gser dang*/ nor bu rin po che bzhes/ zur mkhar gyi brag rta mgor rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor mang po gter du sbas pa sogs grub pa'i spyod pa dang*/ mdo sngags gsar rnying gi bstan bcos du ma dang*/ gso rig skor la bye ba ring bsrel dang ma nu'i dris lan dang sman ngo gsal byed sogs kyi bstan bcos mang po mdzad/ u rgyan chen po dang*/ g.yu thog pa sogs lhag pa'i lha mang po zhal gzigs/ dbyar dus 'tsho byed rnams la ldum sman gyi ngo sprod gnang nas ro nus sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ dgun dus thal sman khaṇḍa sogs dang cha dpyad kyi phyag len sogs dang phyag rdzogs zhi gcod sogs kyi khrid tshul gyis slob ma rnams 'khrid par mdzad/ slob ma yang*/ gso rig phyogs la yang mi 'gyur tshe brtan/ phrag dbon bsod bkras bshad mkhas padma tshe 'bum rdo rje sogs thugs sras bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang byin rlabs zhugs pa'i slob ma brgyad/ shes rab can gyi slob ma bcu drug grags ldan gyi slob ma nyi shu/ bla dgas can gyi slob ma bco brgyad sogs byon pa yin no/ /de ltar zhwa dmar bzhi pa spyan snga rin po che'i slob ma dang yang slob ches mang ngo*// ༈¿¿rje dus mkhyen gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi gdan sa lnga las/ khyad par du gsung gi gdan sa gdan sa bar par grags pa'i gdan sa pa karma si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor ni/

sgar du chos don gnyer 'dus pa thams cad la'ang dbang chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ khyad par drung nyid kyi lung bstan la brten rje brgyad pa'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin dang zhabs tog gi thog ma mdzad pas kar bstan la phyag rjes che/ spyir yang de'i dus rje thams cad mkhyen pa zhag 'ga' zung na zhal mjal lan re las mi yong zhing gsung chos ci rigs pa thob dka' zhing dbang dang gdams ngag thugs nyams kyi zab khrid bla lhag pas skal ldan gyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing smin par mdzad pa las/ chos kyi thob rgya 'dod pa rnams go'i shri rin po che dang drung si tu pa sku mched 'brong bu go shri rnams la zhu/ khrid dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs rnams rje btsun skya ses mdzad pas rje phrin las pa sogs kyi gsan yig na yang rnam bshad dang lung phal mo che 'di dag las brgyud pa shas che'o// ༈¿¿'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal ni/ yul rgya smad lha khang gi mda' ngam pa ra'i grong nag mo 'bum khyim du/ yab 'gos ston 'byung gnas rdo rje dang*/ yum sri thar skyid gnyis kyi sras su chu sprel la 'khrungs/ spyan g.yas mkhan chen las rab tu byung*/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa las rtses thang du/ byang sdom dang*/ chos drug smin khrid du zhus/ rje blo bzang grags pa la nā ro chos drug dang lam rim gsan/ rngog byang chub dpal la rngog chos thams cad dang*/ paṇa chen nags rin las mi g.yo bla med/ rdo rje phreng ba bla med kho nar byed pa rdor phreng rang lugs dang*/ grwa lnga/ dgyes rdor/ bde mchog lū yi pa'i dbang sogs gsan/ sku chung ngu nas snar thang saṅga shrīr sgra kā lā pa gsan nas lo tsā byang bar mkhyen pas/ paṇa chen ba na ratna'i drung nas mi g.yo bla med kyi rgyud dang*/ mtshan brjod dang dpyid thig gi 'grel pa/ dbang mdor bstan/ dpe med 'tsho'i sbyong drug rtsa 'grel rnams gsan cing bsgyur/ rje 'di la paṇa chen nas bsngags brjod dpe med mdzad 'dug

tā ra nā thas 'gos los phyag chen gyi zhen rke chad chad la 'then kyin bsdad pas paṇa chen 'di dang thug pa na sngags rgyud rgya mtsho tsam bshol 'dug gsungs pa de'o// dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer las dar pan gyi bya btus sogs dang*/ zhwa dmar chos dpal ye shes las chos drug zhus/ zhwa dmar spyan snga'i bsnyen rdzogs gyi mkhan po mdzad/ sems 'grel skor dang gzhan yang dbang khrid du ma zhus/ tshur yang mkha' spyod dbang po'i rims lnga dang*/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi smin khrid/ rlung sems gnyis med dang sbyor drug gi khrid dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang dang rgyud 'grel/ phag mo snying thig ber nag can gyi dbang dang gdams ngags thams cad rdzogs par zhus/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho la sems 'grel skor gsum dbang khrid mang po phul/ dgung lo dgu bcu tham pa me glang la sku gshegs so// ༈¿¿lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde ni/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi rigs brgyud rig 'dzin bsod nams 'od zer dang*/ yum dpal ldan 'dzom gyi sras su shing 'brug la 'khrungs/ brag nag pa mgon rgyal bas mtshan bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde zhes gsol/ dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal las rab tu byung*/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho la/ byams chos/ rigs tshogs/ 'jug pa/ spyod 'jug bzhi brgya pa/ mngon pa gong 'og sogs gsan/ tshogs chen pa'i mkhan po don dpal bas bsnyen par rdzogs/ khams su 'bul sdud la 'byon pa'i phyir/ 'jam dbyangs don grub 'od zer las nyer mkho'i dbang lung 'ga' re zhu ba la byon pas/ mkhyen rtogs kyi yon tan la mgu ste/ zab mo nang don sogs zab chos thams cad zhus pas nang don la zin bris mdzad/ 'gos lo tsā las lo tsā bslabs/ paṇa chen nags rin las/ bde mchog me tri bcu gsum ma dang dus 'khor gyi dbang dang sbyor drug gi khrid dang āryaya de ba'i snying po brgya pa rnams gsan/

dri med 'od kyi dka' gnas rnams la 'dri gtugs mdzad/ zhwa dmar spyan snga las phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang nā ro chos drug gi smin khrid sogs gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ phar la 'ang rngog dkyil bdun sogs phul/ rje 'di bal yul du phebs nas paṇa chen rin po che las sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gi ye shes brnyes/ sbyor drug gi man ngag thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang*/ shānta pu rir shā wa ri pas byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba'i sbyor drug gi zab khrid kyang phul ba sogs dpon slob thun mong min par gyur/ gro bo lung du rje mar pa zhal gzigs so/ /thugs dam gyi mthil ni dus 'khor kho na mdzad/ dgung lo nga dgu pa chu stag la gshegs/

༈¿¿skyabs che rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni/ rus 'gru/ gser gyi nang tshan skyabs che a bes dang*/ bkra shis mtsho'i sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig thog sog por rta jag la phebs pas jag nyes/ dgung lo bcu gsum thog 'bri bcu jag par thob pas byang du sog dmag gi so par sku rkyang du phebs pas byang thang stong zhig tu spyang kus bzar nye ba byung bas/ nam 'chi ba'i tshe 'di ltar gcig pur nyam thag par 'gro dgos snyam pa thugs la shar nas chos byed pa'i dam bca' mdzad/ tshur 'khor nas 'bri bcu blangs pho rgod pa'i khrom thog chod/ dgung lo bcu bzhir 'ba' brom bga' drug pa'i sar chos bros la byon kyang pha tshan thu bas skra gcod ma nus/ bcu dgur ban sgar pa'i drung du phebs nas rab byung mdzad/ pha tshan rnams ram mdar thon nas rje ban sgar ba la dkrong bsdigs btang mod nga'i rkub la rgyob gsungs nas nyal bzhugs pas byar med de log rang song*/ de nas bla ma'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ chos mang du gsan/ khyad par gcod skor rnams zhus/ nyin gcig bla mas/ lta ba ni smyon pa'i skad cha dang 'dra/ /sgom pa ni rgan mo'i mel tshe dang 'dra/ /sems nyid 'di sa mdo'i srang khyi dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pas de nyid du gnas lugs kyi don 'phrod/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa la/ phyag chen skor sogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs don grub 'od zer las dbang dang rgyud bshad/ chos drug sogs zhus/ bsgoms pas nyams rtogs bzang po 'khrungs/ brag dkar chos sding pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la tshe khrid sogs gsan/ bcud len kho na las sha chang sogs mi zas mi bzhes/ lha phu/ jo mo gangs/ gnam mtsho do/ ti sgro/ sham po gangs/ la phyi/ dom tshong rong sogs su dben pa kho na bsten/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu ni rje chos grags rgya mtsho rang yin/ dbang lung gdams ngag thams cad dang khyad par gcod kyi nyams khrid mdzad nas gtso bor gcod kyi nyams bzhes mdzad/

ma gcig dngos dang mjal nas gcod kyi gdams pa rnams zhus/ khros nag /yum chen mo/ sgrol ma/ bde mchog /dgyes rdor/ thub pa/ byams mgon/ rigs gsum mgon po rnams zhal gzigs/ mtshur phu/ karma/ stag lung sogs kar lugs kyi dgon rnying mang por nyams gso dang dar rgyas mdzad/ gnas sgo gu shrī/ zur mang gu shrī/ lcags mo gu shrī/ lho rong gu shrī sogs sku drag mang po'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po mdzad/ karma pa'i drung du gser zho lnga brgya la brdung ba'i nor bu sogs 'bul chen dang 'bul phran mang po phul/ stag lung dang ra sgreng gi gser tog sogs dang*/ jo bo rin po cher gser zho sum brgya las grub pa'i 'khor lo phul/ karma pa'i dgongs rdzogs la dbus gtsang gi dgon sde rnams la gser zho re'i phyag 'gyed btang*/ khams kyi 'bri chu la gru pas ma phud pas 'phur te phebs/ gtsang du bya rgod du sprul pa dang*/ nam mkha' la byon pa dang*/ la mo tsher gseb nas se mo dor ja yun gcig la phebs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa ni brjod kyis mi langs/ dus kun tu chab len zla phyed kyi gso sbyong sogs/ nyan thos chen po'i brtul zhugs las mi 'da' dgung lo brgya dang drug la kong po brag gsum zho khar sku mya ngan las 'das/ sku gdung bzhus pas ring bsrel mang po dang*/ dbu thod la/ thub pa grong khyer ma/ snying po kye rdo rje yab yum/ spyan ras gzigs 'gro 'dul dang*/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ hrīḥrnams dang*/ gdung rus rnams la yig 'bru byon pa yang du ma byung ngo*/ /rje 'di'i zhal slob ni tre ho chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs skyes bu dam pa mang po byon/ skra 'dzin dang rab byung gnang ba'i slob ma ni bgrang las 'das so// ༈¿¿tre ho chos kyi rgya mtsho ni/ khams shar zla'i rgyud/ hor ba'i dur gyi gdung brgyud yab dpon khro skyabs/ yum bsod nams sgron gyi sras su 'khrungs/

bla ma nam mkha' dbang phyug la skra phud phul/ mtshan bkra shis dbang phyug tu gsol/ dgung lo brgyad pa la kun dga' bzang po zer ba'i sde bla zhig gi zhabs phyi la thegs/ phyi lo dbus gtsang du phebs/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa dang mjal/ do ha skor gsum sogs zhus/ mtshur phur phebs/ sangs bsam pa dang mjal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs zhus/ skyabs che 'jam dpal rgya mtsho mjal/ rab tu byung bar mdzad/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i drung nas karma pakṣi dang*/ don ldan zhabs dang rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung stsal/ gzhan yang dwags po bka' 'bum/ bka' brgyud gser phreng rnams kyi lung*/ ber nag can dang rang byung ma'i dbang*/ gtum mo'i me dbang rnams gsan/ de nas khams su phebs/ khu bo bla ma blo gros las phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid/ gcod stan thog gcig ma/ mi la'i mgur 'bum/ 'brug lugs kyi bka' 'bum phal cher gyi lung*/ gcod khrid skor brul tsho drug sogs dang*/ ras chung snyan brgyud/ de nas gling dpon gyis skyabs che rtogs ldan spyan 'dren gyi bod mir karmar phebs/ bla ma ye shes rdo rje la bka' 'gyur lung zhus/ nag rgyal phag gsum sogs kyi dbang rnams kyang gsan/ phyi lo skyabs che rtogs ldan phebs byung ba mjal bas gcod skor rnams zhus/ gzhan yang rdor phreng*/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs dang bka' brgyud gong ma'i bka' 'bum sogs kyi lung rnams gsan/ de nas 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabs phyi mdzad de/ tsandan dgon/ re rgyab/ khra bo dgon rnams su phebs/ skyabs che rtogs ldan drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas chos rje tre chenadang lhan cig tsā rir phebs/ g.yu mtshor karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ mgon po phyag bzhi drug /rang byung rgyal mo rnams zhal gzigs/ de nas sna phur skyabs che rtogs ldan dang mjal/ gcod kyi rnam bshad chen mo dang*/

skyob pa dang*/ khro lo'i bka' 'bum sogs dbang khrid lung sogs mang po zhus/ chos grags rgya mtsho gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su bka' 'gyur zhig bzhengs nas zhwa dmar spyan sngar phul/ jo bo la gser gdugs phul/ lha phu gser 'bum du bzhugs dus gnyan thang lha 'khor bcas kyi mjal/ thugs rje chen po'i bsgom lung gnang*/ mtshur phu'i bla ma smon lam pa'i drung nas/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ lū nag bril gsum/ gshed skor dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ 'dus pa 'phags zhabs sogs gsar rnying gi dbang lung mang po gsan/ bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan la rnying ma'i skor mang po dang*/ rje bdun pa nas brgyud pa'i/ rdor phreng*/ mi tre/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs dang*/ zur mang snyan brgyud skor dang*/ snye bo/ bkra shis don grub pa las/ rta mgrin lcags ral gyi rjes gnang sogs zhus/ de nas skyabs che rtogs ldan sku gshegs/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan las/ shang chos sogs zhus/ karma phrin las pa'i drung nas/ phag mo lha lnga'i dbang dang lha khrid/ don ldan zhabs kyi bka' 'bum/ ngam rdzong snyan rgyud/ mi tra khrid drug sogs gsan/ bsam gtan gling pa'i drung nas/ thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid sogs zhus/ bla ma rin chen rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum sogs dang*/ smyug la paṇa chen nas/ bka' gdams glegs bam sogs dang*/ zhwa dmar spyan snga rin po che las/ grags seng bka' 'bum dang mkha' spyod pa'i bka' 'bum/ chos dpal ye shes kyi bka' 'bum las pu sti re re'i lung*/ rje rang gi khrid skor dang*/ chos drug lung sbyor sogs kyi lung dang*/ gnas nang pa nam mkha' 'od zer las dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs dang*/ don grub rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas gur drag 'o bran lugs/ chos rje rnam rgyal grags pa'i drung nas/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i skor/ byang sems thar pa rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas/ thar rgyan gyi lung dang*/

'bri khung rin po che'i drung nas dgongs gcig sogs zhus so// de nas ri khrod kho nar bcud len gyis 'tsho bar bzhugs/ ra sgreng du jo bo rje ra sgreng gi rgyab ri dang mnyam pa dang mtshur phu'i rgyab ri thams cad mi g.yo ba dkar po dang*/ sngon po mang pos gang ba zhal gzigs/ rtsig pa sogs la zang thal du mdzad/ mchog gong du dpal lha mo dang*/ ber nag can phyogs bcu mgon pos bskor ba dang*/ phyag drug pa/ stag zhon sogs zhal gzigs/ kṣe tra pā la/ dzi na mi tra/ ṭākki rā dza sogs dang*/ phyag drug pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ gri gug zhing skyong*/ trakṣad/ mgon po gur zhal rnams zhal gzigs/ mon mtsho snar phebs/ mon yul gsum du dung khra rgyal pos gdan drangs/ de nas rim bar mchod rten rnam dag dang shing gi ri mjal/ rgya gar du zla ba lnga bzhugs/ de phyogs kyi skye 'gro thams cad shin tu dad par gyur/ 'bo la zer bar dbang mdzad dus sbrang bu rnams srung 'khor gyis bsrung bar mdzad pas thams cad shin tu dad par gyur/ bye lar gnas brtan bcu drug dang*/ mgon po brag gdong du slob dpon padma zhal gzigs/ kong por karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje mjal/ 'bul chen bstabs/ chos mang du zhus/ mtshur phu dang*/ rin spungs/ 'bri khung*/ snye mo rnams su chos mang po gsungs/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen por rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs kyi dbang mdzad/ rin spungs pa zil gnon rdo rje dge tshul mdzad/ zil gnon chos dbyings dpal gyi rgya mtshor btags/ 'jag du phebs/ yin thang mjal bas 'ja' 'od sogs rtags ngo mtshar ba mang po byung*/ gtsang chu mig tu/ rje btsun byams pa dang*/ jo bo rje shākya shrī rnams zhal gzigs/ slar rje brgyad pa mjal/ 'bul chen bstabs/ mtshur phur ras chos btang*/ rje grol mchog la grub brgya'i byin rlabs dang phag mo lha khrid mdzad/ yang zur sogs la sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid gnang*/ la stod lhor phebs dus thab zhig 'dril pa rje yi thad nas gyen du 'dril/

de nas 'dar/ rin spungs sogs su phebs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ gsung brtsams kyang mang du bzhugs/ me lug hor zla bcu par chos dbyings pho brang du mya ngan las 'das so/ /slob ma yang*/ mi nyag rtogs ldan dpal ldan seng ge mi nyag ras chen sogs ri thub pa mang po dang*/ gzhan yang slob ma mang du byung*/ ༈¿¿byams chen chos rje sna tshogs rang grol ni/ rin spungs pa'i zhal ngo'i sku skye gsal bar byung*/ rje bdun pa nyid rtsa ba'i bla mar bsnyen/ gsang sngags kyi gdam pa mthar thug pa gnang ba'i bu chen du grags/ byams chen chos sde'i gdan sa mdzad/ spang rtogs phul du byung*/ lha sa'i gser thog brje bar dgongs kyang bde bzar gyis ma grub/ de'i rgyu rnams las gser dngul gyi rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs/ rgyud 'bum rje brgyad pa'i drung du phul/ gzhan rnams gtsang gi dgon chen sogs rnams la gnang*/ phyis sku khams cung zad bsnyun pa'i nyin gcig shar pha gi nas sprin dkar po gcig tshur byung ngam ltos gsungs/ snga dro tsam na sprin dkar po mtha' 'ja' tshon gyis bskor ba zhig ri'i rtse nas tshur je mgyogs byung*/ gzim khang gi steng tsam du sleb byung zhus pas nga'i stan mthong ka'i thad der theg gsung ste sprin de la gzigs cing phyag thal mo sbyar ste rje thams cad mkhyen pa kho bo bsu bar phebs byung*/ nga ni phyags phyi byas ste dag pa mkha' spyod du 'gro gsung ste de nyid du sku mdangs yal gyis song*/ karma grwa tshang gi grwa bsgres rab 'byams pa bsod nams rab 'byor rje 'di las gdams pa zhus te nyams rtogs bzang bar skyes/ 'u yug gi ri khrod cig na sgrub pa la yod pas gsal snang la sku 'das par shes te mtshams thon nas gag tshangs su phyin pa na sku gdung bzhu ba dang thug ste mos gus kyi gsol 'debs drag po byas pas thugs tsheg sgra dang bcas te bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i sgo chung las 'phar ste khong gi pang du byung ba la rten ring bsrel ngo mtshar can byung zhes khong nyid las dngos su gsung pa'i lo rgyus sogs nges shes cher skye bar yod do//

༈¿¿bya 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal ni/ gtso bor rje bdun pa'i dngos slob yin la/ spyir rje btsun skya se/ dus zhabs pa/ rje phrin las pa rnams bsten zhing ches mkhas par gyur/ nor dpyad rgya mtsho sogs 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dang*/ nang don gyi 'grel pa pod chen bzhi la sogs pa bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ chos 'khor lhun po bskal dus kyis nyams kyang slar padma bkod pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad do// ༈¿¿rje btsun skya se rtogs ldan ni/ 'khrungs yul byang stag lung ba'i skor gyi skya se ru ba yin/ sngar khyim du bzhugs dus skya se a mgon zhes ming thos pa tsam gyis ri dwags dang byang 'brog pa mgron po sogs 'dar nus pa'i dpa' rngam gyis ar jag gi dpon mdzad/ phyis dgung lo drug cur longs pa na mgron tshan zhig bcom brlag tu brtsams par/ de dag gis brgol ba la ral gris bsnun pa rgod ma sbrum ma zhig la phog ste lto ba ral nas rte'u lhung ba la ma des lces ldag par gzigs pas skyo ba cher skyes te kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po'i drung du rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ de phyin gro dkar gdan gcig them spangs na bza' chos gos gsum gyi sbyang yon mdzad cing thugs dam gyi mthil gcod yul la mdzad de gnyan khrod kho na 'grims pas snang srid kyi lha 'dres phrin las thams cad sgrub/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho las phyag chen chos drug gi thugs dam brnyes/ sa skyong don rdor ba sogs dbus gtsang gi che dgu thams cad kyis bla mar bkur/ rtogs ldan 'gal ltag pa zhes rnam dpyod che ba des tshigs bcad kyis skur pa mang du btab kyang phyis zhal mjal ba na/ mi la ras pa ser po tsam ches dad cing snga ma la bshags pa dang bstod pa yang dag pa phul/ sku tshe bya bral gyi brtul zhugs la bskyal/ rje gong ma'i phrin las kyi 'phro kong po'-i chos rgya dkar po thams cad dpyis phyin par phan bder bkod sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rtsa lag gcig tu gyur te sku tshe mthar phyin pa dgung lo brgyar nye bar bzhugs te phyis brag gsum zho khar mya ngan las 'das nas gdung 'bum yang der bzhugs so//

de la spyir slob ma'i tshogs shin tu mang ba'i sngar slob kre che chung gnyis ni thugs dam spang rtogs cher 'khrungs pa byon yang snga mo nas gshegs pa las dngos kyi 'gro don ma bstan/ phyis slob las kre chen mchims phu'i sgrub sde'i bla ma yang slob rje btsun dam pa glo bo chos rje kun dga' grol mchog sogs te 'dis kyang byang stag lung gi chos rje sku mched dang gzhan yang dbus gtsang gi bla ma chos sde che dgu'i gdan sa mdzad pa sogs dang*/ kre che chung gnyis ka mtshur phur kre bo'i las tshan la bzhugs pas de ltar grags so// ༈¿¿khams su 'khrungs pa'i bla ma ru pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho ni/ sman gyi bcud len cung zad ma gtogs mi zas rags pa mi gsol/ /sgrub pa gtsor mdzad/ sgam po spyan snga khu dbon rnams kyi bla ma mdzad/ g.ye dwags sogs kyi phrin las skyong*/ de'i slob gtso'i gras las byar po rtogs ldan te/ gcod kyi thugs dam mthar phyin rtogs pa shin tu mtho/

mngon shes thogs med mnga'/ sne'u gdong rtse dang gdan sa thel sogs zhal ngo che dgus bla mar bkur/ de'i slob ma phrin las nus pa bla ma smon lam rgya mtsho sogs byung ngo*/ /gzhan yang nags phu chos 'phel sku mched la sogs rje btsun skya se'i dngos slob yang slob ches mang ngo*// ༈¿¿grub chen chu 'phur ba ni/ sngon rje phag mo gru pa'i slob ma grub thob nyag ras se bo zhes grags pa grub chen pakṣi'i phrin las kyi bkod par zhal gyis bzhes pa de rdzu 'phrul gyis gsang phu ba btul nas rgya gar du mu stegs 'dul du 'byon par dgongs par rten 'brel ma 'grig nas slar mdo khams su byon/ drel dkar mo zhig yod pa shi ba spom ra'i bar chad du mkhyen nas gangs gzigs pa'i phug par bzhugs/ gangs kyi tshal pa gcig blangs pa la gangs ri de'i gzugs 'chos/ chang zom cig yod pa nas gsol/ chab byung ngo cog gangs de la bsil bas de ji ltar zhu ba bzhin spom ra'i gangs nag zang gis zhu nas de'i shul deng sang yang yod zer/ der spom ras bzod gsol byas srog snying phul te bshags par drel brgya dang brgyad 'bul ba byas pa na da res nga la mi dgos/ ma 'ongs par dgos dus su phul zhig gsungs te gdams ngag du ma dang ma 'ongs lung bstan mang po mdzad de de nyid du gter du sbas/ phyis grub chen par 'khrungs pas sngon gnas gsal bar dran te gter phyung*/ rma spom ra'i skor du byon pas dre'u dkar mo gcig gis sna drangs te dre'u 'bul ba kho na brgya dang bdun du longs/ de nas dril dkar mo gcig byung bas nga 'dis don 'grub gsung nas 'byon 'phro bcad/ 'di kam po rdo rje dpal brtsegs dang de'i ri yin zhes kyang thos/ spyir thugs dam rang byung du shar yang rtsa ba'i bla ma rje bdun par 'dzin/ khams su chu chen gcig la brgal dus 'phur ba yul mis mthong ste chu 'phur bar grags pa yin no//

༈¿¿gzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal ba ni/ rje bdun pa las chos dang gdams ngag thams cad gsan te mkhas grub chen por gyur/ rab sgang gi mkhas pa mi lnga'i nang nas byams sar ba chen po'i sngon gnas gsal bar dran/ rab sgang sde 'khrug chen por gyur nas/ chos 'khor yun ring du chag sde rnams kyang nyam nyes kyi dus rje 'dis 'khrug rtsod thams cad bsdums/ dge 'dun gyi bca' ba thams cad gsar du mdzad/ chos 'khor gyi snga srol gsos te rab sgang du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gzhi bzhengs mdzad/ khyad par byams sar la bstan pa'i mdzad rlabs che/ rab sgang gi dge 'dun pa kun dam chos kyis btul/ spyir mdo smad kyi skye bo thams cad chos la bkod cing*/ shin tu hu'i rgyal po dang*/ dar mdo'i chen po sogs rgya'i blon chen mang po dang rgyal bu du mas yon gnas dam par bsnyen/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis kyang*/ sngon tshe gtsang ma'i zas kyi rim gro pa/ paṇa chen dbang phyug rgya mtsho de yang khyod/ ces sogs sngon gnas du ma lung gis bstan/ phrin las shin tu che sku tshe mthar phyin par bstan 'gro'i don mdzad cing*/ dbon po sku mched sogs kyis phrin las kyi rgyun skyong ngo*// ༈¿¿zur mang bya btang blo gros rgya mtsho ni/ rma se'i dbon rigs yin/ dbus su phebs/ chos grags rgya mtsho mjal/ kwan ting gu shri'i las ka shel tham gnang*/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa dar rgyal tshab bkra shis rnam rgyal las dbang chos mang du gsan/ khams su phebs bde chen rtse'i sgrub sde dang 'du khang chen mo bzhengs/ rang gling gi chos bdag du lung bstan dgongs 'dus pa las rang gling gi chos skor rnams gsan/ rje bdun pa sku gshegs nas sgar dpon mdzad/ dgung lo so gcig par kun spang mdzad/ thub pa dang*/ mchims phur o rgyan zhal gzigs/ bde chen rtser bum sgrub dang yol migs du sgrub sde btsugs/ sgom sde ri khag gi bla ma rnams la chos mang du bstan/

dgung lo drug cu par sku gshegs so// ༈¿¿rgya ston bya bral nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni/ rgya ston chos rje'i sku skyer rje brgyad pas zhal gyis bzhes/ rgya ston pa'i gdan sar sgrub pa snying por dril te sgrub bstan rgya cher spel/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi thog mar zhabs 'degs pa'i gtso bo mdzad de zhabs bkur phul du byung ngo*// ༈¿¿gsi dkar kun spang pa ni/ gdan sa 'og ma'i skor du dbang khrid kyi 'gro don che'o// ༈¿¿bla ma grags rgyal ba ni/ rong po'i sar 'khrungs/ bkra shis ljongs kyi rdor 'dzin mdzad/ sgar chen bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du rgyun mar gzigs/ gzhan yi dam gyi zhal gzigs pa la rje bdun pa'i slob tshogs la chos rje ngo khro dang 'di gnyis mang zhes drung bdun pa nyid gsung skad/ sngags kyi nus pa dpag med thob/ sog steng dang tshil dgon pa btab ste phrin las che'o// ༈¿¿paṇḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan ni/ spyir kong ston zhig gi sras su skyi shod du 'khrungs/ gsang phur gsan sbyangs mdzad de dgung lo bcu gsum bcu bzhi nas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur te/ dus der gsang ne'u thog dang gangs ljongs kyi mkhas dbang gzur gnas rnams mkhas pa'i khyu mchog tu gleng zhing bstan bcos brtsams pa'i 'bras bzang dngos rtags las kyang shes mod/ g.yas ru gser mdog can gyi chos grwa chen po btab ste phrin las mtha' yas/ phyis rje bdun pa dang mjal te gdams ngag gsan/ thugs dam gyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs te rje 'di rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin la/ sgrub brgyud nges don snying po pa 'di ni gang der nges don phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skyes pa de kho na rtsa ba'i slob mar 'jog ste rtogs pa don brgyud du gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsung bshad gnang ba kun kyang rje bdun pa'i bzhed pa ltar theg chen shing rta gnyis ka'i mthar thug lta ba'i 'jog mtshams gzhan stong kho nar mdzad cing tshad ma'i skor yang rje bdun pa'i rig gzhung rgya mtsho'i lugs su gnang zhing*/

karma pa nyid dang thugs rgyud gcig par gsungs so// ༈¿¿mi nyag rab 'byams pa mgon po dpal ni/ mi nyag tu 'khrungs/ chung du nas rje bdun pa'i zhabs bsnyen te/ 'bras yul rdzong dkar du slob gnyer gyis shog stsal bzhin byon/ kun mkhyen byams chen rab 'byams pa bsten te mkhas par sbyangs/ phyis rje yis karma gra tshang gsar 'dzug la grwa pa nyung tsam gyi bla chos dbu gsum ga'i go mdzad de dka' ba mdzad pas ring po ma lon par blo gsal gyi dge 'dun ches mang du 'phel/ skyed tshal chos rje 'jam dbyangs pa dang thugs cher gshim pas mkhan chen g.yag pa'i chos gan skyed tshal gyi gaṇḍi dang po ba gcig /bca' yig chung ba/ yar 'brog dka' bcu pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa dang bcas gra tshang tshugs pa'i legs jar gnang*/ skyed tshal ba smyug la ba sogs su chos bar la 'byon dus tshogs dang rig lung bsre ba'i srol byung*/ mdor na chos rje mi nyag pa de thugs rgyud bzang*/ slob ma thams cad la thugs thag pa nas brtse bas slob gnyer cung smar ba rnams la'ang lhag par gsol ras sogs mdzad/ sbyin bdag dad can mang pos zla re bzhin na bza' cha tshang mang du phul ba mang jar bsgyur nas dge 'dun par drangs gos med pa la gnang*/ na bza' phyi ma de sar rnying gang yin de ga nyi char thams cad la gsol ba ma gtogs bzang ngan 'dem ga spo len mi mdzad/ grwa pa rnams kha shas nas res mos kyi nyin re bzhin ja gung tshigs chag med gnang*/ slob gnyer smar ba rnams srod chos kyang zhu chog thor chos la rtag tu phebs/ chos 'don sku rim la yang gral dbur rtag tu phebs shing thugs dam kho na mdzad/ kha char lhag pa nyi tshan ci byung yang g.yo med du bshad nyan kho na mdzad/ bstan 'gror dgongs pa'i chos 'chad pos mdzad skyong de lta bu zhig dgos rgyur snang ngo*// sku tshe'i mjug la phar tshad la sogs la yig cha mdzad na legs rung sgros mi gcig par chags sdang gi rgyur 'gro ye mi byed gsungs/

grwa pa thams cad kyang shin tu gus zhen che bas mthar bsnyun pa dang sku gshegs dus lhung bzed zla gam lhag po sogs yod do cog rje de'i sku'i dgongs rdzogs su btang*/ mthar grwa pa rnams snying rje kho bo ni dga' ldan du 'gro gsung te gshegs/ me tog gi char kha ba ltar bab/ dge bshes dka' bcu bstan dar zhes gsang phu'i tshogs pas kyang tshad ma la 'gran par mi nus pa'i mkhas pa'i rtser son de la soḍa pa slob ma'i tshogs mkhas pa dang khyi thul sku skye soḍa gzhan don nus pa mang du byung ngo*// ༈¿¿ngo khro rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal ni/ drung rin po che sku chung ngu dus ngo khror phebs pa na zhabs la gtug /gser mdog can du slob gnyer gyis shog stsal bas byon te paṇa chen shāka mchog pa bsten te gsung rab mtha' dag bde blag tu khong du chud/ ber can sogs chos skyong rnams rgyun par zhal gzigs/ rtag tu 'khrul zhig chen por bzhugs/ mtshur phu'i chos 'chad mdzad de nang don gyi 'grel ba sogs bstan bcos kyang du ma mdzad/ slob ma'ang gzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal dang*/ g.yam bzang spyan snga/ bla ma gru bzhi pa dang*/ bla ma tshe dbang rgya mtsho/ rje blo gros dbang phyug sogs du ma byon no// ༈¿¿rje smyug la paṇa chen ni/ dpon sa gser khang ma'i sras smyug la ba'i zhal ngor sa stag la sku bltams/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan la tshul bzhin zhugs/ mkhan chen ratna pa/ lo pa spyan snga bsod nams legs mchog la sogs pa bsten te bka' gdams kyi srol dngos 'dzin/ spyan snga tshul 'bar ba'i sku'i skye bar nges/ rje dbus smyon pa rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad skabs smyug lar mi gcod mdzad dbu thod rag rug du chag rdo phung chen mos mi mthong par mnan yang har gyis bzhengs te rlung ro gcig bsal bas sku lus skyon med du gyur te mgur len zhing mgyogs par byon pa la thugs dad cher 'khrungs te chos du ma gsan zhing*/

rigs drug 'khor lo'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang*/ zhes sogs pa'i bstod pa dang rnam thar yang mdzad/ mtshan ldan zhig mo dang bsod nams legs mchog pa sogs skyes chen du ma las bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa mang du gsan/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho bla ma'i mchog tu 'dzin cing*/ nges don gyi gdams pa kho nar thugs gzhol/ thugs dam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin/ bka' gdams glegs bam kyang lo re la lan re gnang ba'i dam bca' mdzad/ de dus me tog gi char nges par 'babs zer/ jo bo'i sku tha dad pa re la mchod pa sna lnga re bshams/ jo bo'i bstod pa dang*/ nang gi yan lag bdun pa re 'don/ de bzhin chos gang gnang de dang mthun pa'i rten bshams sogs ngo mtshar bar mdzad do/ rgyal srid kyi gnang dgos rgya che na'ang gzim dpon pa sogs byed 'jug /sku drung du chos zhu dang bla ma dge bshes ma gtogs khyim pa la gral yang mi 'dzin/ dam pa'i chos kyi phrin las 'ba' zhig mdzad nas/ dgung lo nga brgyad la dga' ldan du gshegs/ 'di'i dus stong ra chos rje'i mnal lam du nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi gseb na khang brtsegs khyad par can du gser gyi skas gsum btsugs pa'i dbus ma la spyan snga tshul 'bar 'byon pa yin zer nas lha rnams mchod pa byed cing snang bar/ rje smyug la ba dbus ma der gshegs nas khang bzang du byon song ba gzigs te rmis ltas ngan pas sku rim dgos zhes gsol bar nges/ lo pa spyan snga sogs slob ma gzhan don nus pa bgrang du med/ gzim dpon don grub kyang bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs mdzad de phyis kun spangs kyis thugs dam mthar phyin no// ༈¿¿rje karma phrin las phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ dgyer gyi gdung rigs rgyal chen sku rab pa'i zhal ngo 'brug mda' dge sbyong gi sras su me byi la 'khrungs/ rje bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi rus dbon yin/ sku chung ngu'i dus zur mkhar du bzhugs te dharma swā mī las sman dpyad bslab/
