pho gcod brul tsho drug dang rnying ma'i skor rnams zhus/ dgung lo bcu bdun la gnas brtan lhun grub bzang po'i drung nas rab tu byung*/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ de yi phyi nyin nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi slob dpon mdzad dgos pa byung*/ sangs rgyas 'phel ba las dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed sogs zhus/ sha ra rab 'byams pa las/ ni gu chos drug su kha chos drug ngan rdzongs snyan brgyud sogs gsan/ lhun grub bzang po las gsan pa mtha' dag la 'jug par mdzad cing*/ gzhung lugs mang po la sbyangs te/ gser phye 'bum du gnyal sde drug dge 'dun bdun brgya tsam gyi dbus su phar phyin la bshad pa mdzad/ slob dpon sangs rgyas mgon po pa'i drung du phar phyin la sbyangs par mdzad/ mkhan dge 'dun lhun grub pa la bka' gdams glegs bam sogs kyi lung*/ byams gling paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal la yang chos 'brel zhus/ gangs dkar rdo rje gdan pa la sa phur dang gur zhal skor sogs dang*/ paṇa chen bde bzang pa la ka lā pa dang*/ sum rtags sogs thun mong rig pa'i skor rnams zhus/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba las 'dus pa 'phags skor sogs sngags chos du ma gsan/ de nas mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ rnam 'grel/ 'dul mngon/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug sogs la mkhas par mdzad/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa la/ byams chos lnga/ tshe mdo sogs dang*/ nyi shu pa dang sum cu pa/ bzhi brgya pa sogs zhus/ rje don grub rgyal mtshan las phar phyin dang dpag bsam 'khri shing*/ sdeb sbyor me tog chun po sogs gsan/ 'phags mchog yon tan rgya mtsho pa la rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad sogs dang*/ gcen chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa la bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung dang*/ gur lha bcu gnyis pa'i dbang sogs zhus/ zangs po cher gnyal sde drug gi lung grwa chen mo'i khar po ti nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi tho phul/

bshad pa bgro gleng mang po mdzad pas dge bshes thams cad thugs dbang med du 'phrogs/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po la/ zhing skyong gzi ldan gyi skor rnams gsan/ tsā ri yul smad du bcad rgyar bzhugs skabs zhing skyong zhal gzigs/ lung bstan yid ches pa mdzad/ chos 'khor lhun po'i gtsug lag khang gzigs/ 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas bsam 'grub las phag mo lha lnga'i dbang dang*/ phyag chen lhan gcig skyes sbyor gyi nyams khrid zhus pas gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs/ slob dpon sangs rgyas chos grags pa la/ ni gu'i skor rnams zhus/ kun dga' phun tshogs la dus 'khor gyi dbang dang sbyor drug gi khrid sogs gsan/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i drung nas/ mkha' sbyod dbang po'i chos drug bsdus pa'i nyams khrid/ zhing skyong gi bka' gtad sgrub thabs yongs tshang dang*/ dus 'khor gyi dbang*/ dgyes rdor/ bde mchog lū hi pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ ber nag can gi dbang chen dang*/ sgrub skor tshang ma'i lung*/ lha mo rnam sras sogs kyi rjes gnang sogs zhus/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho mjal ma thag nas sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes thob/ rlung sems gnyis med dang*/ chos drug gi khrid kyi zhu ba phul bas brgyud pa 'dzin par khas len dgos pa'i bka' phebs nas/ phyag chen dang chos drug gi khrid gnang ste zla ba ltar bshad rim ltar nyams su blangs pas ji skad bshad pa'i myong ba rnams rim par 'khrungs/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i skor tshang ma dang dbu ma'i lta khrid/ rang stong gzhan stong mi 'gal bar ston pa'i gzhung chung*/ rang byung ba'i bka' 'bum tshang ma'i lung*/ nang don/ snying po bstan pa/ rnam shes ye shes kyi rab dbye sogs kyi bshad pa/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi myong khrid/ rngog dkyil bdun dang lnga tshan lnga'i dbang la sogs pa chos kyi char chen po bab pa nyams su bstar bar mdzad pa ji ltar nyams rtogs kyi yon tan rgyud la skyes pas rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog dam pa ste rdo rje 'chang dngos su 'dzin/
/skyabs che 'jam dpal rgya mtsho las gcod kyi nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang*/ gcod khrid rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i dbang khrid sogs gsan/

bla ma don grub rgyal mtshan pa la/ zhang gi bka' 'bum dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang sogs zhus/ 'brong bu gu shrī las/ rngog lugs dgyes rdor dang bdag med ma'i dbang sogs dang*/ si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa dang bde mchog nag po pa sogs zhus/ sprul sku bkra shis don grub rnam rgyal la/ chos drug ka dpe sogs dang*/ na lend+ra'i chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen la lam 'bras lam skor sogs dang*/ smyug la paṇa chen la/ sgrol dkar skor sogs dang*/ steng dkar chos rje blo gros rnam rgyal la lam 'bras pod nag skor sogs dang*/ paṇa chen shāka mchog la lam 'bras sras don ma sogs dang*/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis la pod nag skor gyi lung khrid dang*/ zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po la/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa sogs dang*/ slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtsho ba la tai lo'i chos drug rim lnga bsdus gsal sogs dang*/ cham dgon pa grags pa dpal ldan chos kyi pho nyar mngags te rngog dkyil bdun sogs rngog chos rnams gsan par mdzad/ mdor na gangs ljogs 'dir bzhugs pa'i dbang khrid lung sogs rje 'di la mi bzhugs pa med pa tsam mo// ma sha'i bsnyen pa gnang skabs myu gu sor bzhi rtse la 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba byung*/ karma pa la chos drug zhus skabs re khā nag po sgra gcan gyi thig le gzigs/ rje karma pakṣi zhal gzigs/ mdzod ṭīka brtsams dus dbyig gnyen yin zer ba'i paṇḍi ta sngo sangs zhig gis dka' gnas dkrol ba rmis/ dbu skra bubs gcig karma pa brgyad pa'i phyag tu yod pa las gser mdog gi ring bsrel mang po 'khrungs/ chibs rgan zhig yod pa shi dus ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur/ bya bkra shis dar rgyal gyis sbyin bdag mdzad de/ chos 'khor lhun por mchod rten chen mo dang*/ ston pa'i sku rgyab mtho nyer lnga yod pa rgyab yol lha khang dang bcas pa sogs bzhengs/

te'u rar bya par zhus nas 'thus btsun mang du bsdus/ rab 'byams pa kun dga' 'od zer 'chad nyan par bskos/ deb sngon gyis gtsos pa'i gsung par mang po bzhengs/ chos rgyal bya pas karma pa spyan drangs nas chos 'khor lhun po rten dang brten pa dang 'thus btsun rnams bcas phul bas rje 'di chos sde'i mkhan por bsko bar mdzad/ der dpal 'byor don 'grub pa'i gdung ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten thog tshad tsam yang bzhengs par mdzad/ chos sde dar rgyas btsun gsum 'dzom par mdzad de rgyal ba nyid la phul/ rje nyid rdza dmar ser steng gi ri khrod du bzhugs/ de nas karma grwa tshang gi bla mar bskos karma pa nas dbu gdugs sogs gnang*/ thub chen chos 'khor gyi gdan sa'i gzhi bting*/ lo gnyis la gtsug lag khang sogs grub/ 'thus btsun bsdus 'dul ba'i lag len tshul bzhin pa tshugs/ gtsang khang du gser zangs kyi thub pa'i sku gung thang lha chen las mtho gang gis mtho ba zhig bzhengs/ de nas shing byi lor karma grwa tshang gi gzhis dgon smyug la legs bshad gling gi gtsug lag khang gi rmang bting nas lcags ri rdo gcal yan grub par mdzad/ chu 'brug lor byang chub gling du 'chi med rgyal ba'i pho brang du bzhengs/ brtag gnyis kyi rgyud bshad btsugs/ legs bshad gling du zung 'jug brgyud rim gyi gser sku khru gang pa nyer lnga/ karma rab brgyad kyi bka' 'bum/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum sogs bzhengs/ na lend+rar/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gser sku mi tshad/ sprul sku kun bkras kyi gser sku/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ bkras rnam pa'i bka' 'bum pod bzhi/ btsan dgon du gdung rten gser gdung thog so gsum pa zhig bzhengs/ me phag lor rje mi bskyod zhabs dang mjal/ chos drug gser zhun ma dang chos drug chen mo sogs phul/ de nas phar phyin gyi gzhung chos phul ba'i dbu tshugs/ mkhan chos grub seng ges mkhan po dang rje 'dis slob dpon mdzad de rgyal ba'i dbang po mi bskyod rdo rje bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/

de nas phar phyin dang*/ byams chos bzhi/ tshe mdo/ rnam 'grel/ rig gter/ mdo rtsa/ mngon pa gong 'og /'jug pa rnams kyi bshad pa phul zhing zin bris kyang gnang song*/ brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa dang*/ rngog lugs dgyes rdor dbang sogs phul/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nas sbyor lam chos mchog brnyes pa phrin las pa zhes gsungs nas/ zhabs brtan gsol 'debs mdzad/ gzhan yang don gnyer can rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par bskor bar mdzad/ smyug lar phebs nas gdan sar shes rab rnam rgyal mkhan por bskos/ rje nyid kun spangs mdzad de theg chen rtser 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dus 'da' zhing snying po'i nyams bzhes kyi ngang du bzhugs so/ /mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mdzad pa'ang pusti bcu phrag lhag tsam bzhugs/ sngon dgung lo sum cu tsam gyi dus grub rgyal tshe sgrub thugs dam sku mtshams mdzad skor/ tshe dpag med dang grub pa'i rgyal mos dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi tshad du brda'i sgo nas bstan pa dang*/ dngos nyams mnal ltas ches mang*/ rje brgyad par tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul pa'i rjes chog skabs/ thugs dam rten tshe dpag sku thang gi dbu rgyan la nas 'bru lnga bum par gsum sogs me tog mang du zug pa thog mar drung gis gzigs shing de nas kun gyis mthong zhes dpon slob rnams gsungs/ dgung lo re bzhi pa tsam gyi dus mnyel gzhi dang phyi nang gi ltas cung byung skabs sgrol dkar thugs dam mdzad pas sku khams dngas/ phal cher zhal gzigs dang rtags sogs kyis re zhig mya ngan las mi 'da' bar zhal gyis bzhes/ phyis rje dpa' bo rin po che'i rmis nyams kyi rtags dang bstun pa'i zhabs brtan phul tshe dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhir rten 'brel 'grigs ltar der mya ngan las 'das/ 'di pa'i dngos brgyud kyi slob ma spyir mtha' yas kyang*/ gtso bor rje brgyad pa/ mchog sprul rnam gnyis/

sgam po'i spyan snga mched/ karma pa'i gdan sa gong 'og gi rin po che sogs skyes chen mang po dang*/ kun mkhyen rong po'i skye ba gsal por rjes dran du nges pa'i zla med mtshur phu'i chos rje/ padma bkod kyi 'dren pa/ ngo khro mkhyen rab pa sogs rab 'byams smra ba brgya phrag du longs pa/ 'dra bla chos 'od sogs dka' bcu smra ba'i phrin can ches mang po/ nyid kyi dbon gzim khang 'og ma'i gdan sa snga phyi sogs dang yar 'brog bla ma phal mo che/ dwo bo ri pa snga phyi sogs sgrub grwa'i bla ma ches mang po/ rje smyug la paṇa chen dang phar slob tshur slob mdzad la chu shul mkhan chen pa dang*/ gzim dpon kun spangs pa la sogs chen po'i gdung rigs su mkhas btsun bzang grub pa sha stag /spyir na lend+ra'i gzim skyil 'og mar kun mkhyen bkras rnam pa'i gdan sa'ang mdzad cing*/ 'phrang po'i chos rje gser mdog pa dang*/ brag thog chos rje sogs dpal sa skya'i dge bshes ches mang por/ lam 'bras ngor rdzong gi lugs tha dad dang*/ glegs bam ma/ dkar ma/ gnyag ma/ smar ma/ pod nag ma/ dpe mdzod ma la sogs lam 'bras kyi pusti nyi shu lhag pa'i khrid dang rgyu lam gyi dbang sogs gnang zhing sa dkar gnyis ka'i bstan pa la phrin las mdzad do// ༈¿¿rje dwags ram pa mkhas grub chos rgyal bstan pa ni/ sgam po'i mdun nyag nyi klung du sa sbrul la sku bltams/ sku chung ngu nas gtsang chen chos rje'i drung du rab byung mdzad/ mtshan chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gsol/ chos gdams ngag mang du gsan/ sne'u thang du mtshan nyid gsan/ phyis skyed tshal du kun mkhyen sangs 'phel ba'i spyan sngar sde snod mtha' dag la sbyangs/ lhag par dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel bu lugs kyi phyag len sogs la ches mkhas/ mdor na rje nyid kyis/ phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyor ba'i rtsis la mkhas// sku gzugs mchod rten sogs kyi dbyibs dang tshad//

bzo rig phul du phyin pa gzhan yod min// rang gzhan grub pa'i mtha' la tshad ma ste// brda' sprod pa la sgra yi rig pa shes// nang don zab mo'i gnas lugs lta ba'i tshe// dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel man ngag bcas// ji bzhin shes nas gzhan la ston nus mod// ces gsungs pa ltar mkhas pa'i phul du gyur te 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la 'gran zla dang bral/ rtses dang du grwa skor la byon dus chu byang pa'i dge bshes pod chen brgyad cu yod pa cig dang*/ 'bum rab 'byams pa rin chen chos dbang ste rnam gsum lhan cig du byung ba rje 'dis pusti nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bshad pa mdzad pa ches bshad pa bzang zhing dpyis phyin pa dang khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo la phul du phyin pa des rgyu skar gyi nang na zla ba ltar lhag par gyur te/ thams cad kyis ngo mtshar du byas/ de nas rje bdun pa'i zhabs bsnyen par mdzad de zab chos mtha' dag gsan zhing nyams rtogs kyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs shing 'khrul zhig chen por bzhugs rje rgyal ba'i dbang pos kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i sras su dgongs te zhwa ljang gi cod paṇa dang*/ rje mthong ba don ldan gyi phyag dril sogs gnang*/ rje phrin las pas yer pa'i bla ma la gnang bar gsol btab ngor yer pa'i gdan sar gnang*/ nang don 'grel pa mchog rab phul du son pa mdzad par/ rje brgyad pas sngags brjod che bar gnang*/ chos gsungs pa rnams kyang bka' brgyud rin po che'i dgongs pa kho na gzhan dang phye ste thun mong ma yin par ston/ rje gtsug lag phreng bas thub chen du spyan drangs te bla ma dge bshes ches mang por 'dus pa la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang*/ tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i bshad lung sogs gnang*/ spyir bka' brgyud rin po che dang khyad par rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa kho na lugs gzhan dang ma 'dres par 'chad/ dgung lo don drug pa shing spre la kho bo'i zhwa ljang bcol po'i tshul du zung zhig zhes sku skye ba phyi ma 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes te mya ngan las 'das shing sgar chen mi mang gi bla mar bskos pa'i dbang gis sgar gyi dpon che chung thams cad kyi bla mar gyur cing*/

cham dgon pa dang slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtshos grub chen pakshi'i bka' 'bum dang 'dul ba lung zhus te rje phrin las pa la phul lo// ༈¿¿chos rje gsung rab mang thos ni/ dwags po sku rab dgon sar du rab byung mdzad/ kun mkhyen sangs 'phel ba'i spyan sngar sde snod la sbyangs/ rje bdun pa rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten ste phyi nang yon tan rdzogs/ se 'bras dge gsum gyi chos rje smon lam dpal dang legs chos pa sogs dang bgro gleng mdzad pas shin tu rgyal bar byung byung skad/ stag lung rin po ches/ dbang grags pa las 'bri khung dgongs gcig zhus nas rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa dang dgongs gcig gcig par mdzad nas lam rim byang chub ljon shing zhes bya ba mdzad/ de nyid rtag tu 'chad cing bka' bstan bcos thams cad kyi pusti brtsegs nas 'di'i nang nas gang 'dem zer na dgongs gcig kho na 'dem zhes thugs rtsis che bar mdzad/ mkhas grub sangs blo ba sogs chos slob shin tu mang*/ bsam yas mchims phu'i sgrub sde'i 'dren pa mdzad de phrin las che bar byung ngo*// ༈¿¿rje bkra shis 'od zer ni/ 'bri stod du skyabs bdud gser gsum las bdud mo'i dpon gyi sras su 'khrungs/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho mjal bkra shis 'od zer zhes pa'i ming dang yig drug gi sgom lung gnang*/ rje dpal 'byor don grub las rab byung mdzad/ lo brgyad nas dge lugs pa'i bshes gnyen 'ga' las bsdus grwa gsan/ ri bo dge ldan du bzhugs sde snod dang gsang sngags la sbyangs pas mkhas par gyur/ mkhan chen sdom rgyun pa chos grub bzang po las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ sa lugs bde mchog lū dril/ phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi dbang rnams zhus/ rnam thos kyi ri bor rje chos grags rgya mtsho mjal/ phyag chen dang chos drug gi nyams khrid zhus/ ma mgon gyi gdams skor dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod/ rlung sems gnyis med/

do ha skor gsum/ grub pa sde bdun/ nang don rtsa 'grel/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten gsum sgron sogs dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs thams cad zhus nas gzhung lugs kun la mkhas par mdzad/ dbus gtsang gi gras rnams su drung gi grub mtha' bzung ste bgro gleng khrom thog chod par mdzad/ si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor las lnga tshad lnga dang ber nag can gyi skor rnams zhus/ ri khrod dben par rtse gcig nyams len kho na mdzad/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad zhal gzigs/ zur dgon nang so sku mched sogs la phyag chen dang chos drug gi khrid mdzad/ sga stod du sa g.yos kyi 'jigs pa bzlog /stag mgo'i rten mjal bas dgun dus char chen babs/ zur mang du phebs bya btang rin po che sogs la nā ro chos drug gi khrid mdzad/ tshur la rad gling chos skor rnams zhus/ rje mi bskyod zhabs dang mjal/ skyes rab so lnga pa'i bshad pa phul/ rje'i bka' ltar sgar du byon/ nang don gyi bshad pa/ chos drug dang do ha skor gsum gyi bshad pa sogs phul/ de nas zur mang du phebs/ bya btang sogs la phung lnga'i rab byed/ snying po bstan pa sogs kyi ljags bshad mdzad/ de nas re zhig ri khrod kho na mdzad/ zur mang dang karma lha steng rnams su phebs rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs/ dbang bskur khrid 'debs mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ rong bo ban sgar du dgon pa mdzad/ chu mig gsar du brdol/ sga 'dan/ lho rgyud/ skyabs bdud rnams su phebs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis/ sangs rgyas theg par don gcig rmongs pa bral zhes sogs gsol ba btab pa'i bka' shog phebs/ /rje btsun bkra shis rnam gnyis zhes/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa dang bka' drin mtshungs pa nyid du 'dzin par mdzad cing*/ rgyal tshab sprul sku grags pa dpal 'byor la sogs skyes chen du ma dang mdo khams kyi lha sde mi sde chen po thams cad kyi bla ma gcig chog du 'dzin zhing nges don sgrub brgyud kyi dgongs pa thun mong ma yin par ston par mdzad do//

༈¿¿sde bdun rab 'byams pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan ni/ gtsang rting khebs pa'i zhal ngo yin/ gser mdog tu paṇa chen shāka mchog rin po che'i zhabs bsten te sbyangs pa mdzad cing*/ gtso bor tshad ma sde bdun la mkhas pas mtshan der thogs/ paṇa chen gyi thugs rtsom gyi par sgrub pa'i 'gan bzhes mdzad pa sogs zhabs tog shin tu che/ rje bdun pa'i drung du paṇa chen gyis 'bul mo che mdzad skabs sde bdun rab 'byams pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan 'di pas gtsos pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge bshes bcu gcig zhes 'bul yig du btab nas phul/ karma grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan slob dpon mdzad cing slob ma mang du byon/ phyis g.yam bzang gi mkhan po dang bshad grwa'i chos ston pa po mdzad de lung rig 'dzin pa mang du byung ngo*// ༈¿¿dus zhabs pa shākya dbang phyug ni/ ru dgon par dang zha lur sbyangs pa mdzad/ sde snod dang khyad par sngags yo ga dang dus 'khor la mkhas pas mtshan dus 'khor zhabs par chags/ rje bdun pa las gdams ngag gsan zhing nyams rtogs cher skyes te don gyi slob mar gyur/ dwags por gsang sngags gling btab/ rje smyug la paṇa chen gyis karma gser phreng la g.yung gi rnam thar nyid mdzad chen mo bcug /rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar mi nyag blo rin pas mdzad pa sogs dang sog dbon pa'i rnam thar brgya rtsa ma chung ngu dang*/ rje don ldan zhabs kyi rnam thar hor ston sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa sogs dang*/ ban sgar ba dang go'i shri pa'i rnam thar gzhan ma rnyed nas rje nyid kyis bstod pa re mdzad/ de rnams glegs bam gcig tu mdzad nas lo re zhing nges par lung du mdzad/ rje bdun pa'i rnam thar khyed bsten yun ring thugs rgyus che rnam thar rtsom pa'i 'os khyed du 'dug pas mdzad dgos zhes gsung chos phar gsan tshur gsan skabs su bskul bar mdzad nas rje dus zhabs pa 'di pas brtsams pa'i rnam thar ches legs pa gcig kyang yod do//

༈¿¿chos rje do bo ri pa ni/ yar 'brog mngon dgar rab byung mdzad/ bka' bcu pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes rtsod pa'i khyu mchog du grags/ karma grwa tshang gi zur chos pa mdzad/ rje bdun pa las thugs dam gyi rtogs pa brnyes te sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad cing g.yung do bo ri dang*/ byi'u chu mig tu sgrub sde mdzad/ skyi shod pa'i dpon sa chos rjes rtsa ba'i bla mar bskur zhing phyag chen thugs dam bskyed/ chos rje kun spangs pa dang bka' bcu pa dbang phyug dpal sogs sgom khrid kyis 'gro don tshul bzhin du nub pa du ma byung ngo*// ༈¿¿rje dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub ni/ dbus yar lung stod gnyal ston gzhis dkar 'khrungs/ gdung mi nyag yab gong ma kun dga' legs pa'i gsol dpon grags rgyal ba/ yum rdor thog pa'i gdung rigs rgyal mo 'dzom/ sku mched gsum las 'bring po rje 'di nyid yin la/ 'khrungs ma thag nas sngon gnas du ma dran nas gsungs/ yum gyis pang du blangs te nas rngod pa na 'bru de thams cad 'gro ba rigs drug gi bkod par gzigs/ sku skye ba snga ma'i gnas lo ro brag dmar yin pas zhal bye 'phral du brag dmar la 'gro gsungs pas yab yum rnams btsan gnod par dogs pa skyes/ chung dus phyag mdzub kyis sa brus pas/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lugs sku chung ngu zhig rnyed/ de nas brtsams ste snang ba thams cad 'od lnga'i thig le dang thig phran gyi nang du zhi ba dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyis gang ba rtag par gzigs/ yum gyis rgol du byung bas 'bros te se phung la 'phyangs pas se ba la phyag rjes gsal bar byung*/ yab kyi sne'u gdong du gong ma kun dga' legs pa la phul te gsol ja bar bcug 'khor ba la snying po med par rtag tu mkhyen pas chos bros yang yang mdzad kyang yab yum gyis bkag ste ma thon/ phyis dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i tshe dgun dus gcig nyung ja thugs spro mdzad pa'i gral dbus su lcags thab btsug pa la gsol ja bkol mkhan mdzad pa na rdo khog tu ja mar rgyab pas me dmar lhab kyis 'bar bas thugs dam gyi ngang du lhan song ste skyogs tshags phyag g.yas g.yon gyis bzung bzhin par spyan lta stangs su ha re lus/

ja gnam du song ste thal tshub kyis khyim gang bas yab kyis gshag du khrid nas bka' bkyon mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis gser ga ma gtogs pa'i sku rgyan rnams pang khebs su dril nas yab kyis rked par sbas/ gser ga bsnams te zangs ri tes po brag dmar na lhun bde rab 'byams pa bzhugs par bros/ mdangs gu ru chos dpang dang mjal ba rmis/ khyod la de lta bu'i 'gro don can 'ong zhes mtshan chos dbang lhun grub du gsol zhing dge tshul du bsgrubs/ spyan snga lugs kyi phyag chen chos drug gi khrid bskyangs ba tsam nas gcig char pa'i tshul du rtogs pa shar/ nyin mtshan gyi sgyu ma gcig tu 'dres/ lo phyed gnyis tsam nas gsang spyod la 'byon par bzhed de rim gyis byon/ lha sar phebs ka'i tshe lung pa dang grong sogs kyi rnam pa ci yang med par thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du song ba'i dbus na thub pa gtso 'khor lnga kho na bzhugs par gzigs te thugs nyams 'ur nas thal byung du jo bo'i drung du byon sku la 'jus te gsol 'debs dang smon lam mang po shugs 'byung du gsungs/ de nas brtsams te gnas byin rlabs can gar phebs su phal cher thugs nyams 'ur ba mang*/ de nas skyi shod dang byang phyogs sogs kyi gnas rnams su gsang spyod dang bar bar du/ lcang gling pa gzhon nu blo gros/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ dpal 'chi med grub pa ra lung rgyal dbang chos rje sogs mang po la chos gsan/ lcang gling chos rje rgyal dbang chos rje lhun bde ba rje 'di gsum la khyed gsum gyis nga yi sku re gyis gsung pa na gzhan gnyis kyis gser sku re mdzad cing rje 'dis rin po che klu 'jim pa la brkos pa'i sku 'dra sor lnga tsam zhig bzhengs pas shin tu mnyes te kho bo 'di 'dra rang zhig yod snyam gsung nas dbu zhal du 'jibs pa'i byin rlabs can zhig da lta bzhugs/ dbon khyod la phrin las chen po 'byung ba 'dug pas slob gnyer gyis shig gsung nas 'bras spungs su byon yang las tshan gyis 'khrug pas thugs skyo ste dben pa mdzad par zhus/

mtshur phur spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje la gtum mo'i man ngag gsan te ras bud kyi tho rangs ras chu grang la sbangs te gsol nas ja yun re tsam la skam zhing rlangs pa chen po 'byung ba de lta bu gzhan rnams las gsum bzhis mang bar mdzad pas ngo mtshar skyes phyis ras bud mdzad pa na yang rlon ras kyi phyag srol 'di mdzad cing rlung khrid mdzad pa na'ang slob ma rlung 'dzin bcug nas sna sgor bya spu bzhag /rlung gsus la dbyug pa bsnun te bya spu ldeg mi ldeg lta ba la sogs pa'i phyag srol yod pa'ang bla ma 'di las byung ngo*// kong por 'byon par dgongs pa na stong shong gi zam kha tshur mar mgon po phyag drug pa zhal gzigs te skye ba thams cad du phrin las sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes/ zam kha phar mar rdo rje phag mo byon te bu khyod zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu la rtsa chung zangs kyi mtsho brag tu ma sleb na 'di phyi'i rten 'brel 'chug go gsungs pas de nyid nas 'ol kha brgyud/ lam thams cad du 'jigs nyen che yang mi skyon pa zhal bzhes mdzad pa thog tu khel/ mgron po kun gus/ zangs mtshor phebs nyin 'ja' 'od kha dog sna lnga pa nam mkha' dang sa gzhi la bsu ba'i tshul du byon/ mkha' 'gro dang zhing skyong gis bsu bar gzigs/ der rtogs pa mthar phyin rlung srog thur 'dren pa'i grub chen kun bsam pa yang der phebs pas gnyi ga phan tshun du dag pa'i snang ba cher thob/ ri chos la sogs pa'i chos du ma gsan/ de'i tshe rje dpa' bo 'di thugs dam mkha' 'gro snying thig la gtso bo mdzad dbang gis spyir thugs nyams 'ur zhing khyad par du mkha' 'gro mang po thugs rgyud la zhugs pa'i tshul gyis sngon ma grags pa'i rgyud mang po sha ra ra gsung pa dang chos nyan rnams kyi dam tshig nyams chag sel ba dang ma 'ongs pa lung ston pa dang*/ mtsho'i steng la sa gzhi la bya ba ltar 'byon pa dang*/ mtsho nang nas zhing skyong gi chibs rjes dang re ma ti'i sku sogs bstan zhing slar mtshor skyal/

phyag rjes zhabs rjes mang du byung ba rnams mtshor bskyur zhing sbas pa sogs dpag med byung bas thams cad ha las te kha cig gis smyo bar thag bcad/ phal cher gyis dpa' bo zhig yin pa 'dra zhes mtshan dpa' bor chags/ chos rje kun bsam pas dngos nyams rmi lam gyi brtag pa mang du mdzad pas rje 'di dang mjal phyin chad thugs dam la skyed cher byung bas thugs ches te bla ma lta bur bskur/ rnam thar bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma yang mdzad/ 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar ha las pas sku tshe thung du dogs zhes/ mkha' 'gro'i bro ra zangs kyi mtsho brag tu/ zhing skyong mkha' 'gro yi dam du ma gzigs// bden 'dzin zhig pas phyag rjes zhabs rjes bzhag/ sprul pa'i dpa' bo khyod la gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so zhing 'dir brtan par bzhugs// zhes sogs kyi brtan bzhugs mdzad/ phan tshun mnal lam bzung nas gzigs res mang du mdzad/ gtsang phyogs su gsang spyod la byon te skabs la lar mi gcod drag po yang mdzad/ gtsang bsam 'grub rtser de dag gi skye bos gus par byas pa na gtsang po'i byed gling rtswa shing gis khebs pa gcig na nyin re zhing 'ja' tshon gyi gur dang me tog gi char 'bab cing mtshan bzhin mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa 'du bar gzigs te dris pa na sprang rgan gza' mi zhig 'dug zer te byon pas rtsa spyil nas nye gnas ma bsgres mo zhig tshur byung*/ bla ma la mjal bar zhus pas su la yang mi mjal ba yin zer/ nan gyis zhus pas des bla ma la zhus te drung du byon pa na bsgres po gzi brjid can zhig 'dug pa la phyag byas pas khyod la dge sbyor ci 'dra yod gsungs/ nyin ma yengs mtshan ma 'khrul tsam yod zhus pas/ a re sdug las dang po pa ru 'dug gsungs/ bla ma 'di su la yang gtam cher mi gsungs/ nyin mtshan med par bhrūṃ bhrūṃ zhes dang skabs su sngon po ser po dmar po ljang gu zhes gsung ba zhig 'dug

khyod skal ldan du 'dug gsungs nas khong rang gis sangs rgyas stong la dngos su gsan pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i khrid gsungs/ las rgyu 'bras la 'dzem pa gal che/ nga yang sngon brtul zhugs tshe/ mi gcod dang gnyan sa la brtul zhugs mang du byas/ khyad par ngo mtshar rong du gza' bdud gnas pa'i shug sdong zhig gi rtsar gcod byas pas tshar slong gang yang ma byung bas drag gcod byas shug sdong la me rgyab pas gza' bdud kyis thog phab nas 'di bzhin byung ba yin gsungs nas dbu gtsug bstan byung bas dbu thod dbu klad dang bcas pa the bong shong lhag par bug pa har gyis 'dug pa la bdud rtsi byung tshad der bcug nas 'jog thog mdel rkan gnyer gyi khrod na nyug ge 'dug 'di la na tsha zug gzer che bar byung nas rdo rje rnam 'joms la 'don par zhus pas des ma thon/ dpal rta mgrin gyis lan gsum bton pas ma thon/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la zhus pas dbu'i gtsug tor phar yol tshur yol mdzad nas/ a ra ra nga mgo na sems can gyi las 'di mthu che bar 'dug gsungs/ rje btsun sgrol ma la zhus pas 'di bsal na phyi mar dmyal bar lan gcig skye dgos par 'dug da lta'i 'di dang du blangs na phyi mar nyams su myong mi dgos par 'dug gsungs pas 'o na da lta la bdag gir bgyid par zhus pa yin gsungs/ bskal pa dpag med kyi sngon du da lta'i chos rje karma pa dang nga gnyis byang chub tu sems mnyam du bskyed pa yin na'ang khong tshogs gnyis rgya che bas gzhan don rgya chen 'grub/ kho bo de tsam ma byung ste tshe rabs phyi ma nas gzhan don rgya chen po 'byung gsungs/ la phyi la sogs par byon/ la phyi dang ling ba brag la sogs par rje btsun la byung ba'i cha mthun gyi tshar slong byung*/ chu mig dngul 'bum gyi rtsar skyes pa gcig dang bu mo zhig rta 'ol ba zhon nas byung ba la thugs 'ur te da lta gang dran pa cig phul gsungs pas bud med des shel phreng zhig phul byung*/

thugs 'ur nas chu de la ma thogs par byon pas de gnyis cher dad/ ko ro la thog du jag pa mi bdun dang mjal ba la mgur gsungs pa sogs rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dang cha mthun pa kho na byung*/ slar lo ro'i sar byon 'jol snang gi yul gzigs pa'i sa nas thugs nyams 'ur te phebs/ skye snga'i gnas ma gi na khang pa khra bo gsum sgyed po btsugs pa ltar yod pa la da gcig las mi 'dug gsungs pa la dbon po shāka rgyal ba na re nag tshang khra bo'i rtse phab mchod khang khra bo 'gyel ba yin zer/ 'jol snang gi nang du byon tshe gdung 'bum las bdud rtsi'i chu bab/ 'jol snang gi rgyab 'od gseb du phebs nas 'di na mchod rten chung ngu yod pa dran nam gsungs/ yul mi rgan po rnams kyis yong par dran yang sa mig ma dran zer bas zhang gi dbus gcig tu 'di na yod pa yin rkos dang gsungs/ brkos pas mchod rten gyi rmang dang sā tstsha mang du byung bas yul mis der mchod rten byas te skye dran 'bum par grags/ sprul sku rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang sprul sku gzhon nu lhun grub sogs kyi sngon gnas mang du dran nas gsungs pas sngon gyi grwa slob kun yid ches te sprul sku rtsod med du grags shing*/ de dag gi skye phreng snga ma chos rgyal rin chen gling pa ste/ de las sngon sprul pa'i tshul bstan du mas phrin las kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan pa/ de yang chos sku 'od dpag med kyi sprul sku thugs rje chen pos dzam gling gdul bar rgyal sras kyi tshul gyis/ phyi rol rgyang 'phen pa'i ston pa 'khor tshogs lnga brgya bcas mu stegs mang po rtsod pas pham par byas pa dang*/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum spro bsdu'i tshul bstan du dge slong ma'i dngos por mdzad nas rdzu 'phrul gyis mu stegs btul ba dang*/ slar yang rgyal sras gcig pu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa sogs mtha' yas par/

chos rgyal rin gling pa'i rnam thar ri bo pa nam mkha' 'od kyis mdzad par phal cher lung drangs pa ji ltar sngon mdzad phrin mang du bstan pa du ma gsungs par mdzad do// yul phyogs der bzhugs pa dgung lo nyer lnga pa'i tshe bsnyun shin tu lci ba zhig byung nas/ nad la sman pa mi 'gugs shing*// gdon la rim gro mi byed par// sogs kyi mgur gsungs/ sman dpyad sogs ma mdzad par ro snyom kho nas gzhi med du grol/ blos btang gi slob ma 'ga' zung dang bcas te yul phyogs du mar byon/ spyir rje 'di sngon bya bral gyi brtul zhugs mdzad dus sku'i cha byad ni nges med du mdzad/ res lung stong grog mdo la rtse sogs su'ang zhag mang po bzhugs su dang yang gtam mi mdzad/ res bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs la bstod pa kho na mdzad cing spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas 'byon pa nyin mtshan sbrel mar mdzad/ res skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi mgur kho na gsung zhing spyan chab 'byung zhing yul gruu ma thos pa mang po'i mi chen la sogs pa shi nas ngan song ba sogs kyi tshul gsung zhing bar do'i sems can la chos bshad kyi mgur kho na gsungs/ res rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud kyi tshig sngon ma grags pa dpag med zhal thon mdzad/ res rtogs pa'i mgur dpag med bzhengs te slob ma rnams kyang de dag la mos pa byed pa ma gtogs chos tsam mi gsungs/ res sus ci phul yang gcan gzan gyi sngon du rtswa bzhag pa ltar 'dor/ res cung zad re la phongs pa ltar mdzad/ res su 'phrad la ma 'ongs lung du stod pa rnams cung zad kyang mi slu/ de ltar ma nges pa'i spyod pa mdzad/ mngon mkhyen yang thugs nyams 'ur na ma gtogs rang gar mi gsungs pa'i dam bca' mdzad/ spyir gzhan rgyud hal hol shes pa 'di 'dra kho bo la lo gsum nas yod/ khams kyi rten 'brel las byung ba yin pas/ 'di 'dra la blor mi chud pa mi dgos gsungs/

da ltar dgung lo sum cu la nye ba'i bar du gsang spyod tshogs spyod chung 'bring dang rig spyod spros bcas spros med dang shin tu spros med ste spyod pa de thams cad lhan cig du mdzad/ de phyin phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang tshogs spyod chen po lhan cig tu mdzad ste snod ldan gyi slob ma rnams la smin grol gyi lam tshul bzhin du stsol/ skye bo thams cad la'ang mthong thos dran reg gi gzhan don mdzad/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma dang khol po dar thod can gyis spyan 'dren par gzigs nas gro bo lung gi phyogs su byon/ de'i dus yul de dag na nad yod pa na lha mo'i 'khor zhig mi la babs nas 'dir o rgyan gyi sprul pa zhig 'byon/ de nas nad yams chad 'gro zer te chos rje phebs ma thag chad/ zur phug dang khyad par zangs phug tu sku mtshams dam pa yun ring ba mdzad pa'i tshe res mtshan ril gyis chos skyong gi bstod pa dang bskul mdzad pa na thams cad kyang zil gyis ldangs mi nus pa tsam byung skad/

mon bum thang gzigs par bzhed nas chu khyer gyi bar byon pa na rten 'brel cung ma 'grig gsung nas phyir phebs/ thugs 'ur nas lam mis thar dka' ba rnams la'ang chibs rgyug mdzad nas sras mkhar du byon/ bu mo chung ngu zhig lam na 'dug pa la lag pas gang zin zhig da lta phul gsungs pas des spen ma zhig bcad nas phul byung bas spen bad cig byed dgos par 'dug gsungs te rje mar pa'i sku mkhar rje btsun mi las brtsegs pa sras mkhar dgu thog gi rtser sngar rje mar pa'i dus kyi spen bad ches brnyings te spen ma'i rnying ma ja bag 'dra ba dam dum tsam lus pa de slar legs par gsos shing mchod khang gong 'og tu mchod pa du ma mdzad/ rgyal mkhar ba'i nang so kun bzang pa shin tu dad cing zhabs tog byas/ sras mkhar gro bo lung gi gnas chen 'di phul bas bzhugs dgos zhus pa na kho bos bdag gir mi byed pa yin gsungs nas ma bzhes/ skyol bya ba'i ri khrod du lhun grub brag ler ming btags gzim spyil mdzad nas bzhugs/ gsung chos smar bar gnang*/ 'di phyin gra pa mang du yod pa rnams kyang chos lung tshogs pa dang tshogs dge 'dun sgang dang phyis sgar chen du rje btsun skya se'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs zhu bar gtong sdo thog ma drung nas shākya bas dbu mdzad pa sogs re re la nyi shu dang bco lnga sogs yod de thams cad bslab tshugs shin tu gtsang*/ bde mchog lū hi pa dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil dar zhing bsnyen sgrub la 'god/ o ḍyan bsnyen sgrub dang chos drug sras mkhar ma sogs la smar khrid mdzad/ de skor du lo du ma bzhugs slar lho shar rta shul du sku grib kyis bsnyun/ thim rim yang phal cher rdzogs te gshegs par mkhyen nas rnal 'byor pa grong yul du 'chi ba phongs pas ri logs ya gir skyol gsung ba na lha bzhi dgon par gdan drangs tshe gzhi bdag tsha lung brag btsan spun bzhis chibs pa'i rmig pa nas 'degs par du mas mthong*/

der phebs 'phral nas sku khams kyang dngas phyis der ring du bzhugs shing slob ma mang du byung*/ yugs se tshangs bya ba'i gnas su bzhugs*/ gra pa mang zhig phug che ba zhig tu mun khang la bzhugs/ gzhan rnams phug so sor mun khang byas/ thams cad kyi bug sgor zhag gnyis gsum la dmigs pa skyel du 'byon/ 'di'i tshe rje chos grags rgya mtsho gnyal chos rgyal lhun por phyi ma phebs pa'i skabs yin/ snyan grags kyis bskul bas lho shar nub kyi skye bo mtha' dag mjal du song*/ de'i tshe mun khang ba rnams mjal bar 'gro 'dod kyi rtog pa drag po byung zhing rgan pa rnams kyis 'byon par zhus pa na/ kho bo rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang 'od gsal gyi ngang du 'bral ba med pas dngos su mjal ma mjal la ltos pa med/ mjal na'ang sngon gyi smon lam zhig gis thugs rjes ni 'dzin par yong*/ da res phyin na khyed rang tshos dge sbyor ni g.yeng bas 'khyer bar 'dug 'on kyang khyed rnams kyi 'dod pa dang sbyar nas 'gro gsungs te byon/ sgar gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs nyams 'ur/ 'bul chen mdzad pa'i dus su 'bul ba'i dngos po re re la tshigs bcad lhug gi bsngags pa dpag med mdzad/ smon lam re dang sbrags nas phul sku gzi brjid che gsung zla med thugs mos gus dang byin rlabs kyi shugs gzhan dang mi 'dra bas khrom thams cad snang ba 'gyur te 'ur ding du song*/ rje dwags po rab 'byams pa dang thugs 'dre bar byung bas zhu sna sogs mdzad/ khrom chen po la rje thams cad mkhyen pas gsung chos gnang ba na rje dpa' bos rje phrin las pa la maṇḍal zhig phul na zhus pas mang pas mi 'grigs gsungs/ sa gzhi spos byug la mi 'grigs rgyu ci yod/ 'grig mi 'grig la phan yon khyad ci yod snyam pa byung gsungs te bzhengs nas maṇḍal phul bas thams cad dad pas 'ur/ sngon khrom rnams shab shub byed pa la de nyin thams cad zhi gnas thob pa ltar nyan/

mjal nyin nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa shin tu mnyes par mdzad cing*/ ja gral grol khar bla ma dpa' bo cung zad 'then gsungs nas zhal 'dzum mdzad de khyed kyis nged kyi bka' bzhin sgrub dgos gsungs/ de ltar yang yang du gsungs/ gsung chos kyang ci rigs gnang zhing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ phyis ci zhig na lho gro bo lung 'dir karma pa'i bstan pa zhig yod pa'i rten 'brel yod na'ang sngar 'grig pa zhig ma byung ba/ da khyed de phyogs la phrin las che ba yod 'dug pas der nged kyi sgrub sde cig cis kyang 'debs dgos gsungs pas bdag gis ci nus zhig 'debs/ de nas phyag nyid du 'bul bas bla ma zhig gnang ba zhu zhes zhus te gro bo lung du byon pas nang so kun bzang pa shin tu mnyes te rje mar pa rang gi thugs rje yin/ sngon phul bas ma bzhes/ da cis kyang go bcad ces thog mar sku mkhar rin po che phul/ sngar mkhar zhol gyi bad chad nas srin zam phra mo la mi rtsal pas thar tsam las med nas de rnams legs par bcos/ sku mkhar gyi rtser zhal ba brdung ba na mtshan mo mi ma yin gyis brdung ba ches mang bar byung*/ mchod yon gnyis kas dro bo lung du sgrub sde'i sa yul gzigs pas nyin mang por thugs thag mchod/ nyin gcig lha mo'i sku 'bag rgya gar ma'i drung du gtor ma zhig mdzad/ thugs 'ur te sku 'bag nas lcag gis brabs te sdug rgan ma khyod kyis bstan pa srung bar khas blangs nas khyod kyi gnas 'di na bstan pa dang ci 'dug chos byed mkhan su 'dug gsungs nas cher bkyon/ de'i sang nam langs ma thag lha mo'i dkon gnyer nag tshangs gdan sa sku drung 'ongs te gzim khang sar pa gcig mdzad na mi sde la 'u lag gzan po yong ba 'dug pas nga rang gi dbu rgyan 'di 'bul pa yin/ mi mang la gson dge'i tshab byed zer nas phul te/ der dbu rgyan bde chen rtser ming btags te gzim khang mdzad/

khong rang dbang ba'i ma'i sa mkhar du yang phul/ don la lha mos phul bar byed pa yin/ de'i skor du sgrub sde'i sgyil po mang du thebs/ 'on kyang rje dpa' bo 'di sgyil po bla gab can byas pa la chos mi 'ong*/ bung tshang 'dra ba chung rug ge ba re dgos pa yin gsungs pas de ltar yod par snang*/ sngon mon mo sgrub chen mas rgyags cig skyong dgos gsung ba bsgrubs pas chos zhu thams cad rgyags cig byed/ tsha dro'i dus thug pa nag tshang nas 'gyed cing rgyugs so sor skyel/ mtshams pa thams cad kyang nang du thab mi 'dzin/ mtshams pa la bug sgor byon nas chos gsungs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya phag mo'i sgom bzlas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas yan lag bdun pa byed/ kuu sa li'i tshogs sog deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*/ sogs kyis so thar len pa/ spyod 'jug lugs kyi sems bskyed kyis byang sdom/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang bde mchog gi nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung gis sngags sdom len pa/ gsol 'debs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi len pa/ phyag chen la mnyam par 'jog pa/ rjes bsngo ba smon lam ste/ de rnams khrigs su mdzad nas thab ka ba ma gtogs thams cad kyis snga dro phyi dro srod tho rengs te thun bzhir ma chag pa byed/ de yang tshig shur tsam ma yin par brel ba med dus snga dro sogs so so 'khyongs pa dang*/ shin tu brel na yang ja 'debs gnyis kyi yun tsam nges par byed/ 'degs bzhud kyi snga dro thams cad chas zin pa na dge 'dun thams cad bzhengs te ma nam mkha' ma'i gsol 'debs rgyas pa re mdzad pas thun gyi tshab byed/ dge 'dun thams cad thar thor du mi 'gro bar ma reg tsam la snga ma dang rjes ma ma gtogs thams cad ngag bcad nas dge sbyor las ma yengs par 'gro ba sogs sngon gyi bka' rgyud gong ma'i chos srol shin tu bzang ba bzhin byed do// dbu rgyan phul nas bla g.ye zin pa na rin chen brag pa'i chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dpon slob kyis nger chos khri brtsegs pas rten 'brel la mnyes/

sgrub sde grub nas sras gro lung sgrub sde sogs kyi bkod pa'i thang sku bris 'bul chen dang bcas rje thams cad mkhyen pa gtsang la thegs pa'i yar res kyi lha sar phebs pa dang mjal/ de res kyang 'bul ba re la tshigs bcad kyi bsngags pa dang smon lam mdzad cing dad pa'i gdung shugs dang gsol 'debs drag po mdzad pa na khrom thams cad snang ba 'ur/ de yang nyid dang por nyan thos kyi dge tshul yin yang bar du sngags spyod kyi sku cha lugs ma nges pas byis pa lta bu'i spyod pa dang smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa dang*/ seng ge lta bu'i spyod pa sogs sna tshogs mdzad la/ phyis lhun bde ba las bsnyen rdzogs rnam dag mdzad pa kho na bzhed kyang lhun bde ba sku gshegs pas sku gdung gi drung du dbu skra phul/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan por 'os pa yang ma gzigs nas/ sngon gyi sgrub rten sgrub pa mo de zhabs phyir yod pa'i skabs yin par snang*/ de'i rgyu mtshan las/ skya se rtogs ldan pa'i gsung nas bla ma dpa' bo de gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob nus pa gcig 'dug lar khong re yang dge ma rag la mnyes drags nas gsung skad/ mkhan chen bde legs pa'i gsung na re/ khrom de'i khrod na mi ngu ba su yang mi 'dug nga las mgo mkhregs pa'i mi med/ tshe 'di la mchi ma gzhan 'ong ma myong ste de'i nyin mchi ma rang dbang med par shor bla ma 'di'i phyags phyi la 'gro dgos snyam/ khong dpon slob kyi sgar du phyin pa na btsun ma skra lo can zhig mthong*/ 'di phyag rgya mar 'dug zer bas mtshan nyid pa'i dbu mdzad yin pas kha zer gyis dogs nas chos ma zhus zhes dngos su gsung ba thos/ sras mkhar dang sgrub sde sogs phul ba na slar khyer rang gi ma bzung na sgar pa'i mi btang bas mi zin gsung nas slar chos rje nyid la bskos 'ja' gnang*/ bla ma'i bka' mi gcog pa'i dam bca' mdzad pas zhal gyis bzhes/ sa skyong don rdor dpon blon gyis kyang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa gnas chen du mchod pa'i yo byad mang du phul/

phebs lam ya 'brog nas ra lug dang gnag phyugs mang du phul ba las sras kyi dkar thog gi rgyun 'di btsugs/ sras mkhar rgyal mtshan zer ba'i gro shul ba grwa pa snyoms chung zhig gis gzan zhig btsongs pa'i rin gyis sku mkhar las dkar gsol bas de phyin srol du chags/ chos rje kun bsam pa gshegs pas spyan 'dren drag du byung ba la nan gyis bzhugs par zhus/ lha mo'i sku 'bag la spyan chab kyi rjes byung*/ gtor ma'ang phul ma thag brul/ thegs par brtsas ma thag kha ba chen po mis mi thar ba bab/ thams cad rmi lam yang rtsub pas bzhugs par zhus pa na/ ltas bzang po nged rang la'ang med kyang bla ma'i dam tshig yin pas 'gro gsung ste dbon po mnga' bdag chos rgyal ba gdan sar bskos/ lam la dka' ba chen po mdzad nas thegs/ sku rjes kyi bya ba mdzad/ dor rdzas bor sku tshe'i rten 'brel du sku mtshams gcig mdzad pa'ang rkyen gyis grol dgos pa byung*/ 'brog bde steng du chos rje ri khrod ras chen he ru ka'i cha byad can dpon slob mang du byon te 'bul pa cher mdzad/ 'byon dus khyed rnams kyis ngu ba sogs ma byed/ bkra shis pa'i mgur 'then/ thor tsugs chings la song gsungs kyang thugs 'bral bar ma phod pas thams cad kyis ral pa bshal zhing bshums pas da ni rten 'brel mi 'grig par 'dug khyod rang lo gsum gyi bar du gtsang ma gtogs shar phyogs la kha gtad nas ma yong*/ yong na tshe yi bar chad 'byung gsungs/ de nas da ni rje thams cad mkhyen pa mjal dgos par 'dug gsung nas sgar chen gtsang nas skyi shod du phebs tshe sku cung zad bsnyun bzhin mjal du byon/ sgar du phebs kar grwa pa kun bsags nas/ 'o sgar chen 'di 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang yin/ sgar pa la ci yang yod de dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' na dur khrod yod pa lta bu yin gang la'ang log lta ma byed/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo spyan ras gzigs dngos yin gsol ba thob/

sde pa sgar pa 'di 'ang 'khor lo sdom pa'i sprul pa yin// bsod nams can la sprul yod pa yin// khyed rang rnams 'di gnyis kyis sdug du mi 'jug gsungs// byang thang du phyags phyi zin du re yang ma zin// skyi shod rnams su mjal te 'bul nod mang du mdzad// sang sgar pa thegs ka'i rgyab ja'i tshe yur ba'i 'gram na btsugs shing gi phreng ba yod pa'i shing drung dang mi ring ba na rje thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs/ drung 'khor rnams ci bder 'khod pa na ci zhig na rje dpa' bo bzhengs nas sku mdun nas phyag 'ga' zhig mdzad cung zad bzhugs/ yang sku'i g.yas phyogs dang g.yon phyogs nas kyang de bzhin mdzad/ ci zhig na rje dwags ram pa'i drung du byon nas/ mdun zhal dang g.yas zhal g.yon zhal nas gsol ba btab dbang bzhi blangs zin/ da rgyab zhal nas gsol ba btab chog gam zhus gsungs te de skad zhus pas rje thams cad mkhyen pa zhal 'dzum mdzad de nged rang la khong gis gdong pa bzhi yod par mthong ba e yin par 'dug /de ga byas chog gsungs te ljon shing dang sku'i bar 'dom gang tsam yod pa de'i bar nas gsol 'debs yun ring du mdzad ces rje dwags ram pa gsungs/ de'i nyin snye thang gi mkhar nag thang du sgar phebs te bzhugs/ de nas ma tshad du khong dpon slob kyi gzim gur mdzad/ de yang dgung lo zhe dgu pa phag lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig tu snang*/ sku mdun du ja la spyan 'dren 'byung*/ dpon slob rags pa bco lnga tsam zhig byon/ gsol lcog g.yas zur na mar bzhugs/ spyir rje dpa' bo 'di bla ma'i drung du bzhugs pa na spyan spyan chab phyag thal sbyar dang mi 'bral/ mos gus che ba'i mthar thug pa'i lo rgyus mang du yod/ su la yang dam pa'i chos kyi tshig tsam ma gtogs phal gtam mi gsung*/ gar bzhugs kyang sku lus gnad/ spyan rdo rje'i lta stangs/ bar rlung gi sbyor ba dang mi 'bral/ mchog dman thams cad la gong du bkur zhing bkur sti mdzad/

gsung 'jam zhing zhe sar bcas pas brjod/ de ltar zhi zhing dul yang sus kyang zil gyis mi non/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa kha bye bas rdo rje'i mgur la thogs pa med/ thugs 'ur ba'i dus lkog gyur gyi gnas dang ma 'ongs pa lung du bstan pa rnams ni bslu ba med/ char 'bebs gcod sogs la spyan lta stangs kyi sbyor bas gang 'dod 'grub/ snying rje chen po tshad med pa mnga'/ yon tan gyi gting mtha' ma dpog pa yin no zhes pa ni 'phros pa'o// de nas ja gral de thon pa dang rje dpa' bo har gyis bzhengs te phyag gsum mdzad nas kho bo nad dam po zhig gis zin bdog pas gang bde byas chog pa gnang dgos ces lan gsum zhus pa na rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang de ga chog gsungs/ 'di mya ngan las 'da' chog par zhus par snang bas sngon tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ bcom ldan 'das la bdag mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyid do lan gsum zhus pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'da' bar smra ba'ang 'dus byas kyi chos nyid yin na nges smrar ci yod/ ces gsungs pa lta bur snang ngo*// de ma thag byon nas gral gyi sked smad tsam na rje sangs blo ba 'di dge 'dun gyi byang 'dren mdzad pa dbu mdzad sangs blo zhes mtshan 'bod pa zhig bzhugs pa'i phyag nas 'then te thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku mdun du khrid de 'di la da lta gro bo lung gi gdan sa bsko ba zhu zhes zhus te/ de kar phyag nas gnang sbyin gnang*/ 'di yang gro bo lung gi mnga' bdag chos rgyal ba de'i nyin gshegs par 'dug pa mkhyen pa yin par snang*/ de ma thag na bza' gos zla ma/ sku phyam dmar ser gnyis/ sku chos sku gzan sku rag sku sham gyi bar du phul/ sku pang du dbu bcug nas smon lam mang du mdzad/ nga bla ma'i drung nas phyir gcer bur mi 'gro gsung nas sku 'gag sku rags tsam bzhes pas sgar gyi drung skor dang grwa pas bskor te yol ba bar la bskor ba mdzad/

zhal gyi thad drang po nas thal mo sbyar te zhal la spyan 'bru tshugs su gzigs nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa khyed kyis nga la spyan yun ring po zhig gzigs shig gsungs pa lan gsum du gsol pa na rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang zhal 'dzum pa dang dbu gug pa lan gsum mdzad/ da ni nga'i bsam pa thams cad rdzogs bya ba thams cad zin gsung nas phyi 'gros kyis yol ba'i phyir byon phyir phebs ma thag gsung chen pos sgar pa rnams la'ang dkor zan khyed tsho dkor thams cad zos thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa mi sgrub pa gsung nas cher bkyon/ grwa pa rnams la'ang mi khyed tsho'i bsod nams de ring gis zad do gsungs/

gzim gur du phebs 'phral rje sangs blo ba la ngas bla ma thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang bstun nas chos brgyud phyogs med du byas pa yin/ khyod kyis ma 'ongs pa'i dgos pa gcig yod pas chos brgyud zhwa stabs dang bcas pa 'di karma pa kho nar 'dril ba zhig gyis gsungs/ de phyin gsung gzhan mi 'byon skabs su/ khyed rang tsho sdod ngas chos bshad kyi gsung pa lan re tsam gsungs/ sang tshes gnyis la sgar chen lha sar thegs/ dpon slob rnams de kar bzhugs/ tshes bzhi'i tho rangs thugs 'od gsal du zhugs/ rje sangs blo bas gtso mdzad pa rnams kyis yol ba'i phyi nas gdung mchod mdzad/ de dus gzim gur la 'ja' 'khor mar zug /me tog gi char rtag tu bab pas snye thang pa rnams kyis rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzim gur gyi shul yin par bzung*/ phyis sgar mgo'i bla ma zhig gshegs par 'dug zer nas bskor ba la 'dus/ tshes brgyad gyi nyin gung la thugs dam grol par bstan zhing rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du bsngo zhus la phyin pa na thog mar zhal ngo nag tsam mdzad/ de nas chos rje mang thos pa la gzigs nas nged sgom chen pa 'chi na nyams dang bcas nas 'chi ba yin zhes zhal 'dzum mdzad/ sgar gyi bla ma rnams las khyed rang tsho su mos pa btang gsung pas rje dwags ram pa zhus te gdung sbyong bar gdan drangs/ sa skyong don rdor pas kyang mchod pa'i sprin spros/ snye thang gi dgon pa gang mos su spyan drongs ces gsungs bas nor bu brag gi zhol du gdan drangs/ hor zla bdun par song bas ser ba yong zhes mi sde gdung mi bzhu par sdes pa la zhus kyang*/ de 'dra mi dgos yul byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ gdung bzhu ba'i tshe thog mar rlung chen po byung ste sa'i nyal nyil thams cad phyags/ de rjes 'brug sgra drag po dang bcas pa'i char chen pos snye thang stod de'i kyong thams cad chus gang bas yon chab bsgrig pa 'dra ba zhig byung*/

de nas char chad de nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs pas khebs/ me tog gi char kha ba ltar bab tshe rje dwags ram pa bzhengs nas g.yul khang gi steng der byon te me tog gi char 'dzin pa la phar rgyug tshur rgyug mdzad/ spyir rdzogs ldan gyi dus zas gos dang rin po che'i char 'bebs pa dang sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i lam brgyan pa sogs la'ang thog mar rlung gis nyal nyil phyags/ de nas char gyis rdul gnon/ de nas me tog gam zas sogs 'bab ba ste go rim ni 'di kho nar snang ngo*// phyis rje dwags ram pa'i zhal nas/ khyed kyi skye ba snga ma de'i gdung bsreg pa la ngas phyin/ gsol kar mi nyag gan kar chen po de spub ba'i yu ba nas bzung ste skor gyin me tog gi char 'di tsam rang byung ngo ang me tog gi char de las che ba mthong ma myong*/ chos 'brel zhig ma zhus snyam nas 'gyod po byung*/ da khyed nga'i rtsar byon byung bas 'gyod mi dgos par 'dug gsungs/ dbu klad ril po spos shel ltar dngas pa dang ring bsrel ngo mtshar ba mang du byung bar snang zhing*/ phyis dbu ltag gi gdung zur gsum pa gcig gi zur cung ser tsam 'dug pa las phyis mdun logs thams cad ser por gyur/ de'i dbus nas dkar zhing 'od 'tsher ba zhig la/ thugs rje chen po kha sarpa ṇa phyag gnyis pa'i sku ches gsal ba zla phyed re zhing je gsal du 'gro ba zhig rje dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng pa'i phyag tu yod pa phyis chos rje gong ma rang gi sku 'dra zhig tu bzhugs su gsol zhing ring bsrel dkar ser sran rlon tsam brgya mdung kyi dbyibs yod pa shin tu lci ba bdar na grub bzhi sogs bzo ji ltar byas kyang btub pa la sang nyin snga ma'i rgya mdud dbyibs snga ma ji lta ba de kar log 'gro ba zhig kyang bdag gis mthong zhes rje gtsug lag phreng ba gsung zhing*/ de ltar rje brgyad pas kyang ring bsrel yang dag pa yin no zhes bka' stsal to/

/gdung tshwa la ring bsrel byung ba ches mang*/ gdung khang gi so phag gdung thal rnams bzhu sa de kar mchod rten byas nas bzhugs shing*/ der bskor mchod byed pa 'ga' dang 'ga' yis lo mang por ring bsrel rnyed pa mang ngo*/ /tshes bzhi'i mchod pa 'dzin pa rnams na me tog gi char sogs 'byung ba yin zer ba yul ci rigs na du ma snang ngo*/ /rje de'i bu slob rang mgo thon tsam gyis sgom chen ni ches mang la/ ༈¿¿rje ri khrod ras chen ni/ rje nyid kyi gcung po yin/ rje nyid kyis dge bsnyen gnang*/ mtshan 'jam dbyangs lhun grub/ gtsang smyon dang shar kha ras chen dang las 'brel 'dug pas re zhig der song gsungs te de dag gi gdams ngag rdzogs shing ri khrod ras chen du mtshan btags/ he ru ka'i chas mdzad/ slob ma'i tshogs mang zhing phrin las shin tu che/ rje dpa' bo nyid las chos dang gdams ngag mang du gsan cing spang rtogs kyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs shing rje nyid khyad par du rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin no/ /de'i slob ma zur pa stod zur gyi sngags ston sgrub chen bsod bkras pa dang*/ de'i slob ma ko brag pa sogs mang ngo*/ /sku tshe'i stod kyi slob ma dbon po rdo rje rnam rgyal zhes sman sbyin dang bsnyung gnas sogs 'gro don shin tu che ba dang*/ bla ma khrom steng pa sku mched kyang rtsa ba'i slob ma yin phrin las che/ dge slong bde chen dar zhes bya ba thugs dam shin tu bzang ba zhig kho bo rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar 'gro gsungs te byon// ༈¿¿bla ma dpon yig pa ni/ grar 'khrungs/ byams gling pa'i dge bshes yin/ rje la bsten te gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs/ rtogs ba mtho/ bka' 'bum gyi bsdu ba po yang mdzad/ mtshan lhun grub rgya mtsho yin/ mngon shes mnga'/ bar do'i rnam shes gzigs nas don byed nus/ ring bsrel mang du byon no// ༈¿¿sgrub chen shākya dhwa dza ni/ byar chos sde'i dge bshes/

rje nyid kyi zhabs la gtugs nas spangs rtogs mthar phyin/ sprul sku phyi ma dgung lo bco brgyad tsam gyi bar gshegs rjes gdan sa'i dod mdzad de zhabs tog che/ de nas lo ro'i sman pa le gdas 'dab sogs su rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad ste spangs rtogs phul du gyur/ lcang lo can gyi dgon pa mdzad/ yul der chos pa dar bar yang mdzad do// ༈¿¿rje sangs blo ba ni/ 'brog pa ri smad du 'khrungs/ rje dpa' bo mjal zhing chos gsan pas skyes bu gsum gyi lam rnal ma 'khrungs/ rig gnas dang mdo sngags kyi mkhyen pa che zhing gsan rgya mtha' yas/ phyis brag rtsa'i dgon btab ste dbang lung khrid gsum gyi phrin las sogs gzhan yang 'gro don cher byung ngo*// ༈¿¿sgrub chen rgya gshongs pa yang*/ rje 'di las gdams pa mang du gsan/ dol bu rgya gshongs su sku tshe sgrub pa la bskyal mngon shes mnga' bar grags so// ༈¿¿bla ma smon bzang ba ni/ gzhung du 'khrungs/ tshal min du dus 'khor dang*/ gsang phur mtshan nyid la sbyangs pas shin tu mkhas/ rje dpa' bo las bsnyen sgrub sogs gdams pa mtha' dag gsan te sras kyi thu bo gyur/ rjes lung bstan te dol chos 'khor sgang btab nas phrin las che'o// ༈¿¿sgrub chen chos dpal ni/ dol du 'khrungs/ rje las chos dang gdams ngag zhus/ tshe ring bar yong ba'i rten 'brel yod gsungs pa ltar dgung lo gya gcig pa'i tshe mdun du 'dom gang tsam na mthong ka yod pa'i skas la phyag g.yog zhig 'dzegs yong par thog phog ste/ skas sol dum tho re ba las ma lus/ mi de lus ldum tsam zhig lus/ lcags phreng zhig yod pa gong bu gcig tu zhu yang khong rang la cung zad kyang gnod ma nus pa sogs so// ༈¿¿sgrub chen blo she pa ni/ rje la gdams pa mang du gsan/ rmi lam sgyu lus la mnga' brnyes/ dbus kyi dol dang*/ gtsang phung po ri bo cher sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ 'brog mgron bu lung gi bla ma dad can de'i khang par phyag nas nam mkhar mang du chags pa las ba thag phra mo zhig la nas bdun brtsegs su chags pa phyis kyang kun gyis mthong*/

de'i slob ma sngags 'chang lhun grub mgo legs bcas thugs rtsis che ba'i gnas brtan sngags 'chang ba bsnyun zug gis phyag zhabs g.yug pa'i rdo thams cad la rjes byung*/ gzhan yang dol bde gshongs su sgrub pas dus 'da' ba'i sgrub chen bsod bstan pa zhes mkhas grub de sogs rtsa slob brgyud slob ni chos mang ngo*// ༈¿¿dge slong thabs ldan don ldan zhes bya ba skad kyis khrom thams cad 'du thub pa phyis rgyal po rnams kyi mgur mkhan du gyur yang 'chi khar rkyen snang thal byung du bcad de bar do dang po zin zhing ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung bar snang ngo*/ /gra nas ce te chos mdzad ma zer ba'i grub chen ma rje 'di'i rtsa ba'i slob ma zhig kyang lo drug cu tsam na dben par me thab drug bcings su bzhugs yod par gnam lcags drag po babs kyang gnod ma nus so/ /gzhan yang yul gru so sor mngon mtho'i 'gro don cung zad pher ba'i bla ma dang sgom chen ri pher tsam ni cher mang ngo*/ /bla ma ru pas mjal bas chos du ma zhus/ lan gcig khyod rang nga'i khri thog 'dir nyol phrin las kyi rten 'brel 'ong gsung ltar phrin las byung zhes rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin par snang ngo*/ /gru shul du bram ze snyan rgyud btsugs par chos zhu'i skyes pa gsum chos byed par zhus pa la/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du las 'brel 'dug pas song zhig bka' stsal ltar phyin pas/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan chos rgyal mtshan/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan zhes gnang ste bya bral gyi brtul zhugs byas pas mi la ras pa gsum zhes grags pa'i dang po pas khra karma chos rdzong btab/ gzhan gnyis kyang sgrub pa mthar phyin par byung ngo*// gzhan yang yar rgyab kun spangs pa glag tshang gdan sa pa sogs chos 'brel thob ba ni ches mang ngo*/ /bla ma 'brir ba/ glang khung pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ gnyal o rgyan gling pa sogs rang gnas su spyan drangs te/

gdams pa mang du zhus pa/ bla ma cham dgon pa/ rkyang chen bla ma lha dbang sogs phyags phyir lo kha shas bzhugs nas chos zhus pa ni ches mang ngo*/ /de ltar rje dpa' bo 'di ni ma mjal ba'i dus nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu 'dzin pa dang*/ phyis dro bo lung gi gdan sa chen por sgrub bstan gyi rten 'brel 'grigs pa'i zhabs tog che zhing dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad pa sogs spangs rtogs phrin las gang gi phyir rtsa slob che shos kyi grar bgrangs pa nyid do// ༈¿¿mkhan chen shāka bzang ni/ mdo khams karma'i nye lam gsal stong sgom sho'i bzhugs gnas dang nye bar 'khrungs/ mtshur phur gsang sngags kyi phyag len mkhas par sbyangs/ chos rje ngo khro las gdams ngag dang*/ phyis sgar gyi yang ri la bzhugs shing gdams pa legs par gsan/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas dwags lha sgam po nyams gsos mdzad nas 'di pa mkhan por bskos/ dar rgyas kyi rten 'brel mdzad/ 'dis phyag mkhar sgrub sde mdzad/ slob ma mang du 'dus/ lugs gnyig nas sgam po dar rgyas su mdzad pas sgam po'i gnas la sngon rje 'jig rten mgon po yab sras dang*/ phyis rje 'di bka' drin che zhing*/ spyan snga bkra sgang pa mched dang*/ spyan snga sgar pa mched du bcas pa rnams kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ kong por yang chos rgya ci rigs pa dang sgrub sde gong 'og mdzad pa sog sgrub bstan la gcig tu mdzad pa che'o// ༈¿¿bla ma cham dgon pa grags pa dpal ldan ni/ 'brog cham dgon du 'khrungs/ bla ma mang po bsten/ khyad par drung pa si tu pa'i phyag dpe bri ba'i zhar la zab chos rnams gsan zhing rje phrin las pa la'ang phul/ phyis ches 'gro ba'i mgon po'i ti shri mdzad ste chu bo rir sgrub grwa mdzad to// ༈¿¿'grus khang pa bsod nams rgya mtsho ni/ mdo khams 'grus khang pa'i zhal ngo yin/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa las gsung chos rnams gsan/ rje kun rin po'i slob ma mdzad nas mdo khams su bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad cing*/

phyis dbus su byon te dbon zur bzhugs pa'i bla ma mdzad to// ༈¿¿khres kha pa don grub rnam rgyal ni/ rje nyid kyi rtsa slob yin la 'bri khung skor du phrin las che'o// ༈¿¿bsam gtan gling pa ni/ kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po dang rje bdun pa'i rtsa slob yin la ra sgreng gi lung lag zhig tu sgrub pa mthar phyin tu mdzad pa'i sgo nas phrin las che'o/ /gzhan yang dar pa rtogs ldan la sogs pa'i gzhan phan can mtha' yas par byon no/ /smyug la ba'i dpon sa gser khang mas kyang sku gshegs khar zhal gzigs par grags shing*/ nang so 'brom pas kyang chu bo ri'i nam mkhar rje karma pa ras rkyang zhwa nag can byon te me tog gi char bab pa'i zhal gzigs thang sku snang ngo*//
